title: 《冰雪奇缘》电影小说
blurb: F1 官方电影小说化：姐妹的羁绊如何融化一个冰封的冬天。

chapters.title: 序章 · 雪山采冰人

paras.en: Long ago, atop a mountain high above the kingdom of Arendelle, a group of strong men were hard at work. They were ice harvesters, men who cut and hauled huge blocks of ice from the mountain lakes. Horses stood at attention, waiting with empty wagons to be filled. The ice blocks were hoisted into the wagons; soon they would be taken down to the village to sell. It was a dangerous business. One slip could send a block hurtling down the mountainside—or even worse, falling on a man and crushing him.
paras.zh: 很久以前，在阿伦黛尔王国上方的高山顶上，一群强壮的男人正干得热火朝天。他们是采冰人——从山间湖泊里凿冰、拖运巨大冰块为生的人。马儿肃立待命，守着空空的货车等候装货。冰块被吊上货车，很快就会运下山去，送到村子里售卖。这是一门危险的行当。稍一失足，冰块就会顺着山坡呼啸而下——更糟的是，砸在人身上，把他活活压扁。

paras.en: A boy stood in the shadows watching the workmen. He kept a small sled at his side. His name was Kristoff, and he desperately wanted to join the ice harvesters, but he was too young. Standing next to him was his friend Sven, a baby reindeer. Kristoff imagined the two of them taking a sled full of ice blocks into the village of Arendelle. Sven sniffed the cold air and glanced at the big blocks of ice. They looked very heavy. He snorted but didn’t move a hoof.
paras.zh: 一个男孩站在阴影里，望着这些工人。他身边放着一架小雪橇。他叫克里斯托夫，一心想加入采冰人的行列，可他年纪还太小。站在他身旁的是他的朋友斯文——一头小驯鹿。克里斯托夫想象着他们俩驾着满载冰块的雪橇，一路驶进阿伦黛尔村。斯文嗅了嗅寒冷的空气，瞥了瞥那些巨大的冰块。它们看上去沉极了。它喷了喷鼻息，却一动也不动。

paras.en: As evening approached, Kristoff finally convinced Sven to carry a small load of ice on their sled. By now, the men had lit several lanterns and were finishing loading their own wagons. Kristoff crept forward and was able to grab a small block of ice. He finally wrestled the block onto his sled and attached Sven’s harness.
paras.zh: 夜幕渐临，克里斯托夫终于说动了斯文，让它在雪橇上拉一小批冰。这时，大人们已点亮了几盏灯笼，正装完自己货车上的最后几件货。克里斯托夫蹑手蹑脚地凑上前，抓住了一小块冰。他好一番折腾才把冰块弄上雪橇，给斯文系好挽具。

paras.en: Wagon by wagon, the ice harvesters headed down the mountain roads. Kristoff trailed behind with Sven, steering his own small wagon down the bumpy path.
paras.zh: 采冰人一辆接一辆，沿着山道下山去了。克里斯托夫驾着自己的小货车，带着斯文颠颠簸簸地跟在后面。

paras.en: Above them all, the northern lights spread across the dark sky, creating waves of gossamer green light. The magical glow pulsed as it rolled over the mountains, down toward the kingdom below.
paras.zh: 在他们头顶，北极光在夜空中铺展开来，漾起一层层薄纱般的绿光。那魔幻的光晕脉动着，漫过群山，一路倾泻向山下的王国。

chapters.title: 第一章 · 极光下的女孩

paras.en: In a grassy valley next to a deep fjord, the castle of Arendelle lay silent in the night. The bright luster of the northern lights danced across the windows, waking a small girl. She sat up and grinned to see the wonderful green light.
paras.zh: 在一道深邃峡湾旁的青翠山谷里，阿伦黛尔的城堡在夜色中静默无声。北极光的璀璨流光在窗上舞动，唤醒了一个小女孩。她坐起身，看见那美妙的绿光，咧嘴笑了。

paras.en: The girl jumped out of bed and tiptoed across the room to wake her older sister. “Elsa, Elsa!” she said urgently. “Wake up!”
paras.zh: 女孩跳下床，踮着脚尖穿过房间，去叫醒姐姐。“艾莎，艾莎！”她急切地说。“快醒醒！”

paras.en: Elsa, who was eight years old, grumbled and ducked under the covers. “Anna, go back to sleep.”
paras.zh: 八岁的艾莎嘟囔着，把头缩进被子里。“安娜，回去睡觉。”

paras.en: But Anna wouldn’t give up. “I just can’t. The sky’s awake, so I’m awake, and so we have to play,” she said. “Do you want to build a snowman?”
paras.zh: 可安娜不肯罢休。“我就是睡不着嘛。天空都醒了，所以我醒了，那我们就得一起玩呀，”她说。“你想不想堆雪人？”

paras.en: Elsa’s eyes popped open. That got her attention.
paras.zh: 艾莎的眼睛一下子睁开了。这话果然管用。

paras.en: The girls were the daughters of Arendelle’s king and queen, and the best of friends. Elsa couldn’t resist Anna’s begging. The sisters ran down the hallway in their nightgowns, laughing as they hurried along. Entering the Great Hall, where all the royal balls were held, they turned to each other.
paras.zh: 两姐妹是阿伦黛尔国王与王后的女儿，也是形影不离的好朋友。艾莎终究抵挡不住安娜的央求。姐妹俩穿着睡裙跑过走廊，一路笑着匆匆前行。走进举办王室舞会的大厅，她们彼此相对站定。

paras.en: “Are you ready?” Elsa asked, smiling.
paras.zh: “准备好了吗？”艾莎微笑着问。

paras.en: “Yes, yes!” Anna cried, reaching out to tickle her sister.
paras.zh: “好了，好了！”安娜喊着，伸手去挠姐姐的痒。

paras.en: Elsa giggled, and suddenly, snowflakes seemed to burst in a flurry from her hands!
paras.zh: 艾莎咯咯笑起来，忽然，雪花仿佛从她手中纷纷迸发而出！

paras.en: Anna clapped happily. She knew that her sister had a very special talent: she could create snow and ice, even in the middle of summer!
paras.zh: 安娜开心地拍起手来。她知道姐姐有一种很特别的天赋：她能凭空造出冰雪，哪怕在盛夏时节！

paras.en: With a twirl and a wave of her hands, Elsa magically summoned her icy powers. Quickly, she filled the Great Hall with mounds of fluffy snow, turning it into a winter playground. Then she stomped her feet and ice swept across the floor. She laughed to see little Anna hopping around joyfully.
paras.zh: 艾莎旋身挥手，唤出神奇的冰雪之力。转眼间，大团大团蓬松的雪填满了大厅，把这里变成了一座冬日游乐场。接着她跺了跺脚，冰面便漫过地板。看着小安娜欢快地蹦来蹦去，她笑出了声。

paras.en: Together, they went to work building their snowman. Anna did her best to roll out the snowman’s body. Then she ran to get a carrot for the nose. “Snowman!” she exclaimed proudly.
paras.zh: 姐妹俩一起动手，堆起了雪人。安娜使出浑身力气，滚出雪人的身子。然后跑去拿来一根胡萝卜当鼻子。“雪人堆好啦！”她骄傲地喊道。

paras.en: Elsa laughed at the lopsided snowman. “Hi, I’m Olaf,” she said in a deep voice, pretending to be the snowman. “And I like warm hugs.”
paras.zh: 艾莎看着这个歪歪扭扭的雪人，忍不住笑了。“嗨，我是雪宝，”她压低嗓音，假装自己是那个雪人。“我喜欢温暖的拥抱。”

paras.en: The girls danced around their funny snowman.
paras.zh: 两个女孩围着滑稽的雪人跳起舞来。

paras.en: Then Elsa gathered her icy magic and made a swooping ice slide. Anna squealed with delight. She climbed to the top of the slide, then zoomed down and soared up again along the icy curve. Elsa quickly created another slide to catch Anna as she came down. The little girl gained speed and was tossed upward again. Elsa had to work fast to keep pace with Anna. She kept making more slides so her sister could stay aloft as she flew around the room.
paras.zh: 随后，艾莎凝聚冰雪魔法，造出一道俯冲而下的冰滑梯。安娜高兴得尖叫起来。她爬上滑梯顶端，嗖地滑下，又顺着冰弧腾空飞起。艾莎赶紧再变出一道滑梯，在安娜落下时接住她。小女孩越滑越快，又一次被抛上半空。艾莎必须手疾眼快，才能跟上安娜的节奏。她不停地造出新的滑梯，好让妹妹绕着大厅飞的时候始终有落脚之处。

paras.en: “Anna, slow down,” Elsa said, starting to get worried. “It’s too high!”
paras.zh: “安娜，慢一点，”艾莎说，心里开始发慌。“太高啦！”

paras.en: But Anna was having fun. The little princess was fearless, jumping and sliding to each new slide as quickly as Elsa made it. Elsa raised her hand to create the next slide, but suddenly, her foot slipped. As she stumbled, her magic went awry. Her frozen blast caught the side of Anna’s head, right through her curls.
paras.zh: 可安娜正玩在兴头上。小公主毫无惧色，艾莎每造出一道新滑梯，她就立刻跳上去滑下来。艾莎举手准备变出下一道滑梯，脚却忽然一滑。她一个踉跄，魔法失了准头。那道冰霜之劲击中了安娜的头部一侧，正穿过她的卷发。

paras.en: Anna gasped and fell to the ground, unconscious.
paras.zh: 安娜倒抽一口气，倒在地上，昏了过去。

paras.en: “Anna!” Elsa shouted, running to her sister. She lifted Anna up and felt her cold, shivering body. A lock of Anna’s hair had turned pure white where the magic had hit it. “Mama! Papa!” Elsa cried desperately.
paras.zh: “安娜！”艾莎喊着，飞奔向妹妹。她把安娜抱起来，触到她冰冷发抖的身体。魔法击中的地方，安娜的一缕头发变得雪白。“妈妈！爸爸！”艾莎拼命呼喊。

paras.en: As she called for help and her worry increased, icicles formed on the ceiling, and frozen spikes grew tall around the girls.
paras.zh: 她一边呼救一边越来越慌，天花板上的冰柱渐渐成形，四周竖起高高的冰刺，把姐妹俩围在中间。

paras.en: The king and queen burst into the Great Hall to find their daughters huddled in a frozen landscape. They knew that Elsa had a special ability to create ice, but this was more than they’d ever seen. “Elsa,” the king cried. “This is getting out of hand!”
paras.zh: 国王和王后冲进大厅，只见女儿们蜷缩在一片冰封的天地里。他们知道艾莎有造冰的神奇能力，可眼前这一幕远远超出了他们的想象。“艾莎，”国王喊道。“这事要失控了！”

paras.en: “I’m sorry,” Elsa replied in distress. “I didn’t mean it!”
paras.zh: “对不起，”艾莎惶恐地答道。“我不是故意的！”

paras.en: “Anna!” the queen gasped, and ran toward her little girl.
paras.zh: “安娜！”王后惊呼着，朝小女儿奔去。

chapters.title: 第二章 · 尘封的古书

paras.en: The castle’s library was dark, but the king knew what he was looking for: an ancient book filled with knowledge from centuries past. When he found it, he pulled it from the shelf and quickly flipped through the pages to the section he needed. In it was a drawing of a troll, which seemed to be holding the northern lights in its hands. In front of the troll, a wounded human lay quiet while the troll used the magic of the northern lights to heal him. The king turned the page and spotted a crumbling document tucked into the book. He carefully unfolded the yellowed map.
paras.zh: 城堡的图书馆里一片昏暗，但国王清楚自己要找什么：一本汇聚着数百年前智慧的古书。找到之后，他把书从架上抽出，飞快地翻到需要的那一部分。书里画着一只山精，双手仿佛捧着北极光。山精面前，一个受伤的人静静躺着，山精正用北极光的魔法为他疗伤。国王翻过一页，发现书里夹着一份边角碎裂的文书。他小心地展开那张泛黄的地图。

paras.en: Wasting no time, the king and queen threw on their cloaks, bundled up their daughters, and ordered that the horses be saddled. The royal family hurried away from the castle. The queen traveled on her own horse with Elsa, while the king held Anna in his arms. The horses thundered up the mountain path.
paras.zh: 国王与王后一刻不耽搁，披上斗篷，把女儿们裹得严严实实，下令备马。王室一家匆匆离开了城堡。王后带着艾莎各骑一匹马，国王则把安娜抱在怀里。马蹄声如雷，沿山路疾驰而上。

paras.en: Kristoff and Sven were walking down the rocky mountain path under the bright glow of the northern lights. But as the rumble of hooves filled the air, they moved aside, wary of the approaching horses. They watched the riders gallop past, leaving a trail of ice behind them.
paras.zh: 北极光明亮的光辉下，克里斯托夫和斯文正走在多石的山路上。可当马蹄的轰鸣响彻夜空，他们警惕地退到一旁，躲避逼近的马队。他们望着骑手们疾驰而过，身后留下一道冰痕。

paras.en: Curious, Kristoff and Sven followed the travelers to a ridge above a mountain valley. The two hid behind a rock and watched as the horses whinnied and came to a stop.
paras.zh: 出于好奇，克里斯托夫和斯文跟着这群旅人，来到一处俯瞰山谷的山脊。两人躲在岩石后面，望着马匹嘶鸣着停下脚步。

paras.en: The king and queen dismounted. The king held a young girl to his shoulder; the queen held the hand of a slightly older girl.
paras.zh: 国王与王后翻身下马。国王肩上扛着一个小女孩，王后则牵着稍大些的女孩的手。

paras.en: “Please, help!” the king cried out. “My daughter!”
paras.zh: “求求你，救救她！”国王高声呼喊。“我的女儿！”

paras.en: The hillside appeared empty at first. Then a pile of rocks rolled down the hillside. Suddenly, the rocks unfolded themselves into legs and arms and stood up, revealing themselves to be small gray creatures—they weren’t rocks at all! “Trolls,” Kristoff whispered to Sven.
paras.zh: 山坡上起初看似空无一人。接着，一堆石头顺着山坡滚了下来。忽然，那些石头伸展开手脚，站了起来——它们根本不是石头，而是一群灰色的小家伙！“是山精，”克里斯托夫对斯文轻声说。

paras.en: At that moment, a rock next to Kristoff jumped up, turning into a short troll woman covered with moss. Her name was Hulda.
paras.zh: 就在这时，克里斯托夫身旁的一块石头蹦了起来，变成一个浑身长满苔藓的矮个子女山精。她叫布尔达。

paras.en: “Shush,” Hulda told Kristoff absently. “I’m trying to listen.” Then, startled, Hulda looked more closely at Kristoff, realizing for the first time that he was not a troll. Her face broke into a grin, and she reached out to give Kristoff and Sven big hugs. “Cuties!” she said, laughing.
paras.zh: “嘘，”布尔达心不在焉地对克里斯托夫说。“我正听着的呢。”随即她一愣，凑近打量克里斯托夫，这才头一回发觉他并不是山精。她顿时咧嘴一笑，伸出双臂，给了克里斯托夫和斯文一个大大的拥抱。“小可爱们！”她笑着说。

paras.en: In the valley, the king stood with his daughters as Pabbie, a very old troll, made his way through the crowd to gaze at the princesses.
paras.zh: 山谷里，国王带着两个女儿站着；年迈的山精长者帕比穿过人群，上前端详两位公主。

paras.en: First he looked at Elsa. “Was she born with the powers or cursed?” he asked.
paras.zh: 他先看了看艾莎。“她的力量是与生俱来的，还是被诅咒的？”他问。

paras.en: “Born,” the king answered. “And they’re getting stronger.”
paras.zh: “与生俱来，”国王答道。“而且越来越强了。”

paras.en: The troll then turned his attention to Anna, who was still unconscious. “You are lucky it wasn’t her heart that was struck,” he noted. “The heart is not so easily changed, but the head can be persuaded.” He paused. “We should remove all the magic, even memories of magic, to be safe.”
paras.zh: 山精随即把注意力转向仍然昏迷不醒的安娜。“幸好击中的不是她的心脏，”他提醒道。“心没那么容易被改变，脑子却可以被说动。”他顿了顿。“为保万全，我们应当移除所有魔法，连同关于魔法的记忆一起抹去。”

paras.en: The king nodded. “Do what you must,” he said.
paras.zh: 国王点点头。“该怎么做就怎么做。”他说。

paras.en: With a gentle touch of his fingers, the troll pulled a series of glowing memories from little Anna’s head. The memories hovered in the air as the troll transformed them into more sensible scenes. Instead of a magical snowman in the ballroom, Anna would now remember a winter scene in the courtyard. Instead of snowflakes in the hallway, she would remember snowflakes falling outside the window. All the magical moments she had shared with Elsa were gone, replaced with normal moments. The only remnant of her magical accident was the streak of white in her hair.
paras.zh: 山精指尖轻轻一触，从小安娜的脑海里取出一连串闪闪发光的记忆。那些记忆悬在半空，山精把它们改写成更寻常的画面。安娜今后记得的不再是舞厅里神奇的雪人，而是庭院里的一场冬景。她记得的不再是走廊里的雪花，而是窗外飘落的雪。她与艾莎共享的所有魔法时刻都被抹去，换成了寻常的日子。那场魔法意外留下的唯一痕迹，便是她头发里那一缕白发。

paras.en: “There,” said Pabbie when he was finished. “She will remember the fun, but not the magic.”
paras.zh: “好了，”帕比做完后说道。“她会记得那些欢乐，却不会记得魔法。”

paras.en: “She won’t remember that I have powers?” Elsa asked.
paras.zh: “她不会记得我有魔法了？”艾莎问。

paras.en: “No,” Pabbie said.
paras.zh: “不会了。”帕比说。

paras.en: “It’s for the best,” the king told her.
paras.zh: “这样最好。”国王对她说道。

paras.en: “Listen to me, Elsa,” Pabbie said. “Your power will only grow. There is beauty in it, but also great danger.”
paras.zh: “听我说，艾莎，”帕比说。“你的力量只会越来越强。其中蕴含着美，也潜藏着巨大的危险。”

paras.en: As he spoke, the troll conjured up an image of an older Elsa in the sky. The image twirled gracefully, surrounded by beautiful snowflakes.
paras.zh: 说话间，山精在夜空中幻化出长大后的艾莎的身影。那身影优雅地旋转着，四周环绕着美丽的雪花。

paras.en: Then, amid the northern lights, the snowflakes turned into sharp spikes. The spectre of a crowd joined Elsa in the sky—the people used the icy spikes as weapons, attacking Elsa’s glowing effigy.
paras.zh: 接着，在北极光的映照下，雪花化作尖锐的冰刺。一群人的身影出现在空中的艾莎身旁——人们把冰刺当作武器，攻击着艾莎那发光的虚像。

paras.en: “You must learn to control your power,” Pabbie continued. “Fear will be your enemy.”
paras.zh: “你必须学会控制自己的力量，”帕比继续说道。“恐惧将会是你的敌人。”

paras.en: The king hugged Elsa close. “We’ll protect her,” he promised. “We’ll lock the gates. We’ll reduce the staff and keep her powers hidden from everyone…including Anna.”
paras.zh: 国王把艾莎紧紧搂进怀里。“我们会保护她，”他许诺道。“我们会锁上城门。我们会裁减侍从，把她的力量对所有人隐瞒……包括安娜。”

chapters.title: 第三章 · 紧闭的宫门

paras.en: Back at the castle, the king and queen immediately ordered that the castle gates be locked. All the doors were closed and the windows shuttered. They kept the girls secluded and no longer opened the castle to visitors. The family stayed hidden, tucked away inside their walled kingdom.
paras.zh: 回到城堡后，国王和王后立刻下令锁上城堡的大门。所有的门都关上了，窗户也用木板封死。他们让两个女孩与外界隔绝，不再向访客敞开城堡。一家人隐居在高墙环绕的王国深处，不与外间往来。

paras.en: The king and queen acted just as cautiously inside the castle. As the princesses grew, their parents did everything they could to ensure that Elsa learned to control herself. That meant the girls were hardly ever together. Nor did Elsa seek Anna out, since she was afraid she might accidentally hurt her. Day after day, Elsa spent most of her time training to be the next ruler—and learning to keep her powers in check.
paras.zh: 在城堡之内，国王和王后同样谨小慎微。随着两位公主渐渐长大，父母想尽一切办法，帮助艾莎学会控制自己。这意味着姐妹俩几乎从不在一起。艾莎也不去找安娜，因为她害怕自己会不小心伤到妹妹。日复一日，艾莎把大部分时间都花在历练上，为将来成为一国之君做准备——同时学着管束自己的力量。

paras.en: The training was difficult, and Elsa often felt unable to contain her magic. Ice seemed to form on her fingertips whenever she laughed or cried or became upset.
paras.zh: 这份修炼十分艰难，艾莎常常觉得自己遏制不住体内的魔法。无论她欢笑、落泪还是心烦意乱，指尖似乎都会凝结出冰霜。

paras.en: Worried, the king gave Elsa a pair of leather gloves. He advised her to keep them on at all times, and reminded her that she had to hide her icy magic in order to stay safe. “Conceal it,” he told her.
paras.zh: 国王忧心忡忡，给了艾莎一副皮手套。他叮嘱她时刻戴着手套，并提醒她：为了安全，必须把冰雪魔法藏起来。“把它藏起来，”他告诉她。

paras.en: “Don’t feel it,” she answered.
paras.zh: “别去感受它，”她应道。

paras.en: “Don’t let it show,” he agreed.
paras.zh: “别让它显露出来，”他附和道。

paras.en: The years slipped by. Anna spent most of her time alone. Sometimes she played with her dolls; sometimes she pretended to have conversations with painted portraits in the gallery. But she was lonely.
paras.zh: 岁月悄然流逝。安娜大部分时间都独自一人。有时她抱着玩偶玩耍，有时假装与画廊里那些画像交谈。可她心里孤单得很。

paras.en: Time after time, she knocked on Elsa’s door, pleading with her sister to come out and play. But Elsa never did. The memory of their friendship was slowly fading.
paras.zh: 她一次次敲响艾莎的房门，央求姐姐出来一起玩。但艾莎从未应允。姐妹间那份友谊的记忆，正一点点淡去。

paras.en: One day, Anna peered out her window and saw snow falling in the royal gardens. She raced down the hallway to her sister’s room. “Do you want to build a snowman?” she called through the closed door.
paras.zh: 一天，安娜从窗口望出去，看见王宫花园里飘起了雪。她沿走廊一路飞奔，来到姐姐的房门前。“你想不想堆雪人？”她隔着紧闭的房门喊道。

paras.en: There was no reply from inside. The door did not open. Eventually, Anna went out into the courtyard and tried to build a snowman by herself. After rolling out a lopsided ball, she glanced up at Elsa’s window and thought she saw someone smiling down at her. But when she looked again, the face was gone.
paras.zh: 门内没有回应。门始终没有打开。最后，安娜来到庭院里，试着独自堆一个雪人。滚出一个歪歪扭扭的雪球后，她抬头望向艾莎的窗户，恍惚看见有人正俯身朝她微笑。可再定睛一看，那张脸已经不见了。

paras.en: Without any memory of Elsa’s magic, Anna had no idea why she was always alone. Over time, she simply came to accept that her sister’s coldness was part of who she was. She didn’t know that Elsa was lonely too, and that she missed Anna as much as Anna missed her. Elsa longed to play with Anna but was fearful of the harm her magic might cause by mistake.
paras.zh: 安娜对艾莎的魔法毫无记忆，根本不明白自己为什么总是一个人。久而久之，她只得接受这个事实：姐姐的冷淡，本就是她的天性。她不知道的是，艾莎同样孤单，对安娜的思念一点也不比安娜少。艾莎渴望和安娜一起玩耍，却害怕魔法一个不慎就会伤到妹妹。

paras.en: “I’m scared,” Elsa told her father one day. “It’s getting stronger.”
paras.zh: “我好怕，”一天，艾莎对父亲说。“它越来越强了。”

paras.en: “Getting upset only makes it worse,” cautioned the king. “Calm down.” He reached out to give Elsa a hug.
paras.zh: “越慌张，它就越失控，”国王告诫道。“冷静下来。”他伸手想抱抱艾莎。

paras.en: “No,” she said sharply. “Don’t touch me.”
paras.zh: “别！”她厉声说。“别碰我。”

paras.en: One day years later, when the girls were teenagers, the king and queen boarded a ship, intending to visit another kingdom. They hugged their daughters goodbye and left them at home, as they had many times before. But this time, the king and queen never returned. A storm engulfed the ship, and they were lost at sea. The kingdom mourned their rulers.
paras.zh: 多年后的某一天，两个女孩已长成少女，国王和王后登上了一艘船，打算出访另一个王国。他们像过去许多次那样，拥别了女儿，把她们留在家中。可这一次，国王和王后再也没有回来。风暴吞没了那艘船，他们葬身大海。举国为他们的君王哀悼。

paras.en: Inside the castle, Anna felt overcome with grief. Not knowing where else to turn, she knocked again on Elsa’s door.
paras.zh: 城堡里，安娜悲痛得难以自持。不知还能向谁求助，她再次敲响了艾莎的房门。

paras.en: “Elsa? Are you okay? I’m right out here,” Anna said. But as always, there was no reply. She slid down and sadly rested her head against the door. “It’s just you and me now. What are we going to do?”
paras.zh: “艾莎？你还好吗？我就在门外，”安娜说。可一如往常，没有任何回应。她顺着门滑坐下去，忧伤地把头靠在门上。“现在只剩下你和我了。我们该怎么办？”

paras.en: Inside her room, Elsa felt awful, too. But she could not open the door. Instead, she sat with her back against the closed door, crying silently. All around her, ice and snow filled the room.
paras.zh: 门内的艾莎，同样心如刀绞。可她无法打开那扇门。她只是背靠着紧闭的房门坐下，无声地流泪。她的四周，冰雪渐渐盈满了整个房间。

paras.en: In time, the girls became young ladies. But they had grown apart, and Anna felt she barely knew Elsa anymore.
paras.zh: 时光流转，两个女孩都出落成了大姑娘。但她们早已日渐疏远，安娜觉得自己几乎不认识艾莎了。

paras.en: When Elsa turned twenty-one, it was time for her to be crowned the new Queen of Arendelle. The whole kingdom was bustling with excitement. For the first time in ages, and for one day only, the castle gates would be opened to the village and to all the surrounding kingdoms.
paras.zh: 艾莎年满二十一岁，加冕为阿伦黛尔新女王的日子到了。整个王国都沉浸在兴奋的忙碌之中。多年来头一遭，而且仅在加冕这一天，城堡大门将向阿伦黛尔村乃至周边所有王国敞开。

paras.en: It would be a celebration that Arendelle would never forget.
paras.zh: 那将是一场令阿伦黛尔永生难忘的庆典。

chapters.title: 第四章 · 加冕之晨

paras.en: On the morning of Elsa’s coronation, the heavy gates to the castle were finally opened. All of Arendelle wanted to celebrate the grand occasion. The streets in front of the castle were crowded with townspeople eager to see the new queen.
paras.zh: 艾莎加冕那天的清晨，城堡厚重的大门终于开启。整个阿伦黛尔都盼着庆祝这一盛典。城堡前的街道上挤满了百姓，人人都想一睹新女王的风采。

paras.en: To add to the excitement, the fjord was filled with ships from other kingdoms, bringing dignitaries from far away. One by one, important people stepped onto Arendelle’s docks.
paras.zh: 更添热闹的是，峡湾里停满了来自其他王国的船只，远道而来的贵宾纷纷抵岸。要人们逐一踏上阿伦黛尔的码头。

paras.en: “Welcome to our humble Arendelle,” the royal handler called to the visitors. One of the visiting dignitaries was the Duke of Weselton, a small man with white whiskers. Two huge guards followed close behind him, carrying his luggage.
paras.zh: “欢迎来到我们质朴的阿伦黛尔，”迎宾官向访客高声说道。来访的贵宾中有一位韦塞尔顿公爵，是个留着白色络腮胡的小个子男人。两名魁梧的侍卫紧随其后，替他搬运行李。

paras.en: “Ah, Arendelle, our most mysterious trade partner,” the Duke said breezily. “Open those gates so I may unlock your secrets and exploit your riches!”
paras.zh: “啊，阿伦黛尔，我们最神秘的贸易伙伴，”公爵轻快地说道。“快把大门打开，好让我揭开你们的秘密，榨取你们的财富！”

paras.en: In the distance, Kristoff was making his way down a mountain path. Now grown-up and strong, he and Sven had become true ice harvesters, masters at hauling ice blocks down the mountain. To Kristoff, the coronation was a perfect opportunity to sell ice to the crowds who filled Arendelle.
paras.zh: 远处，克里斯托夫正沿着山道往下走。如今他已长大成人、身强力壮，和斯文成了真正的采冰人，最擅长把冰块从山上运下来。在克里斯托夫看来，加冕礼正是向涌入阿伦黛尔的人潮售卖冰块的大好时机。

paras.en: “A coronation on a hot July day, you know what that means?” he asked Sven, who was harnessed to their rickety ice cart.
paras.zh: “七月酷暑里办加冕礼，你知道这意味着什么吗？”他问斯文。斯文正套着他们那辆摇摇晃晃的运冰车。

paras.en: The reindeer raised his eyebrows. Sven couldn’t talk, but that wasn’t a problem for Kristoff. He often spoke for Sven, changing his voice to sound deeper and more reindeer-y.
paras.zh: 驯鹿扬了扬眉毛。斯文不会说话，可这对克里斯托夫来说不算问题。他常常替斯文开口，故意压低嗓音，装出一副更“驯鹿”的腔调。

paras.en: “I sure do, Kristoff,” he declared, as Sven. “By noon I’m going to smell like a barrel of rabid skunks.”
paras.zh: “我当然知道，克里斯托夫，”他用斯文的声音宣布。“到中午，我就会臭得像一桶发狂的臭鼬。”

paras.en: “Yes, you will,” Kristoff said, talking normally again. He grinned. “But also, people will be needing ice. Lots of ice.” He pulled Sven’s rope, and the two continued down into the town.
paras.zh: “没错，你会的，”克里斯托夫换回平常的语调说。他咧嘴一笑。“而且啊，人们会需要冰块的。大量的冰块。”他拉了拉斯文的缰绳，一人一鹿继续往镇子里去。

paras.en: For Anna, the new people and the excitement were a dream come true. For the first time in years, every door in Arendelle was open. No one was shutting her out! She burst through the busy courtyard in front of the castle and practically skipped into town. People everywhere were getting ready for the coronation. She saw banners, a maypole, and flowers—all celebrating her sister, the new queen. There were dancing groups, musical bands, and food stalls. Everything looked so interesting.
paras.zh: 对安娜来说，这些新面孔与热闹景象简直是美梦成真。多年来头一回，阿伦黛尔的每一扇门都敞开着。再没有人把她关在门外了！她冲过城堡前熙攘的庭院，几乎是蹦跳着进了城。四处的人们都在为加冕礼做准备。她看见彩旗、五朔节花柱和鲜花——全都在为她姐姐、为新任女王庆祝。有舞蹈队，有乐队，还有各色小吃摊。一切都那么有趣。

paras.en: “I can’t wait to meet everyone!” Anna exclaimed out loud. Then she stopped short as a thought occurred to her. “What if I meet the one?” Anna knew she wasn’t likely to meet someone special, especially since the castle gates would be open for one day only, exactly twenty-four hours. Still, she couldn’t help daydreaming just a bit. Today might be her only chance to meet new friends, have new experiences, and maybe, just maybe, find love.
paras.zh: “我等不及要认识大家了！”安娜大声感叹。接着她猛地停住，一个念头掠过心头。“要是遇见了那个对的人呢？”安娜明白，自己遇见特别之人的机会微乎其微，何况城堡大门只开启一天，整整二十四小时，一分钟都不多。尽管如此，她还是忍不住稍稍做起了白日梦。今天也许是她唯一的机会——结识新朋友，体验新事物，也许，只是也许，还能觅得爱情。

paras.en: In her room upstairs in the castle, Elsa did not share the happiness that pulsed through the kingdom. She worried about controlling her powers, and hoped she could just get through the ceremony without anyone learning about her magic.
paras.zh: 而在城堡楼上的房间里，艾莎却无从分享这举国欢腾的喜悦。她忧心自己管不住力量，只盼能平安挨过典礼，不让任何人察觉她的魔法。

paras.en: As a test, she slipped off her gloves and picked up a candlestick and a little jar from the table. She concentrated, holding both with her bare hands. “Be the good girl,” Elsa whispered to herself. “Make one wrong move and everyone will know.…” She was nervous. As she stood there, ice formed on her palms and moved onto the objects, turning them to ice. She hurriedly dropped them and tugged her gloves back on, concealing her hands—and her icy magic.
paras.zh: 为了试一试，她摘下手套，从桌上拿起一座烛台和一个小罐。她凝神静气，用赤裸的双手捧着两样东西。“做个好女孩，”艾莎对自己低语。“只要走错一步，大家就都知道了……”她紧张极了。她站在那里，掌心凝出冰霜，慢慢蔓延到手中的物件上，把它们冻成了冰。她慌忙撒手放下，重新套回手套，藏起双手——也藏起那冰雪魔法。

paras.en: “It’s only for today,” Elsa reminded herself. After that, the gates would be closed again and she could go back into hiding.
paras.zh: “就今天一天，”艾莎提醒自己。过后大门就会再度紧闭，她便能重新躲回自己的隐秘世界。

chapters.title: 第五章 · 海港的遐想

paras.en: In the streets below, Anna was strolling dreamily around the harbor, watching the ships and imagining all the fun the coronation party would bring. For once, it wouldn’t matter that Elsa didn’t want to spend time with her, because she’d be spending time with everyone else!
paras.zh: 楼下的街道上，安娜正梦游般地在海港边闲逛，望着来往的船只，想象着加冕庆典会带来多少欢乐。这一次，艾莎不愿陪她总算是不要紧了，因为她要和大家一起欢庆呢！

paras.en: Anna rounded a corner and suddenly–smack!–a horse bumped into her!
paras.zh: 安娜转过一个街角，忽然——砰！一匹马撞上了她！

paras.en: Caught by surprise, Anna lost her balance and stumbled, falling into a small rowboat on the dock. The boat tipped precariously toward the water. Luckily, the horse came forward and placed its hoof on the end of the boat to keep it from sliding into the harbor.
paras.zh: 安娜猝不及防，失去了平衡，踉跄着跌进码头边的一艘小划艇里。小艇摇摇晃晃地朝水面倾斜过去。幸好那匹马上前一步，把蹄子踩在小艇末端，不让它滑进海港。

paras.en: “Hey!” Anna exclaimed in surprise, looking up at the horse and its rider.
paras.zh: “嘿！”安娜又惊又喜，抬头望着那匹马和马上的人。

paras.en: “I’m so sorry,” the rider said. “Are you hurt?”
paras.zh: “实在抱歉，”骑马的人说。“你没受伤吧？”

paras.en: Anna tried to regain her composure. “Hey, uh… No, I’m okay,” she managed to say. She couldn’t help noticing that the rider was very handsome.
paras.zh: 安娜努力镇定下来。“嘿，呃……没有，我没事，“她好不容易才说出话来。她忍不住注意到，这位骑手英俊非凡。

paras.en: “Are you sure?” the young man asked. He hopped off his horse. He was tall and sharply dressed in a fancy uniform. He looked very concerned about her welfare.
paras.zh: “真的没事？”年轻人问。他翻身下了马。他身材高大，一身华丽的制服穿得笔挺。他看上去对她的安危关切极了。

paras.en: “Yeah, I just wasn’t looking where I was going,” Anna said. She smiled. “But I’m great, actually.”
paras.zh: “是啊，我刚才光顾着走神，没看路，”安娜说。她笑了。“不过说真的，我好得很。”

paras.en: “Oh, thank goodness,” the stranger said, smiling. He stepped into the little boat and extended his hand to Anna. When their eyes met, a happy charge of excitement passed between them.
paras.zh: “哦，那就好，”陌生人微笑着说。他踏进小艇，向安娜伸出手。四目相对的那一刻，一股甜蜜的悸动在两人之间流过。

paras.en: The young man smiled. “Prince Hans of the Southern Isles,” he said, introducing himself.
paras.zh: 年轻人微微一笑。“南艾尔斯的汉斯王子，”他自我介绍道。

paras.en: Anna stood up and curtsied. “Princess Anna of Arendelle,” she replied.
paras.zh: 安娜站起身，行了个屈膝礼。“阿伦黛尔的安娜公主，”她答道。

paras.en: “Princess?” he responded, horrified. “My lady!” He dropped to one knee and bowed his head.
paras.zh: “公主？”他惊呼。“拜见殿下！”他单膝跪下，低头行礼。

paras.en: His horse also dropped to one knee. Immediately, the little boat tipped backward, and Hans tumbled on top of Anna. They both giggled awkwardly.
paras.zh: 他的马也单膝跪了下来。这一下，小艇立刻向后翘起，汉斯整个人摔在了安娜身上。两人尴尬地咯咯笑了起来。

paras.en: “Hi again,” Anna said. The prince’s face was just inches from hers.
paras.zh: “又见面了，”安娜说。王子的脸离她只有几寸远。

paras.en: Apparently realizing his mistake, the horse slammed its hoof back down on the boat. Anna and Hans fell the opposite way. This time, Anna landed on top of Hans!
paras.zh: 那匹马显然意识到了自己的失误，猛地把蹄子重新踩回艇上。安娜和汉斯朝相反的方向倒了过去。这一次，换作安娜压在了汉斯身上！

paras.en: “Oh, boy,” Hans said, embarrassed.
paras.zh: “哎呀，”汉斯窘迫地说。

paras.en: “Ha! This is awkward,” Anna said, acknowledging their positions. “Not that you’re awkward,” she said, trying to cover her embarrassment. “But just because we’re…I’m awkward!” she said. “You’re gorgeous.” Her hand flew to her mouth. Had she just said that out loud? “Wait, what?”
paras.zh: “哈！这也太尴尬了，“安娜说，也意识到两人此刻的姿势。“我不是说你尴尬，”她说道，想掩饰自己的窘态。“只是因为我们……是我自己尴尬啦！”她说。“你真好看。”她的手猛地捂住了嘴。她刚才那句话，是说出口了吗？“等等，我刚才说了什么？”

paras.en: Hans jumped to his feet, quickly regaining a royal posture. “I’d like to formally apologize for hitting the Princess of Arendelle with my horse. And for every moment after,” he added.
paras.zh: 汉斯一跃而起，迅速恢复了王子应有的仪态。“我为我骑马撞倒了阿伦黛尔公主一事，郑重道歉。也为之后发生的每一件事，“他补充道。

paras.en: “No, no,” Anna said. “It’s fine. I’m not that princess. I mean, if you’d hit my sister, Elsa, this would be…” She paused for a moment. “Yeesh! Because, you know…” Anna patted the horse, trying to recover her rambling thoughts. “Hello,” she said to the horse. She turned back to Hans and offered him a princess grin. “But lucky for you, it’s just me.”
paras.zh: “不不，”安娜说。“没关系的。我算不上什么公主。我是说，要是你撞的是我姐姐艾莎，那可就……“她顿了片刻。“乖乖！因为，你懂的……“安娜拍了拍那匹马，努力理清自己乱成一团的思绪。“你好呀，”她对马说。她转回身，朝汉斯露出一个公主式的笑容。“不过你运气好，撞到的只是我。”

paras.en: “Just you?” Hans asked. A warm smile spread across his face.
paras.zh: “只是你？”汉斯问。温暖的笑容在他脸上漾开。

paras.en: Anna couldn’t help smiling back. All of sudden, the castle bells began to peal.
paras.zh: 安娜忍不住回以微笑。忽然，城堡的钟声敲响了。

paras.en: “The bells!” she cried. “The coronation—I’d better go,” she said. She hopped off the boat onto the pier and waved. “Uh, bye!”
paras.zh: “钟响了！”她喊道。“加冕典礼——我得走了，”她说。她跳下小艇踏上码头，挥手作别。“呃，再见！”

paras.en: Hans waved back. Even the horse waved, lifting his hoof off the boat for a moment. Unfortunately, that caused the boat’s weight to shift again.
paras.zh: 汉斯也挥手道别。连那匹马也跟着“挥手”，把蹄子从艇上抬起来了一下。不巧的是，小艇的重心又偏了。

paras.en: “Oh, no!” Hans said.
paras.zh: “哦，不好！”汉斯说。

paras.en: The boat flipped off the dock and Hans fell into the water with a splash! Lifting the boat off his head, Hans peeked up from the water and watched Anna run through the streets toward the castle. He grinned as he thought about his wonderful chance meeting with the beautiful princess.
paras.zh: 小艇翻出了码头，汉斯扑通一声栽进水里！汉斯把扣在头上的小艇掀开，从水里探出头来，望着安娜穿过街道朝城堡飞奔而去。想着与这位美丽公主的美妙偶遇，他咧嘴笑了。

paras.en: Soon the people of Arendelle, along with dignitaries from around the land, were making their way into the royal church for Elsa’s coronation. Kristoff, however, was far away, in a corner of the town. He had sold all his ice and was now busy bargaining for a brand-new sled.
paras.zh: 不久，阿伦黛尔的民众连同各地的显贵，纷纷走进王室教堂，参加艾莎的加冕典礼。而克里斯托夫却在镇子另一头的角落里。他已经卖光了所有的冰，正忙着为一辆崭新的雪橇讨价还价。

paras.en: “Watch this, Sven,” Kristoff called as he played around with the sled’s special features, which allowed it to switch between runners and wheels. “It’s a sled! It’s a wagon! It’s a sled! It’s a wagon!”
paras.zh: “看好了，斯文，”克里斯托夫一边摆弄雪橇的特殊装置——它能在滑橇与轮子之间切换——一边喊道。“这是雪橇！是四轮车！是雪橇！是四轮车！“

paras.en: The sled salesman looked concerned, as if he was wondering what kind of person would talk to a reindeer. But he wanted to finish the sale. He tried to make small talk as they completed their deal. “You sticking around to see the queen and the princess?” he asked Kristoff.
paras.zh: 卖雪橇的商人一脸困惑，仿佛在琢磨什么样的人会对着驯鹿说话。但他还是想做成这笔买卖。成交的时候，他试着搭话闲聊。“你留下来看看女王和公主吗？”他问克里斯托夫。

paras.en: “Are you kidding?” Kristoff replied. “I’ve got a brand-new sled…with wheels!” He grinned. “I’m hitting the road.”
paras.zh: “开什么玩笑？”克里斯托夫答道。“我有了全新的雪橇……还带轮子！”他咧嘴一笑。“我这就上路。”

paras.en: “Suit yourself,” the man said. “But I bet they’re beautiful.”
paras.zh: “随你便，”那人说。“不过我敢说，她们俩一定美极了。”

paras.en: Kristoff didn’t even hear the man. He and Sven were already headed back to the mountains with their new sled.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫根本没听进去。他和斯文已经带着新雪橇动身回山里去了。

chapters.title: 第六章 · 加冕典礼

paras.en: The cathedral was packed with people as the coronation ceremony began. An orchestra played and a choir sang while the royal procession walked down the very long center aisle. The bishop led the way, followed by Elsa, looking regal and serious, and finally Anna, holding the train of Elsa’s dress.
paras.zh: 加冕典礼开始时，大教堂里挤满了人。管弦乐队奏响乐曲，唱诗班放声吟唱，王室仪仗沿着漫长的中央通道缓缓前行。主教走在最前面，身后是神情庄重威仪的艾莎，最后是替姐姐提着裙裾的安娜。

paras.en: At the altar, Elsa and Anna faced the bishop. Near him lay a silver platter holding the royal crown, scepter, and orb.
paras.zh: 在圣坛前，艾莎和安娜面向主教。主教身旁的银盘上，安放着王冠、权杖和宝球。

paras.en: Peeking over her shoulder, Anna spotted the handsome Prince Hans. He sat straight and tall, and a stranger was asleep on his shoulder! Hans waved at Anna, who giggled.
paras.zh: 安娜回头一瞥，瞧见了英俊的汉斯王子。他坐得笔直挺拔，肩上竟靠着一位睡熟了的陌生人！汉斯朝安娜挥挥手，安娜咯咯笑了起来。

paras.en: The bishop placed the crown on Elsa’s head. Then he turned for the scepter and orb and presented them to Elsa. She reached for the royal items, but the bishop cleared his throat. “Ahem. Your gloves, Your Majesty.”
paras.zh: 主教把王冠戴在艾莎头上。接着他转身取过权杖和宝球，呈到艾莎面前。她伸手去接，主教却清了清嗓子。“咳咳。请摘下手套，陛下。”

paras.en: Elsa took a sharp breath. If she took the gloves off, she might accidentally let out her icy magic. She hesitated, growing pale with worry.
paras.zh: 艾莎倒吸一口凉气。一旦摘下手套，她可能会不小心释放出冰雪魔法。她迟疑着，担心得脸色发白。

paras.en: Anna took that moment to look over at Hans and smile at him. She couldn’t wait to talk to him at the ball!
paras.zh: 安娜趁这个当口望向汉斯，对他嫣然一笑。她等不及要在舞会上和他说话了！

paras.en: Elsa slowly removed her gloves and placed them on the satin pillow. With a deep breath, she took the orb and scepter into her hands. She turned to face the crowd.
paras.zh: 艾莎缓缓摘下手套，放在缎面软垫上。她深吸一口气，把宝球和权杖握进手中。她转身面向众人。

paras.en: “As the undoubted queen, protector of this dominion,” the bishop intoned, “keeper of the doctrine and government thereof from this day forward, I present to you Her Majesty…”
paras.zh: “作为无可争议的女王、这片疆土的保护者，”主教庄严宣告，“自今日起，教义与国政的守护者，我向诸位呈献……”

paras.en: Elsa’s eyes widened as the scepter and orb began to freeze in her hands! She tried desperately to control her emotions. She was just so nervous!
paras.zh: 艾莎的眼睛一下子睁大——权杖和宝球竟在她手中开始结冰！她拼命想要控制住自己的情绪。她实在紧张极了！

paras.en: “…Queen Elsa of Arendelle!” The bishop finished his decree.
paras.zh: “……阿伦黛尔的艾莎女王！”主教念完了宣告。

paras.en: The people in the church rose. “Queen Elsa of Arendelle!” they echoed.
paras.zh: 教堂里的人们纷纷起身。“阿伦黛尔的艾莎女王！”众人齐声呼应。

paras.en: Elsa quickly placed the orb and scepter back on the silver tray and grabbed her gloves. With a sigh of relief, she realized that no one had seen the ice on the orb or the scepter. She smiled at the cheering crowd. She had made it through the ceremony!
paras.zh: 艾莎赶紧把宝球和权杖放回银盘，抓起自己的手套。她松了一口气——还好，没有人看见宝球和权杖上的冰。她朝着欢呼的人群微笑。她总算熬过了典礼！

paras.en: Later, at the coronation ball, Elsa and Anna stood side by side in a long receiving line at the entrance to the Great Hall. Elsa felt relaxed, almost content, now that the most difficult part of Coronation Day was over. Festive music filled the air as guests danced across the floor of the lavishly decorated ballroom.
paras.zh: 稍后，在加冕舞会上，艾莎和安娜并肩站在大厅入口处长长的迎宾队列里。加冕日最艰难的一关已经过去，艾莎感到放松下来，几乎有几分满足。欢庆的乐声弥漫空中，宾客们在装点得富丽堂皇的舞厅里翩翩起舞。

paras.en: “You look beautiful,” Elsa said to Anna.
paras.zh: “你真美，”艾莎对安娜说。

paras.en: “Thank you,” Anna said in surprise. A smile spread across her face. Her sister had actually spoken to her! “You look beautiful-er,” Anna replied. Then she realized how strange that had sounded and blurted out an explanation. “Not that you’re fuller. No. Just more beautiful!”
paras.zh: “谢谢，”安娜有些意外。笑容在她脸上漾开。姐姐居然主动跟她说话了！“你更美，”安娜答道。随即她意识到这话听起来有多古怪，慌忙解释起来。“我不是说你更丰满。不，只是更漂亮！”

paras.en: Elsa grinned. “Thank you.” Then she looked out at the crowded ballroom. “So this is what a party looks like?”
paras.zh: 艾莎笑了。“谢谢。”然后她望向宾客云集的舞厅。“原来舞会就是这个样子？”

paras.en: Anna nodded. “It’s warmer than I thought.”
paras.zh: 安娜点点头。“比我想象的暖和呢。”

paras.en: “All the people, I guess,” Elsa said. “And what is that amazing smell?”
paras.zh: “大概是人多吧，”艾莎说。“还有，那股好闻的香味是什么？”

paras.en: Both of them caught a whiff of a sweet aroma wafting across the room. “Chocolate!” they exclaimed at the same time. Then they looked at each other and started laughing.
paras.zh: 一缕甜香正从大厅那头飘过来，两人都闻到了。“巧克力！”两人异口同声。说完她们相视一眼，笑了起来。

paras.en: Anna could hardly believe that Elsa was treating her so kindly. She was about to say more to her sister, but just then, a guest stepped up to be presented to the new queen and the princess. “The Duke of Weaseltown,” a royal attendant announced.
paras.zh: 安娜几乎不敢相信，艾莎对她这么亲切。她正想和姐姐多聊几句，恰好这时，一位宾客走上前来，被引荐给新女王和公主。“黄鼠狼镇公爵到——”王室侍从高声唱名。

paras.en: “Weselton,” the Duke corrected him. Then he bowed his head. “As your closest partner in trade, it seems only fitting that I offer you your first dance as queen.”
paras.zh: “是韦塞尔顿，”公爵纠正道。说罢他低下头。“作为您最亲密的贸易伙伴，由我来邀您跳女王生涯的第一支舞，再合适不过了。”

paras.en: Elsa stiffened and clasped her gloved hands together. “Thank you,” she said. “But I don’t dance.”
paras.zh: 艾莎身子一僵，把戴着手套的双手紧紧交握在一起。“谢谢，”她说。“可我不会跳舞。”

paras.en: The Duke looked offended, so Elsa quickly nudged Anna forward. “But my sister is a marvelous dancer.”
paras.zh: 公爵面露不悦，艾莎连忙把安娜推上前去。“不过我妹妹的舞跳得棒极了。”

paras.en: Anna was a little startled, but she allowed the Duke to lead her to the dance floor.
paras.zh: 安娜吃了一惊，但还是随着公爵走向了舞池。

paras.en: Unfortunately, the Duke was a horrible dancer. He couldn’t seem to take one step without crushing Anna’s toes. As he bobbed up and down, his toupee bounced back and forth on his head—and he never stopped talking.
paras.zh: 不巧的是，公爵的舞姿糟透了。他似乎每迈一步都要踩到安娜的脚趾。他上蹿下跳时，头顶的假发前后乱晃——嘴上也一刻没停。

paras.en: “Bump-be-dump-bah! Look at me!” he crowed. “This certainly makes up for being shut out for twelve years for no reason. Do you know the reason?” he asked Anna. “No? Well, watch this: like a chicken with the face of a monkey, I fly!”
paras.zh: “蹦跶蹦跶哒！看我！”他得意地叫道。“被人无缘无故关在门外十二年，这下总算补偿回来了。你知道是什么原因吗？”他问安娜。“不知道？那看好啦：像只长着猴脸的鸡，我飞！”

paras.en: Anna cringed as the Duke danced around her like a dying peacock. Then she caught sight of Elsa watching from the side of the room, barely able to keep from laughing. Anna shot Elsa a number of “help me” looks, but there was no way out of it. She was forced to finish the dance, much to Elsa’s amusement.
paras.zh: 公爵像一只垂死的孔雀，围着安娜乱舞，安娜直皱眉头。这时她瞥见艾莎在大厅一角看着，正强忍着不笑出声。安娜朝艾莎投去一连串“救命”的眼神，却根本脱不了身。她只得跳完整支舞，而艾莎在一旁乐不可支。

paras.en: After the dance, Anna limped back to Elsa. “Well, he was sprightly,” said the queen with a smile.
paras.zh: 舞毕，安娜一瘸一拐地回到艾莎身边。“嗯，他还挺精神，”女王微笑着说。

paras.en: “Especially for a man in heels!” Anna replied. Both sisters giggled.
paras.zh: “尤其对一个穿高跟鞋的男人来说！”安娜答道。姐妹俩都咯咯笑了起来。

paras.en: “Are you all right?” Elsa asked more gently.
paras.zh: “你还好吧？”艾莎的语气柔和下来。

paras.en: Anna smiled. “I’ve never been better,” she said, glancing into Elsa’s eyes. “This is so nice. I wish it could be like this all the time.”
paras.zh: 安娜笑了。“我从没这么好过，”她望着艾莎的眼睛说。“这真好。真希望一直都能这样。”

paras.en: “Me too,” Elsa said wistfully. Then she caught herself and stiffened. “But it can’t.”
paras.zh: “我也是，”艾莎怅然地说。随即她猛然回过神，身子一僵。“可这是不可能的。”

paras.en: “Why not?” Anna asked, surprised at Elsa’s sudden change of attitude.
paras.zh: “为什么？”安娜问，对艾莎态度的突变感到意外。

paras.en: Elsa tensed. “Because it can’t,” she said firmly.
paras.zh: 艾莎绷紧了全身。“就是不可能，”她斩钉截铁地说。

paras.en: Anna’s felt all her old disappointment rushing back. “Excuse me,” she said. Elsa watched sadly as Anna walked away.
paras.zh: 安娜只觉得往日的失望一齐涌上心头。“失陪，”她说。艾莎望着安娜走远的背影，满心伤感。

chapters.title: 第七章 · 翩然相遇

paras.en: Anna pushed through the crowd of guests, and one of the dancers tripped into her, knocking her backward. Someone grabbed her by the arms before she hit the floor.
paras.zh: 安娜从宾客人群中挤过去，一个跳舞的人绊到了她，把她撞得向后一个趔趄。摔倒之前，有人一把扶住了她的手臂。

paras.en: “Glad I caught you,” Hans said, smiling.
paras.zh: “幸好接住了你，”汉斯微笑着说。

paras.en: “Hans!” she said, surprised.
paras.zh: “汉斯！”她又惊又喜。

paras.en: Hans lifted Anna back to her feet, and the two immediately were drawn into the dance. Hans was an excellent dancer, and Anna was happy to let him guide her around the ballroom, twirling her at just the right moments. She was amazed at how natural it felt.
paras.zh: 汉斯把安娜扶起身，两人立刻随着音乐舞了起来。汉斯舞技高超，安娜乐于让他带着自己在舞厅里旋转起舞，每个转身的时机都恰到好处。她惊讶地发觉，这一切竟如此自然。

paras.en: After that, she and Hans walked and laughed and danced some more. One hour turned into many hours of them talking and enjoying each other’s company.
paras.zh: 之后，他们边走边笑，又跳了几支舞。一个小时接着一个小时，两人聊个不停，相处得格外愉快。

paras.en: Finally, they took a break and strolled into the rose garden. Hans plucked a rose and placed it in Anna’s hair. As he did, he noticed the white streak running down the side of her head. “What’s this?”
paras.zh: 终于，他们歇了口气，漫步走进玫瑰园。汉斯摘下一朵玫瑰，别在安娜的发间。就在这时，他注意到她鬓边垂着一缕白发。“这是什么？”

paras.en: Anna put her hand to her hair. “I was born with it,” she told him. “Although I dreamt I was kissed by a troll.”
paras.zh: 安娜抬手摸了摸头发。“我生来就有，”她告诉他。“虽然我梦见自己是被山精亲了一口。”

paras.en: “I like it,” Hans said.
paras.zh: “我喜欢，”汉斯说。

paras.en: On the balcony, they sat on a bench and Anna taught Hans how to eat a krumkake. “Just bite it. The whole thing!” she said. The pair laughed as the treat crumbled all over Hans’s face.
paras.zh: 在阳台上，他们并肩坐在长椅上，安娜教汉斯怎么吃脆饼。“直接咬。一整口！”她说。点心碎屑落了汉斯一脸，两人笑作一团。

paras.en: Hans told Anna about his family. “I have twelve older brothers,” he said. “Three of them pretended I was invisible…for two years.”
paras.zh: 汉斯给安娜讲起自己的家人。“我有十二个哥哥，”他说。“其中三个假装我是透明的……一装就是两年。”

paras.en: “That’s horrible,” Anna said.
paras.zh: “太过分了，”安娜说。

paras.en: “It’s what brothers do,” he replied with a shrug.
paras.zh: “兄弟们不都这样嘛，”他耸耸肩答道。

paras.en: Anna smiled knowingly. “And sisters,” she added. “Elsa and I were really close when we were little. But then one day she just shut me out, and I never knew why.”
paras.zh: 安娜会心一笑。“姐妹也是，”她补充道。“小时候我和艾莎可要好啦。可后来有一天，她忽然就把我关在了门外，我始终不明白为什么。”

paras.en: “I would never shut you out,” Hans said, gazing into Anna’s eyes.
paras.zh: “我绝不会把你关在门外，”汉斯凝视着安娜的眼睛说。

paras.en: Anna beamed. “Okay, can I just say something crazy?” she asked.
paras.zh: 安娜眉开眼笑。“好，我能说句疯话吗？”她问。

paras.en: “I love crazy,” Hans said with a wide grin.
paras.zh: “我最爱疯话了，”汉斯咧嘴大笑。

paras.en: “All my life has been a series of doors in my face,” she said. “Then suddenly, I bump into you!” Anna explained that she felt like she’d been waiting her whole life to meet him. And Hans agreed. He felt the same way! Anna couldn’t believe her good fortune. At last, here was someone who understood her. Someone who was open to new experiences and people, exactly the way she was. Hans was sweet, kind, and fun. They spent the rest of the party together, dancing, laughing, and discussing their pasts—and their futures, too.
paras.zh: “我这一辈子，一扇扇门总当着我的面关上，”她说。“然后忽然之间，我就撞上了你！”安娜说，她觉得自己仿佛等了一辈子，就为了遇见他。汉斯也深有同感。他正是同样的感觉！安娜不敢相信自己有这样的好运。终于，有一个人懂她了。一个和她一样，乐于拥抱新事物、新朋友的人。汉斯温柔、善良，又风趣。舞会余下的时光他们都腻在一起，跳舞、欢笑，聊着各自的过去——也聊着未来。

paras.en: “Can I say something crazy?” Hans asked suddenly. “Will you marry me?”
paras.zh: “能让我说句疯话吗？”汉斯忽然问道。“你愿意嫁给我吗？”

paras.en: Anna gasped. “Can I just—ooh. I mean, yes!” She was amazed that she and Hans had found each other. She just knew that they were meant to be.
paras.zh: 安娜倒抽一口气。“等等，我——噢。我是说，愿意！”她惊叹于自己竟能与汉斯相遇相知。她就是知道，他们俩是命中注定的一对。

paras.en: “Elsa!” Anna called from across the ballroom. She pulled Hans toward her sister. “May I present Prince Hans of the Southern Isles,” she said formally.
paras.zh: “艾莎！”安娜隔着舞厅喊道。她拉着汉斯来到姐姐面前。“请允许我引荐南艾尔斯的汉斯王子，”她一本正经地说。

paras.en: “Your Majesty.” Hans greeted the queen with a deep bow.
paras.zh: “陛下。”汉斯向女王深深鞠躬致意。

paras.en: Anna was beaming. “We would like—”
paras.zh: 安娜满面春风。“我们想要——”

paras.en: “—your blessing—” Hans continued.
paras.zh: “——您的祝福——”汉斯接着说。

paras.en: “—of our marriage!” Anna finished breathlessly.
paras.zh: “——为我们的婚事！”安娜气喘吁吁地收了尾。

paras.en: “Marriage?” Elsa asked. “I’m confused.”
paras.zh: “结婚？”艾莎问。“我糊涂了。”

paras.en: “Well, we haven’t worked out all the details,” Anna said. “We’ll need a few days to plan the ceremony. Of course, we’ll have soup, roast, and ice cream…” Anna turned to Hans. “Would we live here?”
paras.zh: “嗯，细节还没全定下来，”安娜说。“我们还需要几天筹备典礼。当然，会有汤、烤肉，还有冰淇淋……”安娜转向汉斯。“我们就住在这儿吗？”

paras.en: “Here?” Elsa asked.
paras.zh: “这儿？”艾莎问。

paras.en: “Absolutely!” Hans cried.
paras.zh: “当然！”汉斯大声说。

paras.en: “What? No,” Elsa said.
paras.zh: “什么？不行，”艾莎说。

paras.en: “And we’ll invite all twelve of your brothers to stay here with us, and—” Anna stopped as Elsa put up her hand.
paras.zh: “我们还要请你那十二个哥哥都搬来和我们同住，还有——”安娜在艾莎抬手时住了口。

paras.en: “Wait,” she said. “Slow down. Anna, no one’s brothers are staying here. No one is getting married.”
paras.zh: “等等，”她说。“慢一点。安娜，谁家的兄弟也不会住到这里来。也没有人要结婚。”

paras.en: Anna’s mouth dropped open. “Wait, what?”
paras.zh: 安娜目瞪口呆。“等等，什么？”

paras.en: “I need to talk to you,” Elsa said sternly. “Alone.”
paras.zh: “我得和你谈谈，”艾莎语气严厉地说。“单独谈。”

paras.en: Anna linked her arm with Hans’s. “No,” she said. “Whatever you have to say, you can say to both of us.”
paras.zh: 安娜挽住汉斯的胳膊。“不行，”她说。“你有什么话，就当着我们两个人的面说。”

paras.en: Elsa shook her head. “No.… You can’t marry a man you just met.”
paras.zh: 艾莎摇了摇头。“不……你不能嫁给一个刚认识的人。”

paras.en: Standing straighter, Anna spoke up. “You can if it’s true love.”
paras.zh: 安娜挺直了身子，大声说：“如果是真爱，就可以。”

paras.en: “What do you know about true love?” Elsa replied, scoffing at her sister’s naiveté.
paras.zh: “你懂什么是真爱？”艾莎反问道，嗤笑妹妹的天真。

paras.en: “More than you,” Anna replied. “All you want is to be alone.”
paras.zh: “比你懂，”安娜答道。“你只想一个人躲起来。”

paras.en: Elsa took a deep breath. “You asked for my blessing, but my answer is no. Now, if you’ll excuse me,” she said, and started to move away.
paras.zh: 艾莎深吸一口气。“你们要我祝福，可我的答案是不。现在，恕我失陪，”她说着便要离开。

paras.en: “Your Majesty,” Hans said. “If I may—”
paras.zh: “陛下，”汉斯说。“请容我——”

paras.en: “No, you may not,” Elsa snapped. “And I think you should go.” She walked off and signaled to one of the guards. “The party is over. It’s time to close the gates.”
paras.zh: “不，不必，”艾莎厉声道。“我看你还是走吧。”她转身走开，朝一名卫兵使了个眼色。“宴会结束了。该关大门了。”

paras.en: Anna ran after her. “Elsa! No!” She reached for her sister and grabbed her hand. As she tugged at her to stay, Elsa’s glove slipped off.
paras.zh: 安娜追了上去。“艾莎！别走！”她伸手去拉姐姐，一把抓住了她的手。她用力想拽住姐姐，艾莎的手套却滑落了下来。

paras.en: “Give me my glove!” Elsa exclaimed.
paras.zh: “把手套还给我！”艾莎喊道。

paras.en: Anna held the glove up and away from Elsa. “No, listen to me,” she said, “I can’t live like this anymore!”
paras.zh: 安娜把手套举得高高的，不肯还给艾莎。“不，你听我说，”她说，“这样的日子我再也无法忍受了！”

paras.en: Elsa fought to gain control. “Then leave,” she finally said. She saw the hurt on Anna’s face. She turned to flee from the room.
paras.zh: 艾莎竭力克制着自己。“那你走，”她终于说道。她看见了安娜脸上的伤痛。她转身想要逃离大厅。

paras.en: “What did I ever do to you?” Anna cried.
paras.zh: “我到底做过什么对不起你的事？”安娜哭喊道。

paras.en: “Enough, Anna!” Elsa ordered.
paras.zh: “够了，安娜！”艾莎喝道。

paras.en: “Why do you shut me out?” Anna asked. “Why do you shut the world out? What are you so afraid of?”
paras.zh: “你为什么把我关在门外？”安娜质问道。“你为什么把全世界都拒之门外？你到底在怕什么？”

paras.en: “I said enough!” Elsa shouted, spinning around. As she did, ice shot from her bare hand, coating the floor of the ballroom and frothing up into icy plumes.
paras.zh: “我说够了！”艾莎猛地转过身大喊。就在这时，冰霜从她裸露的手中迸出，铺满了舞厅的地板，又翻涌起一道道冰浪。

paras.en: The music stopped abruptly and everyone turned to stare at Elsa in shock. She stared at her subjects, wishing with all her heart that she could take the magic back.
paras.zh: 音乐戛然而止，所有人都惊愕地转头盯着艾莎。她望着她的臣民，满心盼望能把这魔法收回去。

paras.en: But it was too late. Sheets of ice covered the dance floor. The Great Hall fell into a chilly silence.
paras.zh: 可惜已经太迟了。整片舞池都覆上了冰层。大厅陷入一片刺骨的寂静。

paras.en: The Duke gasped. “Sorcery! I knew there was something going on here.”
paras.zh: 公爵倒抽一口凉气。“妖术！我就知道这里头有事。”

paras.en: “Elsa?” Anna called, but Elsa was already pushing through the doors and racing out of the room.
paras.zh: “艾莎？”安娜喊道，可艾莎已经推门而出，飞奔出了大厅。

chapters.title: 第八章 · 秘密泄露

paras.en: Elsa burst into the courtyard. She was so afraid now that her secret was out. She hoped she hadn’t hurt anyone. Regardless, everyone in Arendelle would soon know about her magic.
paras.zh: 艾莎冲进了庭院。秘密已经泄露出去，她此刻害怕极了。她只希望自己没有伤到任何人。可无论如何，阿伦黛尔的所有人很快都会知道她的魔法了。

paras.en: “There she is!” cried a townswoman, excited to get a glimpse of the newly crowned queen. The woman obviously had no idea what had just happened in the ballroom. “Your Majesty! Long live the queen! Queen Elsa!”
paras.zh: “她在那儿！”一位镇上的妇人喊道，兴奋地想一睹这位新加冕女王的风采。这妇人显然还不知道舞厅里刚刚发生的一切。“陛下！女王万岁！艾莎女王！”

paras.en: Elsa backed away from the woman and quickly weaved through the crowd, trying hard not to touch anyone as she backed away. She didn’t want to cause any harm with her powers. She just wanted to leave the kingdom and hide!
paras.zh: 艾莎从那妇人身边退开，匆匆在人群中穿行，一边后退一边极力避免碰到任何人。她不想用自己的力量伤到任何人。她只想离开这个王国，躲起来！

paras.en: A young woman with a small child in her arms called to her. “Your Majesty, are you all right?” she asked, full of concern.
paras.zh: 一位怀里抱着小孩的年轻女子朝她喊道。“陛下，您还好吗？”她满怀关切地问。

paras.en: Elsa put her hands behind her and moved away. She slowly walked backward, accidentally bumping into the fountain in the center of the courtyard. As soon as she touched the fountain, the water in it froze to solid ice.
paras.zh: 艾莎把双手背到身后，退开了。她缓缓向后退去，不小心撞上了庭院中央的喷泉。她的手一碰到喷泉，里面的水便冻成了坚冰。

paras.en: There was a loud gasp from the villagers. People turned and ran away from Elsa.
paras.zh: 人群中响起一片惊呼。人们转身从艾莎身边逃开。

paras.en: The Duke and his guards ran down the castle steps. “There she is!” he shouted, leading the charge toward Elsa. “Get her!”
paras.zh: 韦斯文顿公爵和他的卫兵冲下城堡台阶。“她在那儿！”他高喊着，带头朝艾莎冲去。“抓住她！”

paras.en: “Just stay away from me! Stay away!” Elsa cried. She held her hands up, causing the castle steps to ice over. The Duke’s guards slipped and tumbled down to the ground.
paras.zh: “离我远点！离我远点！”艾莎哭喊道。她高高举起双手，城堡的台阶顿时结满了冰。公爵的卫兵脚下一滑，跌跌撞撞地摔在地上。

paras.en: “Monster!” the Duke hissed.
paras.zh: “怪物！”公爵咬牙切齿地说。

paras.en: The crowd panicked. A swirl of cold air traveled through Arendelle as Elsa ran along the streets, leaving ice and snow in her wake.
paras.zh: 人群慌乱起来。一股寒风席卷着阿伦黛尔的街道，艾莎一路奔跑，身后留下了冰与雪。

paras.en: Anna watched from the castle gates. “Elsa!” she called. “Wait, please!” She rushed from the castle and ran after Elsa. Hans trailed behind her. “Elsa!” Anna cried desperately.
paras.zh: 安娜从城堡大门望着这一切。“艾莎！”她喊道。“等等，求你了！”她冲出城堡，追着艾莎跑去。汉斯跟在她身后。“艾莎！”安娜绝望地喊道。

paras.en: Elsa looked over her shoulder as she neared the water. When she turned, her foot touched the lapping waves—and the water in the fjord immediately froze. She took another cautious step…and another sheet of ice bloomed under her foot.
paras.zh: 艾莎临近水边时，回头望了一眼。她一转身，脚尖触到了拍岸的浪花——峡湾里的水顿时冻结了。她又小心翼翼地迈出一步……脚下又绽放出一片冰。

paras.en: “Elsa!” Anna called after her.
paras.zh: “艾莎！”安娜在她身后喊道。

paras.en: Feeling her panic grow, Elsa ran across the fjord. With each step, more water froze underneath her. Soon she was moving at full speed, heading toward the mountains on the other side of the lake. As she passed, the ships belonging to the visiting dignitaries creaked and locked into place, frozen in the ice. The gorgeous summer day had turned into a growing winter storm.
paras.zh: 艾莎只觉恐慌愈发强烈，便奔跑着越过峡湾。她每迈出一步，脚下就有更多的水冻结成冰。很快，她已全速奔跑起来，朝着湖对岸的群山而去。她经过时，来访使节们的船只吱嘎作响，被牢牢冻在了冰里。明媚的夏日已变成一场愈演愈烈的冬日风暴。

paras.en: “Elsa, stop!” Anna pleaded. She rushed onto the fjord after her sister but slipped on the ice. She was too far behind to catch up.
paras.zh: “艾莎，停下！”安娜恳求道。她冲上峡湾去追姐姐，却在冰面上滑倒了。她落后太远，怎么也追不上了。

paras.en: Hans reached out for Anna and helped her to stand. “Anna, are you all right?” he asked.
paras.zh: 汉斯伸手扶起安娜，帮她站稳。“安娜，你还好吗？”他问。

paras.en: They both watched as Elsa reached the far shore and made her way into the mountains. Anna strained to see the path Elsa had taken.
paras.zh: 两人望着艾莎抵达对岸，走向群山深处。安娜极力想看清艾莎离去的路。

paras.en: “Did you know?” Hans asked Anna.
paras.zh: “你早就知道吗？”汉斯问安娜。

paras.en: “No,” Anna replied. Then she nodded. “But it makes so much sense.”
paras.zh: “不知道，”安娜答道。接着她点了点头。“可这一切都说得通了。”

paras.en: They walked back through the village and overheard the Duke speaking. He was addressing a growing crowd of concerned people. “The queen has cursed this land,” he said. “She must be stopped! You must go after her!”
paras.zh: 两人穿过村庄往回走，无意间听到韦斯文顿公爵正在讲话。他正对着一群越聚越多、忧心忡忡的民众讲话。“女王诅咒了这片土地，”他说。“必须阻止她！你们必须去追她！”

paras.en: Anna rushed over to him. “No!” she shouted. “No one is to go anywhere.”
paras.zh: 安娜冲到他面前。“不！”她喊道。“谁也不准去追。”

paras.en: “You!” The Duke shook a finger at Anna. “Is there sorcery in you, too?” he shouted. “Are you a monster, too?”
paras.zh: “你！”公爵朝安娜晃着手指。“你身上是不是也有妖术？”他喊道。“你也是个怪物吗？”

paras.en: “No, I’m completely ordinary,” Anna replied.
paras.zh: “不，我普普通通，”安娜答道。

paras.en: Hans took her hand. “That’s right, she is,” he told the Duke.
paras.zh: 汉斯握住她的手。“没错，她就是普通人，”他对公爵说。

paras.en: “And my sister is not a monster,” Anna added.
paras.zh: “而且我姐姐不是怪物，”安娜补充道。

paras.en: The Duke scowled. “She nearly killed me,” he said dramatically.
paras.zh: 公爵沉着脸。“她差点害死我，”他夸张地说。

paras.en: “You slipped on ice,” Hans pointed out.
paras.zh: “你是踩在冰上滑倒了，”汉斯一语点破。

paras.en: Anna stepped forward. “It was an accident. She was scared. She didn’t mean it. She didn’t mean any of this.” She paused. “All she’s ever wanted is to be perfect and good. Tonight was my fault. I pushed her. So I’m the one who needs to go after her.”
paras.zh: 安娜走上前。“那是个意外。她当时吓坏了。她不是故意的。这些事她一样也不是故意的。”她顿了顿。“她一直以来想要的，不过是做到完美、做个好人。今晚的事是我的错。是我逼她的。所以该去追她的人是我。”

paras.en: Anna turned to her royal guards. “Bring me my horse, please.”
paras.zh: 安娜转向她的皇家卫兵。“请把我的马牵来。”

paras.en: “What? Anna, no!” Hans shouted. “It’s too dangerous.”
paras.zh: “什么？安娜，不行！”汉斯喊道。“太危险了。”

paras.en: “I’m not afraid of Elsa,” Anna said. “I’ll bring her back and make this right.”
paras.zh: “我不怕艾莎，”安娜说。“我会把她带回来，把一切纠正过来。”

paras.en: A royal guard brought Anna’s horse to her. She took her cloak, which was hanging over the saddle, and wrapped it around her shoulders.
paras.zh: 一名皇家卫兵把安娜的马牵了过来。她拿起搭在马鞍上的斗篷，裹在肩头。

paras.en: “I’m coming with you,” Hans said.
paras.zh: “我跟你一起去，”汉斯说。

paras.en: “No,” Anna told him. “I need you here to take care of Arendelle.”
paras.zh: “不行，”安娜告诉他。“我需要你留在这里照看阿伦黛尔。”

paras.en: Hans saw the desperation in Anna’s eyes. He put his hand to his chest. “On my honor,” he said, bowing his head.
paras.zh: 汉斯看出了安娜眼中的决然。他把手按在胸口。“以我的名誉起誓，”他低着头说。

paras.en: “I leave Prince Hans in charge!” Anna told the crowd.
paras.zh: “汉斯王子代为掌管国事！”安娜向人群宣布。

paras.en: “Are you sure you can trust her?” Hans asked as Anna mounted the horse. When Anna didn’t reply, he leaned in. “I don’t want you getting hurt.”
paras.zh: “你确定能信任她吗？”安娜上马时，汉斯问道。见安娜没有回答，他凑近了些。“我不想让你受到伤害。”

paras.en: “She’s my sister,” Anna said. “She’d never hurt me.”
paras.zh: “她是我姐姐，”安娜说。“她绝不会伤害我。”

paras.en: Urging her horse into a gallop, Anna took off over the frozen fjord toward the mountains as snow continued to fall.
paras.zh: 安娜一催马缰，马儿飞奔起来，载着她越过冰封的峡湾，向着群山而去，雪花仍在纷纷飘落。

paras.en: Elsa trudged up the steep North Mountain. Ever since she was a child, she had been taught to conceal her powers. Now that was all over. She felt sad and worried as she gazed back at Arendelle far below. She knew no one in Arendelle would ever see her in the same way again.
paras.zh: 艾莎一步一步艰难地爬上陡峭的北山。从孩提时代起，她就一直被教导要掩藏自己的力量。而如今，这一切都结束了。她回望远处山下的阿伦黛尔，心中满是悲伤与忧虑。她知道，阿伦黛尔的人再也不会像从前那样看她了。

paras.en: But a tiny part of her also felt relieved. Her magic had been a hard secret to keep, and she didn’t have to hide it anymore. Being alone was easier, too. She didn’t have to worry about hurting anyone.
paras.zh: 但她心底也有一小部分感到如释重负。她的魔法曾是个难以保守的秘密，如今她不必再隐藏它了。独自一人，反倒也轻松些。她不必再担心伤到任何人。

paras.en: As she continued up the mountain, her steps actually became a little lighter. Now that everyone knew what she was capable of, she was free to be herself!
paras.zh: 随着她继续向山上走去，脚步竟真的轻快了些。既然大家都已知道她的能耐，她便可以自由自在地做自己了！

paras.en: With a wave of her hand, Elsa started to experiment with her magic. Snow and ice whirled around her as she created snowmen and icy patterns in the air. The farther she got from Arendelle, the more confident she felt. As she took each step, her ability to draw forth ice and cold grew stronger and more powerful.
paras.zh: 艾莎一挥手，开始尝试施展她的魔法。冰雪在她周身飞旋，她造出一个个雪人，在空中勾勒出冰晶的图案。离阿伦黛尔越远，她就越发自信。她每迈出一步，呼冰唤雪的本领便愈发强大。

paras.en: Elsa plucked off her crown and threw it aside. She tossed her head and her tightly bound hair came loose, cascading over one shoulder in a thick, wavy braid. Twirling around, she conjured up a flowing new outfit of ice, a crystal-blue gown with a cape of gossamer frost. Snow was her element. She was the Snow Queen!
paras.zh: 艾莎摘下王冠，随手抛到一旁。她甩了甩头，紧紧束起的头发顿时散开，如一条浓密蓬松的辫子垂落在一侧肩头。她旋身起舞，凭空变出一身飘逸的冰雪新装——一袭水晶蓝长裙，披着薄霜织成的轻纱斗篷。冰雪，正是她的本元。她就是冰雪女王！

paras.en: Thrilled to let her powers loose at last, Elsa found that she could do more than she realized. As released her magic, a staircase of ice extended upward…to an exquisite ice palace that grew as she raised her arms!
paras.zh: 终于能尽情释放力量，艾莎惊喜地发现，自己能做到的远比想象中多。随着魔法倾泻而出，一道冰阶向上延伸……直通一座精美的冰宫，冰宫随着她扬起的双臂不断生长！

paras.en: This was where she would live. When the castle was finished, Elsa slammed the door. She was home at last.
paras.zh: 这里，就是她今后的居所。冰宫落成，艾莎砰地关上了大门。她终于到家了。

chapters.title: 第九章 · 风雪寻姐

paras.en: The wind howled and the snow blew into Anna’s face. She struggled to guide her horse up the frozen mountain path. She was determined to find Elsa. Anna was sure her sister would thaw the fjord and bring back summer. The whole kingdom would celebrate, and the two sisters would live happily ever after. The thought encouraged Anna as she rode through the snowdrifts.
paras.zh: 狂风呼啸，雪花扑打在安娜脸上。她费力地牵着马，走上冰冻的山路。她下定决心，一定要找到艾莎。安娜坚信，姐姐一定会融化峡湾，让夏天回来。到时候整个王国都会欢庆，姐妹俩也会从此幸福地生活下去。这个念头鼓舞着安娜，她策马穿过一处处雪堆。

paras.en: “Elsa!” Anna called into the blizzard. “It’s me, Anna. Your sister who didn’t mean to make you freeze the summer!” She paused, shivering in the cold. “Wow, that’s a sentence I never thought I’d say. Anyway, I’m sorry! This is all my f-f-f-fault.”
paras.zh: “艾莎！”安娜在暴风雪中喊道。“是我呀，安娜。你那个并不是有意让你把夏天冻住的妹妹！”她顿了顿，在寒冷中瑟瑟发抖。“哇，这话我可从来没想过自己会说出口。总之，对不起！这全都是我的错——错——错——错。”

paras.en: A wolf’s howl interrupted Anna’s cries.
paras.zh: 一声狼嚎打断了安娜的呼喊。

paras.en: Her horse stopped and looked around nervously. Anna tried to convince herself that the sounds were just puppies playing.
paras.zh: 马儿停下脚步，紧张地四处张望。安娜努力说服自己，那不过是小狗在打闹。

paras.en: “Of course, none of this would have happened if she’d just told me her secret,” Anna said with a sigh.
paras.zh: “说真的，要是她当初把秘密告诉我，这一切都不会发生，”安娜叹了口气说。

paras.en: A tree branch snapped, and the horse panicked. It whinnied and kicked up its front legs.
paras.zh: 一根树枝咔嚓折断，马儿惊慌起来。它嘶鸣着，前蹄腾空。

paras.en: “Whoa, whoa!” Anna commanded, pulling back on the reins. She flew off the horse into a snowdrift! She sat up, spit snow out of her mouth, and looked around just in time to see her horse running away.
paras.zh: “吁，吁！”安娜勒紧缰绳，大声喝止。她却从马背上飞了出去，一头栽进雪堆里！她坐起身，吐掉嘴里的雪，环顾四周，正好眼睁睁看着自己的马跑远了。

paras.en: “No, no, no! Come back!” Anna called, but the horse was long gone. “Okay,” she said to herself. She had to keep focused. She struggled to stand up and dusted the snow off her dress.
paras.zh: “不，不，不！回来呀！”安娜喊道，可马早已跑得没了踪影。“好吧，”她对自己说。她得打起精神来。她挣扎着站起身，拍掉裙子上的雪。

paras.en: “Snow, it had to be snow,” she grumbled. “She couldn’t have had a tropical magic that covered the fjords in white sand and warm…” A welcome sight interrupted Anna’s rant. She saw smoke rising in the distance. “Fire!”
paras.zh: “偏偏是雪，非得是雪，”她嘟囔着。“她怎么就不能是一种热带魔法，用白沙和暖意盖满峡湾……”一个令人欣喜的景象打断了安娜的牢骚。她看见远处升起了炊烟。“是火！”

paras.en: Anna took one more step and stumbled down a steep hill. She began to roll like a snowball, layering on more and more snow as she went.
paras.zh: 安娜又迈出一步，却顺着陡峭的山坡跌了下去。她像雪球一样滚了起来，一路上裹上了越来越多的雪。

paras.en: Anna landed with a splash in an icy stream and the snowball broke apart. She got to her feet, shivering. “Cold, cold, cold, cold, cold…,” she muttered. She was standing next to a small building. A wooden sign hung in front of her: WANDERING OAKEN’S TRADING POST. A lump of snow fell off the sign. “And sauna!” she said, reading the end of the sign.
paras.zh: 扑通一声，安娜落进一条冰冷的溪流，雪球也随之散开。她站起身来，浑身直打哆嗦。“冷，冷，冷，冷，冷……”她喃喃自语。她正站在一间小屋旁。一块木招牌悬在她面前：流浪奥肯杂货铺。一团雪从招牌上滑落下来。“还有桑拿！”她念出招牌末尾的字样。

paras.en: Anna hurried inside. The little shop was stocked with summer supplies—after all, it was technically still summertime. She gazed at the goods, looking for warm clothes.
paras.zh: 安娜匆匆走了进去。小店摆满了夏日用品——毕竟，严格说现在还是夏天。她打量着货架上的货品，寻找保暖的衣物。

paras.en: “Hoo, hoo!” called a blond man behind the counter wearing a bright sweater. His name was Oaken, and he was the owner. “Big summer blowout,” he said hopefully. “Half off on our swimming suits, clogs, and a sun balm of my own invention, ja?”
paras.zh: “嗬，嗬！”柜台后一个身穿鲜艳毛衣的金发男子招呼道。他叫奥肯，是这儿的店主。“夏日大甩卖，”他满怀期待地说。“泳衣、木屐，还有我自创的防晒膏，通通半价，好不好？”

paras.en: “Oh, great,” Anna said, looking around the store. “For now, how about boots? Winter boots and dresses?”
paras.zh: “哦，太好了，”安娜环顾着店里说。“不过眼下嘛，先来双靴子怎么样？冬靴，还有裙子？”

paras.en: “Well, that would be in our winter department,” the man said in a thick accent.
paras.zh: “呃，那得去我们的冬季专区，”男子带着浓重的口音说。

paras.en: Anna darted toward the single rack of warm clothing. “Oh, um, I was just wondering,” she said, trying to sound casual, “has another young woman, the queen, perhaps, I don’t know, passed through here?” She brought a pair of boots and some clothes to the counter and set them in front of Oaken.
paras.zh: 安娜快步走向仅有的那排保暖衣物。“哦，呃，我只是想问问，”她故作随意地说，“有没有另一位年轻女子——比如女王，我也不知道——从这儿经过？”她拿了一双靴子和几件衣服走到柜台前，放在奥肯面前。

paras.en: “Only one crazy enough to be out in the storm is you, dear,” Oaken said in a pleasant voice.
paras.zh: “亲爱的，敢在暴风雪里往外跑的疯子，只有你一个，”奥肯和颜悦色地说。

paras.en: At that moment, the front door opened and a gust of frigid air blew in. A large, broad man entered. He was dressed for the arctic cold and completely covered in snow, with only his brown eyes showing. It was Kristoff, and he was looking for supplies, too.
paras.zh: 就在这时，前门开了，一阵刺骨的寒风灌了进来。一个高大魁梧的男子走了进来。他一身极地御寒的装束，浑身上下覆满白雪，只露出一双棕色的眼睛。是克里斯托夫，他也是来采购物资的。

paras.en: “You and this fellow. Hoo, hoo,” Oaken sang out. “Big summer blowout.”
paras.zh: “还有你和这位老兄。嗬，嗬，”奥肯高声吆喝。“夏日大甩卖。”

paras.en: Kristoff pushed past Oaken and went straight to Anna. “Carrots,” he demanded.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫从奥肯身旁挤过去，径直走向安娜。“胡萝卜，”他劈头就说。

paras.en: “Huh?” Anna asked.
paras.zh: “啊？”安娜问。

paras.en: “Behind you,” Kristoff said crossly, pointing.
paras.zh: “你身后，”克里斯托夫没好气地指了指说。

paras.en: “Oh, right,” Anna said. “Excuse me.” She moved out of the way, and Kristoff grabbed a bag of carrots from a shelf behind her. He gathered a few other supplies as he moved briskly around the shop.
paras.zh: “哦，对，”安娜说。“借过。”她让开身子，克里斯托夫便从她身后的架子上抓起一袋胡萝卜。他在店里利落地转了一圈，又收了几样东西。

paras.en: “A real howler in July, ja?” Oaken said, trying to make conversation with the stranger. “Wherever could it be coming from?”
paras.zh: “七月里刮这么大的风，真是少见，是吧？”奥肯想跟这个陌生人搭搭话。“这风到底是从哪儿来的呢？”

paras.en: “The North Mountain,” Kristoff replied.
paras.zh: “北山，”克里斯托夫答道。

paras.en: “The North Mountain,” Anna repeated to herself. Was that where Elsa had gone?
paras.zh: “北山，”安娜在心里默念了一遍。艾莎是不是去了那里？

chapters.title: 第十章 · 杂货店风波

paras.en: Kristoff brought his pile of supplies to the front counter.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫把那堆物资搬到前面的柜台上。

paras.en: “That’ll be forty, ja?” Oaken said.
paras.zh: “一共四十，是吧？”奥肯说。

paras.en: “Forty?” Kristoff barked. “No, ten.”
paras.zh: “四十？”克里斯托夫吼道。“不，十块。”

paras.en: “No, see, these are from our winter stock,” Oaken told him. “Where supply and demand have a big problem.”
paras.zh: “不，你瞧，这些都是冬季存货，”奥肯告诉他。“那儿如今供和需可出了大问题。”

paras.en: “You want to talk about a supply-and-demand problem?” Kristoff asked. “I sell ice for a living!”
paras.zh: “你想跟我谈供需问题？”克里斯托夫反问道。“我可是靠卖冰吃饭的！”

paras.en: Anna walked over to the counter and smiled at Kristoff. “Ice. Really?” she said. “That’s a rough business to be in right now.”
paras.zh: 安娜走到柜台前，朝克里斯托夫微微一笑。“卖冰。真的？”她说。“眼下行这行可不容易呢。”

paras.en: “Forty,” Oaken repeated. “But I will throw in a visit to Oaken’s sauna. Hoo, hoo!”
paras.zh: “四十，”奥肯重复道。“不过我会附赠一次奥肯桑拿。嗬，嗬！”

paras.en: Kristoff and Anna both peered over Oaken’s shoulder to see a family waving from a toasty sauna in a room behind him.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫和安娜都从奥肯肩头望过去，看见他身后的房间里，一家人正在暖融融的桑拿房里朝他们挥手。

paras.en: “Ten’s all I got,” Kristoff told him. “Help me out, ja?”
paras.zh: “我就只有十块，”克里斯托夫对他说。“行行好，是吧？”

paras.en: Oaken held up the bag of carrots. “Ten will get you this and no more.”
paras.zh: 奥肯举起那袋胡萝卜。“十块就只能买这个，别的一概不行。”

paras.en: Kristoff glared at Oaken, seething.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫怒视着奥肯，气不打一处来。

paras.en: “Just tell me one thing,” Anna said, moving closer to Kristoff. “What was happening on the North Mountain? Did it seem…magical?”
paras.zh: “只想请你告诉我一件事，”安娜说着，凑近克里斯托夫。“北山上到底出什么事了？看起来……是不是有魔法？”

paras.en: Kristoff pulled down his scarf, revealing his face. He looked down sharply at Anna. “Yes!” he shouted. “Now back up while I deal with this crook here.”
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫拉下围巾，露出了脸。他低头狠狠瞪着安娜。“没错！”他喊道。“现在退后，让我来收拾这个骗子。”

paras.en: Oaken rose from his chair. He did not appreciate being called a crook. “What did you call me?” he said. He was much taller and wider than Kristoff had expected. Oaken loomed over the counter. Then, with a frown, Oaken swiftly threw Kristoff out of the shop.
paras.zh: 奥肯从椅子上站了起来。他可不喜欢被人叫作骗子。“你叫我什么？”他说。他比克里斯托夫预想的要高大魁梧得多。奥肯隔着柜台居高临下地俯视着他。接着，奥肯眉头一皱，一把将克里斯托夫扔出了店门。

paras.en: Kristoff went flying out the door and landed face-first in a mound of snow next to Sven, who had been waiting patiently outside. Kristoff pulled his head out of the snow. “Ow!” he moaned.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫飞出门外，脸朝下摔进一堆雪里，落在一直耐心等在外面的斯文身旁。克里斯托夫把头从雪里拔了出来。“哎哟！”他呻吟道。

paras.en: “Goodbye!” Oaken said pleasantly, and slammed the door.
paras.zh: “再见！”奥肯客客气气地说完，砰地关上了门。

paras.en: The reindeer snorted and moved over to Kristoff, snuffling and searching in the snow.
paras.zh: 驯鹿喷了喷鼻息，凑到克里斯托夫跟前，在雪里嗅来嗅去地找着什么。

paras.en: “No, Sven,” Kristoff told him. “I didn’t get your carrots.”
paras.zh: “别找了，斯文，”克里斯托夫对它说。“我没给你买着胡萝卜。”

paras.en: The hungry reindeer huffed in his face. Then Kristoff turned his head and spotted something that made him brighten. There was a barn behind the trading post—a warm place to spend the night.
paras.zh: 饥肠辘辘的驯鹿朝他脸上喷了口热气。这时，克里斯托夫转过头，瞥见了什么东西，顿时眼睛一亮。杂货铺后面有一间谷仓——一个过夜的暖和地方。

paras.en: “But I did find us a place to sleep,” he added. “And it’s free.”
paras.zh: “不过我倒是给咱们找着睡觉的地方了，”他补充道。“而且不要钱。”

paras.en: Back in the shop, Oaken returned to his other customer. “I’m sorry about this violence,” he told Anna. “I will add a quart of lutefisk so we have good feelings.” He looked over at what she had selected. “Just the outfit and the boots, ja?”
paras.zh: 回到店里，奥肯转向另一位顾客。“刚才动了手，真是抱歉，”他对安娜说。“我再送你一夸脱腌鳕鱼，咱们就皆大欢喜啦。”他看了看安娜挑好的东西。“就这套衣服和这双靴子，是吧？”

paras.en: Anna looked at her supplies, and then over at the bag Kristoff had left on the counter. She smiled as an idea occurred to her.
paras.zh: 安娜看了看自己挑的物资，又瞥了一眼克里斯托夫落在柜台上的袋子。她微微一笑，心里冒出了一个主意。

paras.en: Shortly afterward, Anna left Oaken’s shop and looked around. She could hear singing coming from the barn. She pushed open the door quietly and peered inside. Kristoff was lying against a bale of hay, playing his lute. He was singing to his reindeer…and then, singing as Sven, he finished the song from the reindeer’s point of view.
paras.zh: 不久，安娜走出奥肯的小店，四下张望。她听见谷仓里传来歌声。她轻轻推开门，朝里面张望。克里斯托夫正靠在一捆干草上，弹着鲁特琴。他在对着驯鹿唱歌……接着，又用斯文的口吻，从驯鹿的视角把歌唱完了。

paras.en: “Ahem.” Anna cleared her throat. When Kristoff looked over, she smiled. “Nice duet,” she said.
paras.zh: “咳咳。”安娜清了清嗓子。克里斯托夫抬头看过来，她甜甜一笑。“二重唱唱得不错嘛，”她说。

paras.en: “Oh, it’s just you,” he said when he saw Anna standing in front of him. “What do you want?”
paras.zh: “哦，原来是你，”他看到安娜站在面前，说道。“你想干什么？”

paras.en: “I want you to take me up the North Mountain,” she declared.
paras.zh: “我要你带我上北山，”她宣布。

paras.en: “I don’t take people places,” Kristoff replied. He closed his eyes and lay back in the hay.
paras.zh: “我可不载人到哪儿去，”克里斯托夫答道。他闭上眼睛，躺回干草堆里。

paras.en: “Let me rephrase that,” Anna said. She threw the sack of supplies she had just bought over to Kristoff. They were exactly the items he’d wanted.
paras.zh: “那我换个说法，”安娜说。她把刚买下的那袋物资朝克里斯托夫扔了过去。正是他想要的那些东西。

paras.en: “Umph!” he grunted as the heavy bag landed on his chest.
paras.zh: “唔！”沉重的袋子砸在他胸口，他闷哼一声。

paras.en: “Take me up the North Mountain,” she ordered.
paras.zh: “带我上北山，”她命令道。

paras.en: Kristoff regarded her carefully. He was not used to taking orders. And he especially couldn’t see any reason to follow Anna’s.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫仔细打量着她。他可不习惯听人发号施令。更何况，他实在看不出有什么理由要听安娜的。

paras.en: “Look,” Anna said. “I know how to stop this winter.”
paras.zh: “听着，”安娜说。“我知道怎么终结这个冬天。”

paras.en: Kristoff hesitated. If the cold weather stopped, he might be able to sell his ice down in Arendelle again.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫犹豫了。要是寒冷的天气过去，他或许又能回阿伦黛尔卖冰了。

paras.en: “We leave at dawn,” he said finally. “And you forgot the carrots for Sven.”
paras.zh: “我们天亮出发，”他终于开口。“还有，你忘了给斯文买胡萝卜。”

paras.en: Anna dropped a bag of carrots on Kristoff’s face.
paras.zh: 安娜把一袋胡萝卜丢在克里斯托夫脸上。

paras.en: “Ooh!” he said.
paras.zh: “噢！”他叫了一声。

paras.en: “Oops, sorry, sorry,” Anna said. Then she caught herself. She was trying to take charge, after all. “We leave now,” she declared. “Right now!”
paras.zh: “哎呀，对不起对不起，”安娜说。紧接着她忽然回过神来。毕竟，她正要拿出个当家的样子呢。“我们现在就走，”她宣布。“立刻，马上！”

paras.en: Kristoff looked over at Sven and offered him a carrot. Sven took a healthy bite. So did Kristoff. They looked at the stranger before them as they chewed. They both knew she had no clue what was ahead.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫看向斯文，递过去一根胡萝卜。斯文咔嚓咬了一大口。克里斯托夫也咬了一口。他们一边咀嚼，一边打量着眼前这个陌生姑娘。人和鹿心里都清楚，她压根不知道前方等着她的是什么。

chapters.title: 第十一章 · 雪原疾驰

paras.en: Kristoff held the reins tightly, steering Sven and the sled through the thick, heavy snow. The night sky was cloudy with the promise of still more snow.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫紧紧攥着缰绳，驾着斯文和雪橇在厚重的大雪中穿行。夜空阴云密布，眼看还要再下更多的雪。

paras.en: “Hang on!” Kristoff yelled to his passenger. “We like to go fast!”
paras.zh: “抓稳了！”克里斯托夫朝车上的乘客喊道。“我们就爱飞驰！”

paras.en: Sven responded happily and charged forward through the drifts.
paras.zh: 斯文欢快地应了一声，冲开积雪向前飞奔。

paras.en: “I like fast,” Anna answered. She leaned back and put her feet up on the front of the sled to show that she was not bothered by the high speed.
paras.zh: “我也喜欢快，”安娜回答。她向后一靠，把双脚翘上雪橇的前沿，摆出一副全然不被高速吓倒的架势。

paras.en: “Get your feet down,” Kristoff scoffed. “This is fresh lacquer.” He glanced at her sideways. “Seriously, were you raised in a barn?” He leaned over and wiped down his new sled.
paras.zh: “把脚放下去，”克里斯托夫没好气地说。“这可是刚上的漆。”他斜眼瞥了她一下。“说真的，你是在谷仓里长大的吗？”他俯下身，擦拭着自己的新雪橇。

paras.en: “No, I was raised in a castle,” Anna replied.
paras.zh: “不，我是在城堡里长大的，”安娜答道。

paras.en: “So tell me,” Kristoff said, “what made the queen go all ice crazy?”
paras.zh: “那倒要问问了，”克里斯托夫说，“女王怎么突然就冰雪发疯了？”

paras.en: “It was all my fault,” Anna blurted out. “I got engaged and she freaked out, because I’d only just met him, you know, that day. And she said she wouldn’t bless the marriage.”
paras.zh: “都怪我，”安娜脱口而出。“我订婚了，她就崩溃了，因为我那天才刚认识他，你懂的。而且她说她不肯为这桩婚事祝福。”

paras.en: “Wait,” Kristoff said. “You got engaged to someone you just met that day?”
paras.zh: “等等，”克里斯托夫说。“你跟一个当天才认识的人订了婚？”

paras.en: “Yeah, anyway,” Anna replied, dismissing his comment. “I got mad and yelled at her, and she tried to walk away, but I grabbed her glove, and—”
paras.zh: “是啊，总之，”安娜没理会他的话，接着说。“我气坏了，冲她大喊，她想走开，可我一把扯下了她的手套，然后——”

paras.en: “Wait. You got engaged to someone you just met that day?” Kristoff repeated.
paras.zh: “等等。你跟一个当天才认识的人订了婚？”克里斯托夫重复道。

paras.en: “Yes, are you listening?” Anna snapped. “Thing is, she wore the gloves all the time, but I just thought the girl’s got a thing about dirt.”
paras.zh: “对啊，你到底有没有在听？”安娜没好气地说。“问题是，她成天戴着手套，我还以为这姑娘就是有点洁癖。”

paras.en: “Didn’t your parents ever warn you about strangers?” Kristoff asked.
paras.zh: “你父母没提醒过你要提防陌生人吗？”克里斯托夫问。

paras.en: “Yes, they did,” Anna said. She looked Kristoff over carefully and slid farther away from him on the seat. After all, he was a stranger. “But Hans is not a stranger.”
paras.zh: “提醒过，他们说过，”安娜说。她仔细打量了克里斯托夫一番，在座位上往远处挪了挪。毕竟，他也是个陌生人。“可汉斯不是陌生人。”

paras.en: Kristoff raised his eyebrows. “Oh, yeah? What’s his last name?”
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫扬起眉毛。“哦，是吗？他姓什么？”

paras.en: Anna frowned, thinking. “Of the Southern Isles?” she offered.
paras.zh: 安娜皱起眉头想了想。“南方群岛的？”她试探着说。

paras.en: “What’s his favorite food?” Kristoff fired off.
paras.zh: “他最爱吃什么？”克里斯托夫连珠炮似的追问。

paras.en: Anna hesitated. “Sandwiches.”
paras.zh: 安娜迟疑了。“三明治。”

paras.en: “Best friend’s name?” Kristoff quickly followed up.
paras.zh: “最好的朋友叫什么？”克里斯托夫紧跟着问。

paras.en: “Probably John,” Anna replied, reflecting that lots of people were named John. So maybe Hans’s best friend would be, too.
paras.zh: “大概叫约翰吧，”安娜答道，心想叫约翰的人多的是。说不定汉斯的挚友也叫这个呢。

paras.en: “Eye color?” Kristoff pressed.
paras.zh: “眼睛什么颜色？”克里斯托夫追问道。

paras.en: “Dreamy.” Anna smiled.
paras.zh: “梦幻迷人。”安娜微笑着说。

paras.en: “Have you had a meal with him yet?” Kristoff asked. “What if you hate the way he eats? What if you hate the way he picks his nose?”
paras.zh: “你跟他一起吃过饭没有？”克里斯托夫问。“万一你讨厌他吃饭的样子怎么办？万一你讨厌他挖鼻孔的样子呢？”

paras.en: Anna wrinkled her forehead. “Picks his nose?”
paras.zh: 安娜皱起了额头。“挖鼻孔？”

paras.en: “And eats it,” Kristoff added.
paras.zh: “挖了还吃，”克里斯托夫补上一句。

paras.en: “Excuse me, sir,” Anna said. “He is a prince.”
paras.zh: “恕我直言，先生，”安娜说。“他可是位王子。”

paras.en: Kristoff shook his head. “All men do it.”
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫摇了摇头。“男人都一个样。”

paras.en: “Ewww!” Anna made a face. “Look, it doesn’t matter. It’s true love.”
paras.zh: “噫——！”安娜做了个鬼脸。“听着，这都不重要。这是真爱。”

paras.en: “Doesn’t sound like true love,” Kristoff said, staring straight ahead.
paras.zh: “听起来可不像真爱，”克里斯托夫直视前方说。

paras.en: “Are you some sort of love expert?” Anna asked.
paras.zh: “怎么，你是恋爱专家吗？”安娜问。

paras.en: “No, but I have friends who are,” he responded.
paras.zh: “不是，不过我有几个朋友是，”他答道。

paras.en: “You have friends who are love experts?” Anna asked sarcastically.
paras.zh: “你还有当恋爱专家的朋友？”安娜讥讽地问。

paras.en: Kristoff’s eyes widened and he stopped the sled. “Stop talking,” he demanded.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫眼睛瞪大了，一把勒住雪橇。“别说了，”他喝道。

paras.en: “No, I want to meet these friends,” she insisted with a grin.
paras.zh: “不，我偏要见见这些朋友，”她咧嘴笑着，不肯罢休。

paras.en: Kristoff put his hand over Anna’s mouth. “I mean it. Shhhh!” He stood up and looked into the dark woods. He held up a lantern. Suddenly, he yelled, “Sven! Go! GO!”
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫伸手捂住了安娜的嘴。“我是认真的。嘘——！”他站起身，望向黑黢黢的树林。他举起一盏灯笼。突然，他大喊一声：“斯文！冲！快冲！”

paras.en: The sled took off and Anna fell backward. She saw glowing eyes in the darkness all around them. “What are they?” she whispered.
paras.zh: 雪橇猛地蹿了出去，安娜向后摔倒。她看见四周的黑暗中亮起一双双泛着绿光的眼睛。“那是什么？”她低声问。

paras.en: “Wolves,” Kristoff said.
paras.zh: “狼，”克里斯托夫说。

paras.en: “What do we do?” Anna asked. She looked at Kristoff and readied herself.
paras.zh: “我们怎么办？”安娜问。她望着克里斯托夫，做好了准备。

paras.en: “I’ve got this,” Kristoff said calmly. “You just don’t fall off—and don’t get eaten.”
paras.zh: “有我呢，”克里斯托夫镇定地说。“你只要别掉下去——也别被吃掉就行。”

paras.en: “But I want to help,” Anna said.
paras.zh: “可我想帮忙，”安娜说。

paras.en: “No,” Kristoff replied.
paras.zh: “不用，”克里斯托夫答道。

paras.en: “Why not?” Anna pouted.
paras.zh: “为什么不用？”安娜撅起了嘴。

paras.en: “Because I don’t trust your judgment,” Kristoff said.
paras.zh: “因为我不信任你的判断力，”克里斯托夫说。

paras.en: Anna was offended. “Excuse me?”
paras.zh: 安娜恼了。“你说什么？”

paras.en: A wolf jumped at the sleigh, and Kristoff kicked it back. “Who marries a man she’s just met?”
paras.zh: 一只狼扑向雪橇，克里斯托夫一脚把它踢了回去。“谁会嫁给一个刚认识的人啊？”

paras.en: Anna was seething. “It’s true love!” She picked up Kristoff’s lute and swung it at his head. He ducked, and Anna struck a wolf that was about to lunge onto the sled!
paras.zh: 安娜气得浑身发抖。“这是真爱！”她抄起克里斯托夫的鲁特琴，朝他头上挥去。他一低头躲过，安娜那一击正好打中一只正要扑上雪橇的狼！

paras.en: “Whoa!” Kristoff exclaimed, just as another wolf jumped up and knocked him down. He fell out and was dragged behind the sled.
paras.zh: “哇哦！”克里斯托夫惊呼，就在这时，另一只狼扑上来把他撞倒了。他摔出雪橇，被拖在雪橇后面。

paras.en: “Christopher!” Anna cried.
paras.zh: “克里斯托弗！”安娜喊道。

paras.en: “It’s Kristoff!” he yelled.
paras.zh: “是克里斯托夫！”他大叫。

paras.en: Anna took the lantern and lit the sled’s blanket on fire. She threw the flaming blanket toward Kristoff, and the wolves tumbled off him. Then she reached out and pulled him back onto the sled. Kristoff looked at her in dismay.
paras.zh: 安娜抄起灯笼，点燃了雪橇上的毛毯。她把燃着的毛毯朝克里斯托夫扔去，狼群纷纷从他身上翻滚下来。接着她探出身子，把他拉回了雪橇上。克里斯托夫哭笑不得地看着她。

paras.en: “You almost set me on fire,” he said.
paras.zh: “你差点把我点了，”他说。

paras.en: “But I didn’t,” Anna replied.
paras.zh: “可我没有啊，”安娜答道。

paras.en: Sven suddenly whinnied. Ahead of him was a steep drop into a massive gorge.
paras.zh: 斯文忽然一声嘶鸣。前方是一道陡坡，下面就是巨大的峡谷。

paras.en: “Get ready to jump, Sven!” Anna called.
paras.zh: “准备起跳，斯文！”安娜喊道。

paras.en: “You don’t tell him what to do!” Kristoff shouted. “I do!”
paras.zh: “轮不到你指挥他！”克里斯托夫吼道。“指挥他的只能是我！”

paras.en: In one swift movement, he grabbed Anna and threw her onto Sven’s back. Then he unhooked the reindeer’s harness. “Jump!”
paras.zh: 说时迟那时快，他一把抓起安娜，甩到了斯文的背上。接着他解开了驯鹿的挽具。“跳！”

paras.en: Sven leaped and cleared the gorge with Anna on his back.
paras.zh: 斯文纵身一跃，驮着安娜越过了峡谷。

paras.en: Just behind them, Kristoff boldly jumped with the sled. The sled didn’t make it all the way across, but just before it fell into the gorge, Kristoff threw himself off and caught the edge of the cliff on the other side. Down below, his new sled burst into flames as he dangled from the cliff. “I just got it.” He looked down with a sigh. Then his hands started to slip on the slick ice. “Uh-oh,” he said in alarm. “No, no, no!”
paras.zh: 紧跟在他们身后，克里斯托夫豁出去带着雪橇一起腾空跃起。雪橇没能完全飞过峡谷，但在坠入谷底的前一刻，克里斯托夫纵身跳离，抓住了对岸的崖边。他悬在崖壁上，崭新的雪橇在下面燃起了熊熊火焰。“那雪橇我才刚到手。”他叹了口气，朝下望去。紧接着，他的手在光滑的冰面上渐渐打滑。“糟了，”他惊慌地说。“不，不，不！”

paras.en: Out of nowhere, an ax slammed into the snow just inches from his face. He heard Anna’s voice from above.
paras.zh: 不知从哪儿飞来一把斧头，咚地扎进离他脸只有几寸远的雪里。他听见安娜的声音从头顶传来。

paras.en: “Grab on!” she yelled.
paras.zh: “抓住！”她喊道。

paras.en: The ax was attached to a rope that was secured around Sven.
paras.zh: 斧头上系着一根绳子，绳子牢牢拴在斯文身上。

paras.en: “Pull, Sven!” Anna ordered.
paras.zh: “拉，斯文！”安娜下令。

paras.en: Sven heaved and walked backward, lifting Kristoff to safety.
paras.zh: 斯文使劲往后拽，一步一步倒退着走，把克里斯托夫拉回了安全的地方。

paras.en: Anna and Kristoff peered over the edge at the burning sled. “I’ll replace your sled and everything in it,” she promised. She looked sadly at Kristoff. “And I understand if you don’t want to help me anymore.”
paras.zh: 安娜和克里斯托夫趴在崖边，望着下面燃烧的雪橇。“我会赔你一架新雪橇，里面的东西也一样，”她许诺道。她难过地看着克里斯托夫。“你要是不想再帮我了，我也理解。”

paras.en: Kristoff watched as Anna walked away. Sven nuzzled him softly with his cold nose.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫望着安娜走远。斯文用冰凉的鼻子轻轻蹭了蹭他。

paras.en: “Of course I don’t want to help her anymore,” he told the reindeer. “In fact, this whole thing has ruined me for helping anyone ever again.” He watched as Anna turned and started to walk in the opposite direction.
paras.zh: “我当然不想再帮她了，”他对驯鹿说。“说真的，这一遭让我这辈子再也不想帮任何人了。”他望着安娜转过身，朝相反的方向走去。

paras.en: “But she’ll die on her own,” he said, speaking in Sven’s deep voice.
paras.zh: “可她一个人会没命的，”他用斯文那低沉的嗓音说。

paras.en: Kristoff looked away. “I can live with that,” he said.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫别过脸去。“我也认了，”他说。

paras.en: Anna turned this way and that, unsure which way to go.
paras.zh: 安娜转来转去，不知该往哪边走。

paras.en: “But you won’t get your new sled if she’s dead,” Kristoff continued in Sven’s voice.
paras.zh: “可她要是死了，你的新雪橇就泡汤了，”克里斯托夫又用斯文的嗓音说。

paras.en: He sighed. “Wait up,” he called to Anna in his normal voice. “We’re coming.”
paras.zh: 他叹了口气。“等一等，”他用自己平时的声音朝安娜喊道。“我们也去。”

paras.en: Anna grinned. “You are?” she said happily. Then she composed herself. “I mean, sure, I’ll let you tag along.”
paras.zh: 安娜咧嘴一笑。“真的？”她高兴地说。随即她又端起了架子。“我是说，好吧，算你们跟着我。”

paras.en: Anna wasn’t sure what lay ahead, but she was very glad that Kristoff and Sven were coming with her.
paras.zh: 安娜不知道前方等着她的是什么，但她打心眼里高兴，克里斯托夫和斯文愿意与她同行。

chapters.title: 第十二章 · 山巅远眺

paras.en: Together, Kristoff, Sven, and Anna walked through the night. As dawn crept over the horizon, the three travelers found themselves on the rim of a mountain. Looking down, they could see Arendelle in the distance.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫、斯文和安娜一起在夜色中赶路。当晨曦悄悄爬上地平线，三位旅人发觉自己已站在一处山顶边缘。向下望去，他们能远远望见阿伦黛尔。

paras.en: But it wasn’t the summertime view they were expecting. The kingdom was completely frozen, covered with white ice.
paras.zh: 可那并不是他们期待中的夏日景象。整个王国冻得严严实实，覆盖着一层白冰。

paras.en: Anna gasped in shock. Then she pulled herself together. “It’ll be fine,” she said. “Elsa will thaw it.”
paras.zh: 安娜惊得倒吸一口气。接着她定了定神。“会没事的，”她说。“艾莎会把冰融化的。”

paras.en: “Will she?” Kristoff asked skeptically. “Just like that?”
paras.zh: “她会吗？”克里斯托夫将信将疑地问。“就这么简单？”

paras.en: “Sure,” Anna replied. She pointed straight ahead. “Come on. This way to the North Mountain, right?”
paras.zh: “当然，”安娜答道。她径直指向前方。“走吧。去北山是这条路，对吧？”

paras.en: “More like this way,” Kristoff said, pushing her pointing finger upward. A huge, steep mountain towered above them.
paras.zh: “更像是这边，”克里斯托夫说着，把她的手指往上推了推。一座巨大陡峭的山峰高耸在三人头顶。

paras.en: With no other choice, the group continued, moving forward and up. As the sun finally rose completely, they rounded a corner and came upon a clearing surrounded by tall trees.
paras.zh: 别无选择，一行人只好继续赶路，一路向前、向上。太阳终于完全升起时，他们转过一个弯，来到一片被高大树木环绕的空地。

paras.en: They gasped as the morning light danced on the snowy area before them. The terrain was different from what they had seen in the rest of the woods. They had found a gorgeous winter wonderland.
paras.zh: 晨光在眼前这片雪地上跳跃闪烁，他们看得屏住了呼吸。这里的地形，与他们在林中其他地方见到的截然不同。他们闯入了一片美不胜收的冬日仙境。
