paras.en: The view took Anna’s breath away. “I never knew winter could be so…beautiful,” she said, looking up at a willow tree covered in ice. The branches looked as if they were glistening with a crystal coating. Then she noticed Sven. The reindeer had gotten his antlers tangled up in icy vines, and he looked like a twinkling Christmas tree!
paras.zh: 眼前的景致让安娜大气都不敢出。“我从不知道冬天可以这么……美，”她仰头望着一棵覆满冰凌的柳树说。那些枝条仿佛镀上了一层水晶，闪闪发亮。接着她注意到了斯文。驯鹿的角缠进了冰藤里，看上去活像一棵闪闪发光的圣诞树！

paras.en: “Yeah, but it’s so white!” said a voice that came out of nowhere. “Does it hurt your eyes? My eyes are killing me. You know, how about a little color?”
paras.zh: “美是美，可这也太白了！”一个不知打哪儿冒出来的声音说。“刺不刺眼睛？我的眼睛都快瞎了。我说，来点颜色怎么样？”

paras.en: Anna and Kristoff looked around. They stared at Sven for a moment. Could he be the one speaking?
paras.zh: 安娜和克里斯托夫四下张望。他们盯着斯文看了一会儿。会是他在说话吗？

paras.en: “Must we bleach the joy out of it all?” the voice went on. “I’m thinking like maybe some crimson or chartreuse. How about yellow? No, not yellow. Yellow and snow? Brrrr… No-go.”
paras.zh: “非得把这点乐趣都漂得惨白吗？”那声音继续道。“我在想，也许来点绯红或者黄绿。黄色怎么样？不，不要黄色。黄色配雪？哆——不行。”

paras.en: A goofy little snowman with twigs for arms, but no nose, appeared. He laughed at his own yellow snow joke. “Am I right?” he asked Anna.
paras.zh: 一个傻乎乎的小雪人出现了，他用树枝当胳膊，却没有鼻子。他正为自己那句黄雪的笑话咯咯直乐。“我说得没错吧？”他问安娜。

paras.en: “AAAAHHH!” Anna screamed. She’d never seen a talking snowman before, and she reacted quickly. She kicked him in the snowball head, which went flying right into Kristoff.
paras.zh: “啊——！”安娜尖叫起来。她从没见过会说话的雪人，反应倒是非常麻利。她一脚踢中那颗雪球脑袋，脑袋飞出去，不偏不倚砸中克里斯托夫。

paras.en: “Hi!” the snowman head said.
paras.zh: “嗨！”雪人脑袋说。

paras.en: “You’re creepy,” Kristoff told the head. He tossed it to Anna.
paras.zh: “你真瘆人，”克里斯托夫对那颗脑袋说。他把脑袋抛给安娜。

paras.en: “I don’t want it!” Anna shrieked, throwing it back to Kristoff.
paras.zh: “我才不要！”安娜尖叫着，把它抛回给克里斯托夫。

paras.en: “Back at you!” Kristoff called, chucking the head to her again.
paras.zh: “还给你！”克里斯托夫喊着，又把脑袋扔回给她。

paras.en: “Please don’t drop me!” the snowman head pleaded.
paras.zh: “求求你们别把我摔了！”雪人脑袋哀求道。

paras.en: Anna frowned at Kristoff. “Don’t!”
paras.zh: 安娜朝克里斯托夫皱起眉。“别扔！”

paras.en: Kristoff grinned. “Come on, it’s just a head,” he said.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫咧嘴一笑。“得了吧，不过是颗脑袋嘛，”他说。

paras.en: “All right,” the snowman told them. “We got off to a bad start.”
paras.zh: “好吧，”雪人对他们说。“咱们这开头是不太愉快。”

paras.en: “The body!” Anna cried. She quickly dropped the head onto the body, but somehow it landed upside down—and stuck that way.
paras.zh: “身体！”安娜喊道。她慌忙把脑袋安到身体上，可不知怎么，它倒着落了上去——还卡在了那儿。

paras.en: “Wait!” the snowman said, gazing at the upside-down world around him. “What am I looking at right now? Why are you hanging off the earth like a bat?”
paras.zh: “等等！”雪人望着四周颠倒的世界说。“我现在看到的这是啥？你们干嘛像蝙蝠似的倒挂在地上？”

paras.en: Anna walked over to the snowman. “All right,” she said. “Wait one second.” She turned his head around so he was right-side up.
paras.zh: 安娜走到雪人跟前。“好了，”她说。“稍等一下。”她把他的脑袋转过来，让他正了过来。

paras.en: “Oh, thank you!” he said.
paras.zh: “噢，谢谢你！”他说。

paras.en: “You’re welcome,” Anna said, smiling at the little snowman. He wasn’t so scary now that she’d gotten a chance to look at him properly.
paras.zh: “不客气，”安娜微笑着对这个小雪人说。如今能好好看清他的模样，他也没那么吓人了。

paras.en: “Now I’m perfect,” the snowman said.
paras.zh: “现在我完美了，”雪人说。

paras.en: “Well, almost,” Anna replied. She grabbed a carrot from Sven’s pack and pushed it into Olaf’s face to give him a nose. She pushed a little too forcefully, though, and the carrot went right through his head! “Oh, too hard!” Anna said. “I’m sorry! I—I was just…”
paras.zh: “嗯，还差点，”安娜答道。她从斯文的行囊里取出一根胡萝卜，往雪宝脸上按去，好给他安个鼻子。可她用力稍猛了些，胡萝卜竟一头穿透了他的脑袋！“噢，太用力了！”安娜说。“对不起！我——我只是……”

paras.en: The snowman spun around. “Woo!” he exclaimed. “Head rush!”
paras.zh: 雪人滴溜溜转了个圈。“呜呼！”他惊呼。“脑袋发晕！”

paras.en: Anna bent down to him. “Are you okay?”
paras.zh: 安娜弯下腰看他。“你还好吗？”

paras.en: He beamed. Even though only a tiny point of the carrot was sticking out in front, he was happy. “Are you kidding me?” he asked. “I am wonderful! I’ve always wanted a nose.” He looked down, cross-eyed, at his new feature. “So cute. It’s like a little baby unicorn.”
paras.zh: 他咧嘴笑了。尽管胡萝卜只在前面露出小小一截，他照样乐呵呵的。“你开玩笑吧？”他问。“我好得很！我一直想要个鼻子呢。”他斗鸡眼似的低头打量着自己的新鼻子。“真可爱。就像一只小独角兽。”

paras.en: With another shove, Anna pushed the carrot from the back of his head so the carrot nose was in the proper place.
paras.zh: 安娜又推了一把，从他的后脑把胡萝卜往前顶，胡萝卜鼻子终于归了位。

paras.en: “What? Hey! Whoa!” the snowman cried out. “I love it even more! All right, let’s start this thing over.” A smile spread across his face. “Hi, everyone! I’m Olaf, and I like warm hugs.” He opened his twig arms wide for a hug.
paras.zh: “什么？嘿！哇哦！”雪人大叫。“我更喜欢了！好啦，咱们重新来一遍。”他脸上绽开灿烂的笑容。“嗨，大家好！我是雪宝，我喜欢温暖的拥抱。”他张开树枝做的双臂，等着拥抱。

paras.en: The name struck Anna. “Olaf?” she asked. Anna thought for a moment. She remembered building a little snowman with Elsa when they were young. Elsa had given that snowman the same name.
paras.zh: 这个名字让安娜心头一震。“雪宝？”她问。安娜想了一会儿。她记得小时候和艾莎一起堆过一个小雪人。艾莎给那个雪人起的就是这个名字。

paras.en: Olaf gazed at Anna. “And you are?”
paras.zh: 雪宝打量着安娜。“那你又是谁？”

paras.en: “I’m Anna,” she answered.
paras.zh: “我是安娜，”她答道。

paras.en: “And who is the funky-looking donkey over there?” Olaf inquired.
paras.zh: “那边那头长相怪怪的驴是谁？”雪宝问。

paras.en: “That’s Sven,” Anna told him.
paras.zh: “那是斯文，”安娜告诉他。

paras.en: “Uh-huh,” Olaf said. “And who’s the reindeer?”
paras.zh: “嗯哼，”雪宝说。“那驯鹿又是谁？”

paras.en: “Sven!” Anna said, laughing at Olaf’s mistake.
paras.zh: “斯文！”安娜说，被雪宝的搞错逗笑了。

paras.en: Confused, Olaf stared at both Sven and Kristoff, thinking they had the same name. “Oh, okay. Makes things easier for me,” he said.
paras.zh: 雪宝糊涂了，盯着斯文和克里斯托夫直看，还以为他俩同名。“噢，好吧。这样对我来说反倒省事了，”他说。

paras.en: Sven moved closer to the talking snowman and tried to take a bite of Olaf’s carrot nose.
paras.zh: 斯文凑近这个会说话的雪人，想咬一口雪宝的胡萝卜鼻子。

paras.en: “Aww,” Olaf said, laughing. “Look at him, trying to kiss my nose.” He smiled at the reindeer. “I like you, too!”
paras.zh: “哎呀，”雪宝笑着说。“瞧他，想亲我的鼻子呢。”他朝驯鹿笑了笑。“我也喜欢你！”

paras.en: “Olaf, did Elsa build you?” Anna asked.
paras.zh: “雪宝，你是艾莎堆出来的吗？”安娜问。

paras.en: “Yeah, why?” the snowman replied.
paras.zh: “是啊，怎么了？”雪人答道。

paras.en: “Do you know where she is?” Anna said, moving closer.
paras.zh: “你知道她在哪儿吗？”安娜边说边凑近了些。

paras.en: “Yeah, why?” Olaf said, innocently oblivious to the line of questioning.
paras.zh: “知道啊，怎么了？”雪宝说，对这番盘问的用意浑然不觉。

paras.en: “Do you think you could show us the way?” Anna asked, full of hope.
paras.zh: “那你能带我们去吗？”安娜满怀希望地问。

paras.en: “Yeah, why?” the snowman asked again.
paras.zh: “能啊，怎么了？”雪人又问了一遍。

paras.en: Kristoff was busy examining one of Olaf’s twig arms, which had fallen off. “How does this work?”
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫正忙着摆弄雪宝掉下来的一根树枝胳膊。“这玩意儿是怎么运作的？”

paras.en: The hand on the arm smacked Kristoff across the face!
paras.zh: 胳膊上那只手“啪”地一巴掌，正扇在克里斯托夫脸上！

paras.en: “Stop it, Sven!” Olaf said, calling Kristoff by the wrong name. “We need to focus here!” He turned to face Anna. “Why?”
paras.zh: “别闹了，斯文！”雪宝喊道，把克里斯托夫叫成了别的名字。“我们得专心！”他转过身面对安娜。“为什么？”

paras.en: “I’ll tell you why,” Kristoff said. “We need Elsa to bring back summer.”
paras.zh: “我来告诉你为什么，”克里斯托夫说。“我们需要艾莎把夏天带回来。”

paras.en: “Summer?” Olaf said. “Oh, I don’t know why, but I’ve always loved the idea of summer and sun, and all things hot!”
paras.zh: “夏天？”雪宝说。“噢，我也说不清为什么，可我一直就喜欢夏天、太阳，还有一切热乎乎的东西！”

paras.en: Kristoff raised his eyebrows. “Really? I’m guessing you don’t have much experience with heat.”
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫扬起眉毛。“真的吗？我猜你没怎么领教过热吧。”

paras.en: Olaf shook his head. “Nope, but sometimes I like to close my eyes and imagine what it’d be like when summer does come.”
paras.zh: 雪宝摇了摇头。“没有，不过有时候我喜欢闭上眼睛，想象夏天真正到来时会是什么样子。”

paras.en: As Olaf went on and on about all the wonderful things he would do in summer, Kristoff looked over at Anna. “I’m going to tell him,” he whispered. It was killing him to hear Olaf talk about summer’s heat—which is a snowman’s worst nightmare!
paras.zh: 雪宝滔滔不绝地说着夏天里要做的一切美事，克里斯托夫却扭头看向安娜。“我要告诉他，”他低声说。听着雪宝大谈夏天的酷热，克里斯托夫如坐针毡——那可是雪人最可怕的噩梦！

paras.en: “Don’t you dare,” Anna scolded Kristoff. She couldn’t bear to ruin Olaf’s dream with the harsh truth.
paras.zh: “你敢，”安娜嗔怪道。她不忍心让残酷的真相毁掉雪宝的梦想。

paras.en: Olaf took Anna’s hand. “So come on! Let’s go bring back summer!”
paras.zh: 雪宝拉起安娜的手。“那就走吧！咱们去把夏天找回来！”

paras.en: “I’m coming!” Anna said. She looked over her shoulder at Kristoff.
paras.zh: “我来啦！”安娜说。她回头望了克里斯托夫一眼。

paras.en: “Somebody’s got to tell him,” Kristoff murmured, shaking his head. He and Sven followed Anna and the little snowman.
paras.zh: “总得有人告诉他，”克里斯托夫摇着头喃喃道。他和斯文跟在安娜和小雪人身后走去。

chapters.title: 第十三章 · 冰棱迷宫

paras.en: Anna, Kristoff, and Sven followed Olaf through a maze of icicles, hoping to find Elsa. But it looked as if whoever had built the path did not want visitors. Sharp ice daggers stuck out of the ground everywhere. Kristoff just missed being jabbed in the chest by one of the thick spikes.
paras.zh: 安娜、克里斯托夫和斯文跟着雪宝穿过一片冰棱迷宫，希望能找到艾莎。可看这情形，修这条路的人似乎并不欢迎访客。锋利的冰刃从四面八方的地面刺出来。克里斯托夫险些被一根粗冰刺扎穿胸膛。

paras.en: “So how exactly are you planning to stop this weather?” he asked Anna.
paras.zh: “那你到底打算怎么拦住这场风雪？”他问安娜。

paras.en: “I’m going to talk to my sister,” she said.
paras.zh: “我要去跟我姐姐谈谈，”她说。

paras.en: “That’s your plan?” Kristoff replied. “My whole business is riding on you talking to your sister?”
paras.zh: “这就是你的计划？”克里斯托夫反问。“我全部的生意，就指望着你去跟你姐姐谈谈了？”

paras.en: Anna marched forward. “Yep.”
paras.zh: 安娜大步向前走去。“没错。”

paras.en: “And you’re not at all afraid of her?” Kristoff asked.
paras.zh: “你当真一点儿都不怕她？”克里斯托夫问。

paras.en: “Why would I be?” Anna said.
paras.zh: “我为什么要怕？”安娜说。

paras.en: Kristoff peered at the sharp ice spikes lining the path.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫打量着道路两旁林立的尖冰。

paras.en: “I was just literally thinking the same thing,” Olaf said. “I bet Elsa’s the nicest, gentlest, warmest person ever.” He walked right into an icicle that pierced his torso. His bottom section continued to walk forward into a snow mound. When Olaf realized his body was no longer connected, he began to laugh. “Oh, look at that,” he said. “I’ve been impaled.”
paras.zh: “我刚才心里想的跟你一模一样，”雪宝说。“我打赌艾莎一定是有史以来最善良、最温柔、最温暖的人。”话音未落，他径直撞上一根冰柱，冰柱穿透了他的上身。他的下半身却浑然不觉，继续往前走，一头栽进一个雪堆。等雪宝发觉自己的身子已经断成两截，他反倒哈哈大笑起来。“噢，瞧瞧，”他说。“我被刺穿了。”

paras.en: Anna and Kristoff didn’t respond to Olaf. They were too busy staring at a cliff in front of them. They had a hit a dead end.
paras.zh: 安娜和克里斯托夫没工夫搭理雪宝。他们正目瞪口呆地盯着面前的一面悬崖。他们撞上了死路。

paras.en: “What now?” Anna asked.
paras.zh: “现在怎么办？”安娜问。

paras.en: Kristoff sighed. “It’s too steep,” he said. “I’ve only got one rope, and you don’t know how to climb mountains.”
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫叹了口气。“太陡了，”他说。“我只有一根绳子，而你又不会爬山。”

paras.en: Anna put her hands on her hips. “Says who?” she countered, and headed straight for the mountain face.
paras.zh: 安娜双手叉腰。“谁说的？”她回敬了一句，径直朝山壁走去。

paras.en: Kristoff and Sven watched as Anna struggled to pull herself up the sheer slope.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫和斯文看着安娜在那道陡坡上拼命想把自己往上撑。

paras.en: “What are you doing?” Kristoff asked.
paras.zh: “你在干什么？”克里斯托夫问。

paras.en: “I’m going to see my sister,” Anna said, straining to secure a handhold or a foothold in the ice.
paras.zh: “我要去见我姐姐，”安娜说，一边费力地在冰上寻找着手点和落脚处。

paras.en: “You’re going to kill yourself,” Kristoff observed. “I wouldn’t put my foot there.”
paras.zh: “你会把自己摔死的，”克里斯托夫一语道破。“换了我可不会把脚踩在那儿。”

paras.en: Anna turned. “You’re distracting me!” As soon as she put her foot down, it slipped and she nearly toppled over. Anna paused and took a deep breath. Kristoff was right. The mountain was too steep to climb, but she didn’t want to give up.
paras.zh: 安娜回过头来。“你干扰到我了！”她脚刚一踩实就打了个滑，险些摔个倒栽葱。安娜停下来，深吸一口气。克里斯托夫说得没错。山太陡，根本爬不上去，可她又不想就此放弃。

paras.en: “How do you know Elsa even wants to see you?” Kristoff asked.
paras.zh: “你怎么知道艾莎想不想见你？”克里斯托夫问。

paras.en: “I’m just blocking you out ’cause I’ve got to concentrate here,” she said.
paras.zh: “我正屏蔽你呢，因为我得专心，”她说。

paras.en: Kristoff crossed his arms over his chest. “I’m just saying, most people who disappear into the mountains want to be alone.”
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫双臂抱在胸前。“我只是说，躲进深山的人，多半是想一个人清静清静。”

paras.en: “Nobody wants to be alone,” Anna said, observing him. “Except maybe you.”
paras.zh: “没有人想孤零零的，”安娜打量着他说。“也许除了你。”

paras.en: “I’m not alone,” Kristoff said. “I have friends.”
paras.zh: “我才不孤单，”克里斯托夫说。“我有朋友。”

paras.en: “Oh, right, the love experts,” Anna scoffed.
paras.zh: “噢，对，那些恋爱专家，”安娜嗤之以鼻。

paras.en: Kristoff was not amused. “Yes, the love experts!”
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫可没觉得好笑。“对，就是恋爱专家！”

paras.en: Anna turned to face the mountain again and started to climb. “Please tell me I’m almost there,” she called over her shoulder. The air seemed thinner to her, and she was growing tired of holding on.
paras.zh: 安娜重新面向大山，又开始往上爬。“快告诉我我快到了，”她回头喊道。她只觉得空气越发稀薄，胳膊也越来越酸，快撑不住了。

paras.en: But Anna was only a couple of feet off the ground! Kristoff sighed and reached into his bag for climbing picks. “Hang on,” he said.
paras.zh: 可安娜离地面才不过几尺高！克里斯托夫叹了口气，伸手进背包去取攀冰镐。“稍等一下，”他说。

paras.en: “Not sure if this is going to solve the problem,” Olaf called from around the side of a snow boulder. “But I found a staircase that leads exactly where you want it to go.”
paras.zh: “不知道这能不能解决你们的问题，”雪宝在一块雪岩后面喊道。“不过我发现了一道楼梯，正好通向你们要去的地方！”

paras.en: Relief spread through Anna, and she dropped from her perch on the ice wall, yelling “Catch!” to Kristoff. She fell right into his arms. “Thanks,” she said, grinning. “That was like some crazy trust exercise!”
paras.zh: 安娜心头一松，从冰壁上的落脚处一跃而下，朝克里斯托夫喊了声“接住！”她不偏不倚落进他怀里。“谢了，”她咧嘴笑着说。“这简直像什么疯狂的信任考验！”

paras.en: The group formed a circle around a large rock formation, and there was Olaf, standing next to a shimmering frozen staircase. Looking up, they saw that it led to a huge and elaborate ice palace. Massive pillars of gleaming ice supported the structure, which was covered with a delicate pattern of crystalline snowflakes. Anna and Kristoff were awestruck.
paras.zh: 一行人围到一块巨大的岩架旁，雪宝正站在那儿，身边是一道熠熠生辉的冰砌阶梯。抬头望去，阶梯直通一座恢弘精美的冰宫。一根根巨大的冰柱晶莹剔透，支撑着整座宫殿，殿身上覆着精巧别致的雪花冰纹。安娜和克里斯托夫看得呆了。

paras.en: “Talk about cut, color, and clarity,” Kristoff said, admiring the ice. “I might cry.”
paras.zh: “瞧这切工、色泽、净度，简直没得挑，”克里斯托夫欣赏着冰说。“我都要哭了。”

paras.en: “Go ahead. I won’t judge,” Anna said.
paras.zh: “哭吧。我不笑话你，”安娜说。

paras.en: Anna approached the front door and pushed it open. She turned to Kristoff and Olaf and motioned for them to wait outside. She didn’t want to risk upsetting Elsa. “The last time I introduced her to a guy, she froze everything,” she explained. “Just give us a minute.”
paras.zh: 安娜走到大门前，把门推开。她转身面向克里斯托夫和雪宝，示意他们在外面等着。她不想冒险惹艾莎不快。“上次我给她介绍一个男生，她就把一切都冻住了，”她解释道。“给我们一点时间就好。”

paras.en: As soon as Anna left, Olaf began to count. “One, two, three, four…”
paras.zh: 安娜刚一进去，雪宝便开始数数。“一，二，三，四……”

chapters.title: 第十四章 · 冰雪宫殿

paras.en: Anna cautiously entered Elsa’s palace. She found herself in a huge room with an impressive winding staircase leading to a second floor. The palace was gorgeous, but it was absolutely still and eerily quiet.
paras.zh: 安娜小心翼翼地走进艾莎的宫殿。她发现自己置身于一间巨大的厅堂，一道气派的旋转楼梯蜿蜒而上，通向二层。宫殿美轮美奂，却是一片死寂，静得令人发怵。

paras.en: “Elsa?” Anna called nervously. “It’s me, Anna.”
paras.zh: “艾莎？”安娜紧张地喊道。“是我，安娜。”

paras.en: “Anna,” Elsa replied. Anna followed the sound of her sister’s voice and saw her at the top of the staircase. She was surprised by Elsa’s new appearance.
paras.zh: “安娜，”艾莎应道。安娜循着姐姐的声音走去，看见她正站在楼梯顶端。艾莎焕然一新的模样让她吃了一惊。

paras.en: “Elsa, you look beautiful,” she said. “And this place is amazing.”
paras.zh: “艾莎，你真美，”她说。“这地方也太了不起了。”

paras.en: Elsa smiled. “Thank you. I never knew what I was capable of.”
paras.zh: 艾莎微微一笑。“谢谢。我从来不知道自己竟有这般能耐。”

paras.en: Anna started up the stairs. “I’m sorry about what happened. If I’d known…”
paras.zh: 安娜开始往楼梯上走。“之前的事，我很抱歉。要是我当初知道……”

paras.en: “No, it’s okay,” said Elsa, backing away. “You don’t have to apologize. But you should probably go, please.”
paras.zh: “不，没关系的，”艾莎边说边往后退。“你不必道歉。不过，你还是请回吧。”

paras.en: Anna was startled. “But I just got here.”
paras.zh: 安娜吃了一惊。“可我刚到这儿呀。”

paras.en: “You belong in Arendelle,” Elsa explained. “I belong here. Alone. Where I can be who I am without hurting anybody.”
paras.zh: “你属于阿伦黛尔，”艾莎解释道。“而我属于这里。独自一人。在这里，我可以做回我自己，又不伤害任何人。”

paras.en: “Actually, about that—” Anna began. But Olaf ran in, interrupting her. The minute was up, and he couldn’t wait another second.
paras.zh: “其实，说到这个——”安娜刚要开口。可雪宝跑了进来，打断了她。一分钟已经到了，他一秒钟也等不下去了。

paras.en: “Wait,” said Elsa, wide-eyed. “What is that?”
paras.zh: “等等，”艾莎瞪大眼睛说。“那是什么？”

paras.en: Olaf ran up the staircase. “Hi, I’m Olaf, and I like warm hugs,” he said. Suddenly, the little snowman felt shy. “You built me,” he told Elsa. “You remember that?”
paras.zh: 雪宝跑上楼梯。“嗨，我是雪宝，我喜欢温暖的拥抱，”他说。忽然，小雪人害起羞来。“是你造了我，”他对艾莎说。“你还记得吗？”

paras.en: Elsa stared at him. “And you’re alive?” she asked in wonder. She looked at her hands, amazed at her own power.
paras.zh: 艾莎盯着他。“而且你还活了？”她满心惊奇地问。她低头看着自己的双手，为自己拥有的力量惊叹不已。

paras.en: “I think so,” Olaf replied.
paras.zh: “我想是的，”雪宝答道。

paras.en: “He’s just like the one we built as kids,” Anna said. “We were so close. We can be like that again.”
paras.zh: “他跟咱们小时候堆的那个一模一样，”安娜说。“那时候我们多亲密啊。我们还能像从前那样。”

paras.en: More than anything, Elsa wanted that to be true. But the white streak in Anna’s hair was a constant reminder of that night long ago when she hit Anna with her dangerous powers.
paras.zh: 艾莎比谁都渴望这是真的。可安娜发间的那缕白发，无时无刻不在提醒她：很久以前那个夜里，她曾用危险的力量击中了安娜。

paras.en: Elsa turned and headed back upstairs. “No, we can’t,” she said. “Goodbye, Anna.”
paras.zh: 艾莎转过身，朝楼上走去。“不，我们做不到，”她说。“再见了，安娜。”

paras.en: “Elsa, wait!” Anna said. “Please don’t shut me out again.”
paras.zh: “艾莎，等等！”安娜说。“求你别再把我关在门外了。”

paras.en: Anna ran to the upper floor and tried to reason with her sister. Now that Elsa’s secret was out, Anna thought they could be happy together for the first time in forever.
paras.zh: 安娜跑上楼，想好好跟姐姐讲讲道理。艾莎的秘密既然已经公开，安娜觉得，她们终于可以第一次在一起快快乐乐地过日子了。

paras.en: But it wasn’t that simple for Elsa. She was sure no one in Arendelle would ever accept her again. She couldn’t hide her powers anymore—and she didn’t want to! What if she injured someone? What if she hurt Anna? Elsa felt that if she could just keep to herself, no one would be hurt by her magic. But there was something Elsa didn’t know.
paras.zh: 可这对艾莎来说，远没有那么简单。她确信，阿伦黛尔再也不会有人接纳她了。她再也无法隐藏自己的力量——而且她也不想藏了！万一她伤到什么人怎么办？万一她伤到安娜怎么办？艾莎觉得，只要她独来独往，就不会有人被她的魔法所伤。可有一件事，艾莎并不知道。

paras.en: “You kind of set off an eternal winter everywhere,” Anna said.
paras.zh: “你算是把四面八方都变成了永恒的寒冬，”安娜说。

paras.en: “Everywhere?” said Elsa, shaken by the news.
paras.zh: “四面八方？”艾莎听到这消息，大为震骇。

paras.en: Anna wanted to be encouraging. “It’s okay, you can just unfreeze it.”
paras.zh: 安娜想给她打打气。“没事的，你只要把冰解冻就好啦。”

paras.en: Elsa looked away. “No, I can’t. I don’t know how,” she admitted.
paras.zh: 艾莎移开了目光。“不，我做不到。我不知道该怎么做，”她坦言。

paras.en: Anna wasn’t worried. “Sure, you can. I know you can.” Anna ran to her sister. She was sure they could work it out.
paras.zh: 安娜一点儿也不担心。“你当然做得到。我知道你做得到。”安娜朝姐姐跑了过去。她坚信，她们一定能一起把问题解决。

paras.en: For her part, Elsa was having trouble keeping her emotions under control. The news that she had accidentally put Arendelle into a deep freeze was very hard to bear. Maybe she was the monster that people thought she was. The walls of the palace started to ice over. Elsa wanted to get away from Anna. She backed farther up the stairs, and the banister frosted over as she passed.
paras.zh: 而艾莎这边，她的情绪已快要控制不住了。得知自己竟在不知不觉间把阿伦黛尔封进了冰天雪地，这让她难以承受。或许，她真的就是人们心目中的那个怪物。宫殿的四壁开始结起冰来。艾莎只想离安娜远远的。她一步步退上楼梯，扶手在她经过之处结满了霜。

paras.en: But Anna kept pressing Elsa. “Everything will be all right,” she insisted.
paras.zh: 可安娜仍不肯罢休。“一切都会好起来的，”她坚持道。

paras.en: Elsa was torn. She did want to go home, she did want everything to be fine, but it just wasn’t possible! Frustrated and upset, she exclaimed, “I can’t!”
paras.zh: 艾莎内心撕裂般地纠结。她的确想回家，的确盼着一切如常，可那根本不可能！又沮丧又难过，她喊道：“我做不到！”

paras.en: With those words, Elsa’s bottled-up emotions rose to the surface. A wave of icy magic was released from her body, and it struck Anna right in the chest! Anna fell backward as Elsa gasped.
paras.zh: 话音一落，艾莎压抑已久的情绪翻涌上来。一股冰冷的魔力从她体内迸发而出，正中安娜的胸口！安娜向后倒去，艾莎倒吸一口凉气。

paras.en: Olaf ran to Anna and helped her stand up. Kristoff entered the room and ran to Anna, as well.
paras.zh: 雪宝跑向安娜，扶她站了起来。克里斯托夫也走进厅来，朝安娜奔去。

paras.en: “I’m okay,” she said bravely. “I’m fine.”
paras.zh: “我没事，”她故作镇定地说。“我很好。”

paras.en: “I told you to stay away!” said Elsa in horror.
paras.zh: “我让你离我远点的！”艾莎惊恐地说。

paras.en: “No, I’m not giving up,” Anna said. “I know we can figure this out together.”
paras.zh: “不，我不会放弃的，”安娜说。“我知道我们一定能一起想出办法。”

paras.en: “How?” Elsa shouted. “What power do you have to stop this winter? To stop me?”
paras.zh: “怎么想？”艾莎厉声喊道。“你有什么力量能挡住这场寒冬？挡住我？”

paras.en: “I don’t know,” Anna said, tears welling up in her eyes. “But I’m not leaving without you!”
paras.zh: “我不知道，”安娜说，眼里涌起泪水。“可没有你，我绝不离开！”

paras.en: Heartbroken, Elsa looked at her sister. “Yes,” she said. “You are.” She waved a hand, and magic shimmered in the air. Suddenly, a giant snowman rose from the floor, conjured by her powers. The snowman grew and grew, until he towered over Anna and her friends.
paras.zh: 艾莎心如刀绞，望着妹妹。“会的，”她说。“你会走的。”她一挥手，空气中魔法粼粼闪动。忽然，一个巨大的雪人从地上升起——那是她用魔力召唤出来的。雪人越长越大，直到高高俯视着安娜和她的伙伴们。

paras.en: “You made me a little brother!” Olaf exclaimed happily. He turned to the huge creature. “I’m going to name you Marshmallow!”
paras.zh: “你给我造了个弟弟！”雪宝开心地叫道。他转向那个庞然大物。“我要给你起名叫棉花糖！”

chapters.title: 第十五章 · 雪怪逐客

paras.en: Marshmallow grabbed the unwanted visitors and tossed them down the icy steps. “Go home!” roared the snowman.
paras.zh: 棉花糖一把抓住这些不速之客，把他们甩下冰冷的台阶。“回家去！”雪怪吼道。

paras.en: But Olaf remained in Marshmallow’s arms, having come apart with all the jostling. “You are a lot stronger than I think you realize,” he told the snow giant.
paras.zh: 可雪宝经这一路折腾早散了架，还留在棉花糖怀里。“你可比我以为的强壮多啦，”他对雪巨人说。

paras.en: Marshmallow howled and threw Olaf, one piece at a time, down the mountain.
paras.zh: 棉花糖嚎叫一声，把雪宝一块一块地扔下山去。

paras.en: “Heads up!” Olaf’s head shouted as it soared past Anna and Kristoff.
paras.zh: “小心头顶！”雪宝的脑袋一边飞过安娜和克里斯托夫，一边喊道。

paras.en: The head crashed into a snowbank.
paras.zh: 脑袋砰地砸进一个雪堆。

paras.en: “Olaf!” cried Anna, racing over to Olaf’s head.
paras.zh: “雪宝！”安娜叫着，朝雪宝的脑袋奔过去。

paras.en: “Watch out for my butt!” he warned.
paras.zh: “当心我的屁股！”他警告道。

paras.en: Anna and Kristoff jumped out of the way just as the rest of Olaf’s body slammed into the snowbank.
paras.zh: 安娜和克里斯托夫慌忙跳开，雪宝身体的其他部分紧跟着砸进了雪堆。

paras.en: Anna picked up a handful of snow and molded it into a ball. Then she flung it at the huge snowman. “It’s not nice to throw people!” she shouted angrily.
paras.zh: 安娜抓起一把雪，揉成一个雪球。接着她把雪球朝那座大雪人掷去。“拿人乱扔可没礼貌！”她气呼呼地喊。

paras.en: Marshmallow roared—and charged after them!
paras.zh: 棉花糖怒吼一声——朝他们直冲过来！

paras.en: “All right, feisty-pants,” Kristoff said to Anna. “Now you made him mad!”
paras.zh: “好了，暴脾气小妞，”克里斯托夫对安娜说。“这下你可把他惹毛了！”

paras.en: “I’ll distract him,” Olaf said. “You guys go!”
paras.zh: “我来引开他，”雪宝说。“你们快走！”

paras.en: Olaf’s belly and butt took off in opposite directions. “No, not you guys!” he yelled to the two body balls, then sighed. “This just got a lot harder.”
paras.zh: 雪宝的肚皮和屁股朝相反的两个方向跑开了。“不，不是叫你们俩！”他朝那两截身体球大喊，随即叹了口气。“这下可难办多了。”

paras.en: Anna and Kristoff slid down the mountain. When they reached the bottom, Marshmallow was already there!
paras.zh: 安娜和克里斯托夫顺着山坡往下滑。等他们滑到山脚，棉花糖竟已经等在那儿了！

paras.en: “Look out!” Kristoff called.
paras.zh: “小心！”克里斯托夫喊道。

paras.en: They quickly got up and ran through a maze of trees and snowbanks, with Marshmallow close behind them.
paras.zh: 两人赶紧爬起来，在树木与雪堆交织的迷宫中狂奔，棉花糖紧追在后。

paras.en: “This way!” Anna shouted. She grabbed a stick and knocked the heavy snow off a tree. With the extra weight lifted, the tree snapped upright and knocked Marshmallow back. Anna and Kristoff laughed and ran ahead of the snowman. But Marshmallow was not giving up.
paras.zh: “这边！”安娜喊道。她抓起一根树枝，把树上沉甸甸的积雪打落。卸去额外的重量，树梢猛地弹直，把棉花糖撞了回去。安娜和克里斯托夫笑着跑到了雪怪前头。可棉花糖不肯罢休。

paras.en: Anna and Kristoff continued to run until they reached the edge of a steep cliff.
paras.zh: 安娜和克里斯托夫一路狂奔，直到一处陡峭悬崖的边缘。

paras.en: “Whoa, stop!” Kristoff yelled.
paras.zh: “哇，停！”克里斯托夫大喊。

paras.en: Anna peered over the edge. “It’s a hundred-foot drop,” she said.
paras.zh: 安娜探身朝崖下望去。“足有一百英尺深呢，”她说。

paras.en: “It’s two hundred,” he countered. Taking a rope, Kristoff tied a loop around Anna’s waist. Then he dug a U shape in the snow.
paras.zh: “是两百，”他纠正道。克里斯托夫取过一根绳子，在安娜腰间打了个活套。接着他在雪地里挖出一个 U 形。

paras.en: “What’s that for?” Anna asked.
paras.zh: “那是干什么用的？”安娜问。

paras.en: “I’m digging a snow anchor,” Kristoff told her.
paras.zh: “我在挖一个雪锚，”克里斯托夫告诉她。

paras.en: “Okay. What if we fall?” Anna said. She looked over the edge again.
paras.zh: “好吧。要是我们掉下去呢？”安娜说。她又朝崖下望了一眼。

paras.en: “There’s twenty feet of fresh powder down there,” he answered. “It’ll be like landing on a pillow.” He paused, and then added, “Hopefully.”
paras.zh: “底下有二十英尺厚的蓬松新雪，”他答道。“落上去就像掉在枕头上一样。”他顿了顿，又补了一句：“但愿吧。”

paras.en: Anna’s eyes widened.
paras.zh: 安娜睁大了眼睛。

paras.en: Kristoff tied off the rope in the snow anchor. “Okay, Anna,” he said. “On three…”
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫把绳头牢牢固定在雪锚上。“好了，安娜，”他说。“数到三……”

paras.en: Anna moved closer to the edge.
paras.zh: 安娜挪近崖边。

paras.en: “One, two…,” Kristoff counted. Just then, a tree sailed through the air. Marshmallow had thrown it at them!
paras.zh: “一，二……”克里斯托夫数着。就在这时，一棵树从空中飞来。是棉花糖把它朝他们掷了过来！

paras.en: “Tree!” Anna yelled. She jumped over the cliff, pulling Kristoff with her.
paras.zh: “树！”安娜大喊。她纵身跃下悬崖，顺手把克里斯托夫也拽了下去。

paras.en: “What? Whoa!” Kristoff hollered as the two plummeted. Seconds later, the rope caught their fall and they were dangling in midair.
paras.zh: “什么？哇啊！”两人急速坠落，克里斯托夫大叫。几秒之后，绳子拽住了下坠的他们，两人悬在了半空中。

paras.en: At that moment, Olaf emerged from the trees, a complete mess. His body parts were in the wrong order as he staggered toward the cliff.
paras.zh: 就在此时，雪宝从树林里钻了出来，一副狼狈不堪的模样。他踉踉跄跄地朝悬崖走去，身上的零件全都装错了位置。

paras.en: “Oh, man, I am out of shape,” he mumbled, winded from the chase. He quickly put himself back together properly. “There we go,” he said. “Hey, Anna! Kristoff! Where’d you guys go?” He searched all around. “We totally lost Marshmallow back there!”
paras.zh: “噢，天哪，我可真是不中用了，”他跑得气喘吁吁，嘟囔着。他很快把自己重新拼好了。“这下对了，”他说。“嘿，安娜！克里斯托夫！你们俩跑哪儿去了？”他四下张望。“我们把棉花糖彻底甩在后面啦！”

paras.en: Marshmallow stepped forward and stood behind Olaf.
paras.zh: 棉花糖迈步上前，站到了雪宝身后。

paras.en: Olaf peered up and smiled. “Hey, we were just talking about you,” he said. “All good things, all good things,” he quickly added.
paras.zh: 雪宝抬头一看，笑了。“嘿，我们刚才正说到你呢，”他说。“说的都是好话，都是好话，”他连忙补了一句。

paras.en: The big snowman roared and went for the snow anchor that held Kristoff and Anna. Olaf took action and jumped onto Marshmallow’s leg. “No!” he shouted. Realizing he was no match for the giant, Olaf shrugged. “This is not making much of a difference, is it?”
paras.zh: 大雪人吼了一声，扑向拴着克里斯托夫和安娜的雪锚。雪宝挺身而出，跳上棉花糖的腿。“不许！”他喊道。雪宝自知不是这巨人的对手，耸了耸肩。“这么着也没多大用，是吧？”

paras.en: Marshmallow shook off the little snowman and kicked him over the edge of the cliff. Olaf flew past the dangling Anna and Kristoff.
paras.zh: 棉花糖甩开小雪人，一脚把他踢下了悬崖。雪宝从悬在半空的安娜和克里斯托夫身边飞过。

paras.en: “Hang in there, guys!” he called.
paras.zh: “坚持住，伙计们！”他喊道。

paras.en: A tug on the rope told Anna and Kristoff that Marshmallow was pulling them back up to the ledge! They started spinning out of control. Kristoff reached down for Anna and hit his head on the cliff.
paras.zh: 绳子猛地一拽，安娜和克里斯托夫明白过来——棉花糖正把他们往崖顶拉回去！他们开始失控地打起转来。克里斯托夫伸手去够安娜，头却撞上了崖壁。

paras.en: “Ugh!” he shouted.
paras.zh: “哎哟！”他叫道。

paras.en: Marshmallow pulled them almost to the top. “Don’t come back!” he bellowed.
paras.zh: 棉花糖把他们拉到几乎就要够着崖顶。“别再回来了！”他咆哮道。

paras.en: “We won’t!” Anna answered. She reached up and cut the rope with a knife. She and Kristoff fell down, down, down…and landed in a deep pile of soft snow.
paras.zh: “我们不会的！”安娜答道。她探身向上，用刀割断了绳子。她和克里斯托夫往下坠，坠，坠……最后落进一大堆松软的雪里。

paras.en: Suddenly, everything was quiet. “Hey, you were right,” Anna said, sitting up and shaking the snow out of her hair. “Just like a pillow!” She looked over and saw Olaf.
paras.zh: 忽然，四周一片安静。“嘿，你说对了，”安娜坐起身，抖落头发里的雪。“真像掉在枕头上一样！”她转头一看，看见了雪宝。

paras.en: “I can’t feel my legs!” Olaf screamed, panicking as he stared at two feet coming through the snow in front of him. “I can’t feel my legs!”
paras.zh: “我的腿没知觉了！”雪宝盯着身前雪里伸出的两只脚，慌了神，尖声叫道。“我的腿没知觉了！”

paras.en: “That’s because those are my legs,” Kristoff said, sitting up just behind Olaf.
paras.zh: “那是因为那是我的腿，”克里斯托夫说着，在雪宝身后坐了起来。

paras.en: Suddenly, Olaf’s lower body came running over. “Oh, hey,” Olaf said to Kristoff. “Do me a favor and grab my butt.”
paras.zh: 忽然，雪宝的下半身跑了过来。“噢，嘿，”雪宝对克里斯托夫说。“帮个忙，抓住我的屁股。”

paras.en: Kristoff took Olaf’s chatty head and slammed it onto his body.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫抓起雪宝那张喋喋不休的脑袋，啪地按回他的身体上。

paras.en: “Oh, that feels better,” Olaf said happily.
paras.zh: “噢，这下舒服多了，”雪宝开心地说。

paras.en: Sven walked over and sniffed Olaf’s carrot nose.
paras.zh: 斯文走了过来，嗅了嗅雪宝的胡萝卜鼻子。

paras.en: “Hey, Sven!” Olaf greeted the reindeer and then turned toward Anna and Kristoff just before Sven could bite the carrot. “He found us!” He looked back at Sven. “Who’s my cute little reindeer?” he cooed.
paras.zh: “嘿，斯文！”雪宝跟驯鹿打了个招呼，趁斯文还没咬到胡萝卜，赶紧转向安娜和克里斯托夫。“他找到我们啦！”他又回头看着斯文。“谁是我可爱的小驯鹿呀？”他柔声逗弄着。

paras.en: Kristoff pulled Olaf away from Sven. “Don’t talk to him like that.”
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫把雪宝从斯文身边拉开。“别那样跟它说话。”

paras.en: Then Kristoff went to help Anna. “You okay?” he asked, pulling her out of the snow.
paras.zh: 接着克里斯托夫去扶安娜。“你还好吧？”他把她从雪里拉出来，问道。

paras.en: “Whoa! Strong man,” Anna said. “Okay, thank you.” Anna’s and Kristoff’s eyes met. They held the gaze for a long moment and then looked away.
paras.zh: “哇！好力气啊，”安娜说。“好啦，谢谢你。”安娜和克里斯托夫四目相对。他们注视彼此良久，才各自移开了目光。

paras.en: “How’s your head?” Anna asked. She touched the spot where Kristoff had banged his head on the cliff.
paras.zh: “你的头怎么样？”安娜问。她碰了碰克里斯托夫方才撞上崖壁的地方。

paras.en: “Ow!” he shouted. “I mean…it’s fine. I’ve got a thick skull.”
paras.zh: “嗷！”他叫道。“我是说……没事。我的脑袋壳硬着呢。”

paras.en: Anna giggled.
paras.zh: 安娜咯咯笑了起来。

paras.en: “I don’t have a skull,” Olaf remarked. “Or bones.”
paras.zh: “我可没有脑壳，”雪宝插嘴道。“也没有骨头。”

paras.en: “So now what?” Kristoff asked Anna.
paras.zh: “那现在怎么办？”克里斯托夫问安娜。

paras.en: The question sent Anna into a panic. “I don’t know! What am I going to do? Elsa threw me out, I can’t go back to Arendelle with the weather like this, and then there’s your ice business.…”
paras.zh: 这一问让安娜慌了神。“我不知道！我该怎么办？艾莎把我赶了出来，这样的天气我又回不了阿伦黛尔，何况你还有你的采冰生意……”

paras.en: Kristoff felt bad for Anna, but he knew panicking wouldn’t help. He tried to steer her back to their current situation. “Hey, don’t worry about my ice business,” he told her. “Worry about your hair.”
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫替安娜难过，但他知道慌张无济于事。他试着把她的思绪拉回眼前的处境。“嘿，别操心我的采冰生意，”他对她说。“操心操心你的头发吧。”

paras.en: Anna’s hands flew to her head and she tried to smooth down her hair. “What? I just fell off a cliff,” she said. “You should see your hair.”
paras.zh: 安娜的手立刻捂上脑袋，想把头发抚平。“什么？我刚从悬崖上摔下来，”她说。“你该看看你的头发。”

paras.en: “No, yours is turning white,” he said, concerned.
paras.zh: “不，是你的头发正在变白，”他忧心地说。

paras.en: “White?” Anna cried. She grabbed her long braid just as another section of hair lost its color.
paras.zh: “变白？”安娜叫道。她一把抓住自己的长辫子，偏偏又有一绺头发正在褪去颜色。

paras.en: “It’s because she struck you with her powers, isn’t it?” Kristoff asked.
paras.zh: “那是因为她用魔力击中了你，对不对？”克里斯托夫问。

paras.en: “Does it look bad?”
paras.zh: “看起来很糟吗？”

paras.en: Kristoff thought for a moment. “No,” he said.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫想了想。“不，”他说。

paras.en: Olaf popped up. “You hesitated,” he said.
paras.zh: 雪宝突然探出头来。“你犹豫了，”他说。

paras.en: “No, I didn’t,” Kristoff said. He knew that Anna needed help. And he knew where to go—and who to ask. “Come on.”
paras.zh: “没有，我没有，”克里斯托夫说。他知道安娜需要帮助。他也知道该去哪儿——该去求谁。“走吧。”

paras.en: “Okay! Where are we going?” Olaf asked.
paras.zh: “好呀！我们要去哪儿？”雪宝问。

paras.en: “To see my friends,” Kristoff said.
paras.zh: “去见我的朋友们，”克里斯托夫说。

paras.en: Anna’s eyebrows rose up. “The love experts?”
paras.zh: 安娜扬起了眉毛。“恋爱专家？”

paras.en: Olaf was surprised. “Love experts?”
paras.zh: 雪宝吃了一惊。“恋爱专家？”

paras.en: “Yes,” Kristoff answered. “They’ll be able to fix this.”
paras.zh: “对，”克里斯托夫答道。“他们准能解决这个。”

paras.en: Anna followed Kristoff and Sven, with Olaf trailing behind. “How can you be so sure?” she asked.
paras.zh: 安娜跟着克里斯托夫和斯文，雪宝殿后。“你怎么这么确定？”她问。

paras.en: “Because I’ve seen them do it before.”
paras.zh: “因为我以前见过他们解决这种事。”

paras.en: “I like to consider myself a love expert,” Olaf said sweetly.
paras.zh: “我倒觉得，我自己就算得上一个恋爱专家，”雪宝甜甜地说。

chapters.title: 第十六章 · 冰封的阿伦黛尔

paras.en: Far down the mountain in Arendelle, the air was still frigid and snow blanketed the land. People wondered if warm weather would ever return. The fjord was frozen solid, and all the dignitaries who had arrived for Elsa’s coronation were forced to stay since their ships were stuck. In the meantime, men and women were working hard to unload supplies from the marooned boats and haul them to the castle, where they could be stored and distributed.
paras.zh: 山下的阿伦黛尔，空气依旧寒气刺骨，白雪覆盖着大地。人们都在想，温暖的天气究竟还能不能回来。峡湾冻得结结实实，前来参加艾莎加冕礼的各国贵宾都被困在了这里，因为他们的船全被冻住了。与此同时，男男女女正忙着从搁浅的船上卸下物资，再搬运到城堡里存放、分发。

paras.en: Hans moved through the crowded village, handing out heavy cloaks. “Who needs a cloak?” he asked. “The castle is open. There’s soup and hot glogg in the Great Hall,” he said, referring to a special drink of hot wine.
paras.zh: 汉斯在拥挤的村子里穿行，给人们分发厚实的斗篷。“谁需要斗篷？”他问。“城堡大门敞开着。大厅里有热汤，还有热格罗格酒。”他说。格罗格是一种特制的热葡萄酒。

paras.en: “Arendelle is indebted to you, Your Highness,” a woman said.
paras.zh: “阿伦黛尔欠您一份人情，殿下。”一位妇女说。

paras.en: The Duke approached. “Prince Hans!” he said. “Are we just expected to sit here and freeze while you give away all of Arendelle’s tradeable goods?”
paras.zh: 这时，公爵走了过来。“汉斯王子！”他说。“难道就让我们坐在这儿挨冻，眼睁睁看着你把阿伦黛尔所有能交易的物资都白白送出去吗？”

paras.en: “Calm yourself,” counseled Hans. “Princess Anna has given her orders.”
paras.zh: “冷静点。”汉斯劝道。“安娜公主已经下了命令。”

paras.en: The Duke went on. “Has it dawned on you that your princess may be conspiring with a wicked sorceress to destroy us all?”
paras.zh: 公爵却不住口。“你难道还没想到，你的公主也许正和一个邪恶的女巫串通，要把我们全都毁掉吗？”

paras.en: “Do not question the princess,” Hans responded forcefully. “She left me in charge, and I will not hesitate to protect Arendelle from treason.”
paras.zh: “休要质疑公主。”汉斯强硬地回道。“她把这里交给我掌管，而我会毫不犹豫地保护阿伦黛尔，防范任何叛国行径。”

paras.en: The Duke was put in his place. “Treason? No, I—I…,” he stuttered.
paras.zh: 公爵被噎得哑口无言。“叛国？不，我——我……”他结结巴巴地说。

paras.en: Hans didn’t have a chance to reply. At that moment, Anna’s horse galloped into the village square.
paras.zh: 汉斯还没来得及答话。就在这时，安娜的坐骑飞奔进了村庄广场。

paras.en: “Whoa!” Hans called to the horse, catching his reins. “Easy, easy.”
paras.zh: “吁！”汉斯朝马儿喊道，一把抓住了缰绳。“慢点，慢点。”

paras.en: “Princess Anna’s horse!” a man shouted. “What happened to her? Where is she?”
paras.zh: “是安娜公主的马！”有人大喊。“她出什么事了？她在哪儿？”

paras.en: Panic grew among the villagers. Hans looked toward the North Mountain. “Princess Anna is in trouble!” he cried. “I need volunteers to go with me to find her.”
paras.zh: 恐慌在村民中间蔓延开来。汉斯望向北山。“安娜公主有难！”他喊道。“我需要志愿者随我一同去找她。”

paras.en: A number of men immediately stepped forward. The Duke ordered his two huge guards to join the search party as well. But he gave them a little advice before they left.
paras.zh: 当即就有好几名男子挺身而出。公爵也命令他那两名彪形卫士加入搜寻队。可临行前，他还给了他们一点叮嘱。

paras.en: “Should you encounter the queen,” the Duke told his men quietly, “be prepared to put an end to this winter. Do you understand?”
paras.zh: “万一你们遇上女王，”公爵低声对部下说，“就要准备好终结这场寒冬。明白吗？”

paras.en: The men nodded and smiled. They enjoyed a good fight.
paras.zh: 两人点头，脸上露出笑意。他们就爱痛痛快快地打上一架。

paras.en: Soon they all trailed Hans across the frozen fjord and up into the mountains.
paras.zh: 很快，他们一行人跟着汉斯越过冰封的峡湾，向大山进发。

paras.en: In her ice palace at the top of the mountain, Elsa looked out the window and felt her own panic rising. She hadn’t meant to hit Anna with her magic, and she wished she could take it back.
paras.zh: 在山顶的冰雪宫殿里，艾莎望着窗外，心中的慌乱也渐渐升起。她并非存心用魔法击中安娜，真希望一切还能收回。

paras.en: “Get it together,” she told herself, trying to use all those strategies her parents had taught her years ago. “Control it. Don’t feel, don’t feel.”
paras.zh: “镇定下来。”她对自己说，努力用上父母多年前教她的那些法子。“控制住它。不要去感受，不要去感受。”

paras.en: Just then, ice cracked behind her. Looking around, she realized a trail of ice had formed behind her—and it was going up the wall!
paras.zh: 就在这时，她身后传来冰层碎裂的声音。她环顾四周，才发现身后已经结出一道冰痕——而且正顺着墙壁往上爬！

paras.en: Frightened, she gave a sharp cry and continued working to keep herself under control. “Don’t feel. Don’t feel. DON’T FEEL!”
paras.zh: 惊恐之下，她发出一声尖叫，仍拼命让自己保持镇定。“不要去感受。不要去感受。不要去感受！”

paras.en: The ice on the floor began to change and grow into a series of sharp spikes. Alarmed, she glanced out the window. The wind was rising as the weather whipped up to match her feelings of worry.
paras.zh: 地面上的冰开始变化，长出一排排锋利的尖刺。她惊慌地朝窗外瞥了一眼。风势渐起，天气也随着她心中的忧虑愈发狂暴。

paras.en: Hans and his volunteers made their way through the snowy woods and braved the steep incline of the North Mountain. Some were on horseback, while others walked. Many of them carried torches and swords. The Duke’s guards carried crossbows.
paras.zh: 汉斯和志愿者们穿过白雪皑皑的树林，冒着风雪攀上北山陡峭的山坡。有人骑马，有人步行。他们中许多人举着火把，佩着长剑。公爵的两名卫士则带着弩。

paras.en: All around them, the storm was growing worse.
paras.zh: 四周的风雪愈演愈烈。

paras.en: At the top of mountain, Hans led the group around the rocky cliffs, and eventually they came upon the ice palace. He turned to the men as they all gaped at the spectacular structure. “We’re here to find Princess Anna,” he reminded them. “Be on guard, but no harm is to come to the queen.”
paras.zh: 到了山顶，汉斯领着众人在嶙峋的崖壁间绕行，终于望见了那座冰雪宫殿。众人望着这壮观的宫殿目瞪口呆，他转过身来。“我们是来找安娜公主的。”他提醒道。“务必警戒，但绝不能伤害女王。”

paras.en: Suddenly, a mass of snow rose from the ground behind Hans. It was Marshmallow! The huge snowman refused to move away from the palace entrance. As the volunteers pressed forward, Marshmallow reacted quickly, knocking men to the ground. Hans rolled to safety and grabbed his sword.
paras.zh: 忽然，汉斯身后腾起一大团雪。那是棉花糖！巨大的雪人死守着宫殿入口，说什么也不肯挪步。志愿者们向前逼近，棉花糖反应迅速，把众人一个个掀翻在地。汉斯就地一滚，脱身抓起自己的剑。

paras.en: Then Elsa, still upset from Anna’s visit, stepped out onto her balcony to see what was happening. She was spotted by one of the Duke’s guards. They ducked around Marshmallow’s legs, raced into the palace, and charged up the stairs.
paras.zh: 这时，仍因安娜的到访而心烦意乱的艾莎走上阳台，想看看外面发生了什么。公爵的一名卫士发现了她。两名卫士绕过棉花糖的腿，冲进宫殿，沿着楼梯一路直奔上去。

paras.en: “Stay back!” Elsa warned. She didn’t want her powers to hurt anyone. The men had their crossbows aimed at her. She held up her arms and summoned a wall of ice for protection.
paras.zh: “退后！”艾莎警告道。她不想让自己的魔力伤到任何人。那两人已将弩瞄准了她。她举起双臂，召出一道冰墙护住自己。

paras.en: But the Duke’s guards kept coming. Desperate to keep them away, she waved her arms, and the wall of ice forced one of the attackers onto the balcony. He teetered on the edge, trapped.
paras.zh: 可公爵的卫士仍步步紧逼。她急着想把他们逼退，挥动手臂，冰墙将其中一名攻击者逼到了阳台上。他摇摇晃晃地立在边缘，被困住了。

paras.en: The other guard was still coming after Elsa, with his crossbow ready to shoot. With another wave, Elsa created a series of icy spikes, pinning the man in place against the wall. The spikes came right up to his jaw, barely allowing him to breathe.
paras.zh: 另一名卫士仍紧追着艾莎不放，弩已搭箭，随时准备射出。艾莎又是一挥，造出一排冰刺，将那人死死钉在墙上。冰刺直逼他的下颌，让他几乎透不过气。

paras.en: Outside the palace, Hans and his fighters continued to battle the powerful snowman. Hans swept Marshmallow’s leg with his sword, forcing the snow giant to fall. Marshmallow rolled away and off a cliff. Hans and his men raced into the ice palace.
paras.zh: 宫殿外，汉斯和他的部下仍在与那强大的雪人缠斗。汉斯挥剑扫向棉花糖的腿，把雪巨人掀倒在地。棉花糖打着滚，摔下了悬崖。汉斯带着部下冲进了冰雪宫殿。

paras.en: There, he immediately spotted the guard trapped against the wall and the other one pushed to the very edge of the balcony. The man was just inches from falling to his death!
paras.zh: 一进去，他就看见了被钉在墙上的卫士，以及另一名被逼到阳台最边缘的人。那人离坠下阳台丧命只差毫厘！

paras.en: “Queen Elsa, no, please!” Hans called out. “Don’t be the monster they fear you are!”
paras.zh: “艾莎女王，不，求您！”汉斯喊道。“别成为他们惧怕的那个怪物！”

paras.en: Elsa saw the fright in the guard’s eyes and hesitated. With a start, she realized she had gone too far; this was exactly what she had worked so long to avoid. As she looked down at her hands, the wall of ice retreated. She had always tried to keep people safe, not put them in more danger—and now her self-control seemed to be dissolving entirely.
paras.zh: 艾莎望见卫士眼中的恐惧，迟疑了。她猛然惊觉自己做得太过了——这正是她长久以来竭力避免的事。她低头看着自己的双手，冰墙缓缓退去。她向来只想护人周全，而非把人推向更深的险境——可如今，她的自制力仿佛正在彻底崩塌。

paras.en: But as the icy spikes melted away from the Duke’s other guard, he aimed his crossbow at Elsa. Hans acted quickly. He pushed the man’s crossbow aside, causing it to shoot at the ceiling. The loose arrow hit the chandelier above Elsa, sending it crashing to the floor. Shards of ice through the air…and Elsa fell, knocked unconscious.
paras.zh: 可当冰刺从公爵另一名卫士身上消融时，他却把弩对准了艾莎。汉斯迅速出手。他一把推开那人的弩，弩箭射向了天花板。那支脱弦的箭击中了艾莎头顶的水晶吊灯，吊灯应声砸落在地。冰屑在空中飞散……艾莎倒了下去，不省人事。

paras.en: Hours later, Elsa’s eyes fluttered open. She was in a stone room with one tiny window high on the wall letting a cold light into the room. Elsa rose from the bench where she lay—and realized that she could not bring her arms forward. Her hands were encased in thick coverings, which were connected to long chains and bolted to the floor. She could see out the window well enough, though, to know that she was back in Arendelle. She was imprisoned in the castle dungeon and could see the snow continuing to fall over the kingdom.
paras.zh: 几个小时后，艾莎的眼睫颤动着，缓缓睁开。她置身于一间石室，高高的墙上开了一扇小窗，透进一缕凄冷的光。艾莎从躺着的长凳上起身——却发现自己没法把双臂拢到身前。她的双手被裹在厚厚的套子里，套子连着长长的铁链，钉死在地板上。不过，透过窗口望出去，她足以辨认出自己又回到了阿伦黛尔。她被囚禁在城堡的地牢里，望着大雪依旧飘落在王国上空。

paras.en: “No!” Elsa cried, looking out at her frozen kingdom. “What have I done?”
paras.zh: “不！”艾莎望着自己冰封的王国，哭喊道。“我到底做了些什么？”

chapters.title: 第十七章 · 极光引路

paras.en: Kristoff and Sven led Anna and Olaf through a rocky area of the mountains, weaving through valleys and hills. Darkness had fallen, but the northern lights lit the sky with a green glow. Anna hoped Kristoff’s friends wouldn’t mind that they were stopping by so late.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫和斯文领着安娜和雪宝，在山区一片岩石嶙峋的地带穿行，绕过一道道山谷与山丘。夜幕已经降临，但北极光用一抹绿色的微光点亮了天空。安娜希望，他们这么晚才来投宿，克里斯托夫的朋友们不会介意。

paras.en: Kristoff could see that Anna was shivering. “Are you cold?” he asked.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫看得出安娜在发抖。“你冷吗？”他问。

paras.en: Anna grinned. “I’m fine.” It made Anna feel better that Kristoff was concerned about her.
paras.zh: 安娜咧嘴一笑。“我没事。”克里斯托夫对她的关心，让安娜心里好受了许多。

paras.en: “Good,” said Kristoff, coming to a halt. “Well, we made it. Meet my friends. They’re more like family, actually.”
paras.zh: “很好。”克里斯托夫说着，停下了脚步。“好了，我们到了。来见见我的朋友们。其实，他们更像是家人。”

paras.en: Anna looked around, confused. It was a valley of rocks. “They’re rocks,” she pointed out.
paras.zh: 安娜环顾四周，一脸困惑。这是一片遍布岩石的山谷。“它们只是石头啊。”她指出。

paras.en: “They’re love experts,” Olaf said.
paras.zh: “它们是爱情专家。”雪宝说。

paras.en: “They’re experts on everything, really,” Kristoff explained. He looked very serious.
paras.zh: “说真的，它们什么都是专家。”克里斯托夫解释道。他神情十分认真。

paras.en: Anna thought Kristoff had lost his mind. She started to back away. “Right. Well, thank you for your help, but I’m thinking I’m going to go. Now. Right now.”
paras.zh: 安娜觉得克里斯托夫大概是疯了。她开始往后退。“嗯，好吧。谢谢你的帮忙，不过我想我得走了。现在。马上就走。”

paras.en: Suddenly, rocks began to roll toward them. Strange voices called out, saying, “Kristoff’s home! Kristoff’s home!” As Anna watched, the rocks rose from the ground one after another and transformed into trolls. Suddenly, they were surrounded!
paras.zh: 忽然，石头开始朝他们滚了过来。古怪的声音喊叫起来：“克里斯托夫回家了！克里斯托夫回家了！”安娜眼看着那些石头接连从地上立起，变成了地精。忽然，他们被团团围住了！

paras.en: Hulda pushed her way to the front, thrilled to see Kristoff. Clearly, she knew him well. “He’s brought a girl!” she exclaimed with a grin.
paras.zh: 胡尔达挤到最前面，见到克里斯托夫欣喜不已。显然，她跟他很熟。“他带了个姑娘回来！”她咧嘴笑着惊呼。

paras.en: The trolls climbed over each other to get a good look at Anna.
paras.zh: 地精们你爬我、我爬你，都想好好看一眼安娜。

paras.en: Hulda examined Anna. “Let me see. Bright eyes. Working nose. Strong teeth,” she said. “Yes, she’ll do nicely for our Kristoff.”
paras.zh: 胡尔达上下打量着安娜。“让我瞧瞧。眼睛真亮。鼻子好使。牙齿也结实。”她说。“没错，她配我们的克里斯托夫正合适。”

paras.en: Anna finally caught on. They believed she was Kristoff’s girlfriend, and that he’d brought her to meet them! “Wait. No. H-he and I aren’t…,” she stammered. “I mean, he’s not, we’re not…”
paras.zh: 安娜终于反应过来。他们以为她是克里斯托夫的女朋友，以为他是专程带她回来见家人的！“等等。不，他、他跟我不……”她结结巴巴地说。“我是说，他不是，我们不是……”

paras.en: Kristoff jumped in. “What she means is, that’s not why I brought her here. We need—”
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫连忙插话。“她的意思是，我带她来不是因为这个。我们需要——”

paras.en: A troll named Soren cut him off. “We know what you need,” he said confidently. And with that, the trolls began to tell Anna all about Kristoff’s shortcomings. According to them, he was a bit of a fixer-upper, but a little love would make everything right.
paras.zh: 一个名叫索伦的地精打断了他。“我们知道你需要什么。”他信心十足地说。说完，地精们便开始向安娜细数克里斯托夫的种种缺点。照他们说来，他算是个“待修整的半成品”，但只要有一点爱，一切都会好起来。

paras.en: Anna wasn’t sure how this information could help solve her problem, but Kristoff didn’t seem worried. “Just do whatever they say, and you’ll be fine,” he advised her.
paras.zh: 安娜不太确定这些话怎么帮得上她的忙，但克里斯托夫似乎并不担心。“只要照他们说的做，你就不会有事。”他劝她道。

paras.en: The trolls started dancing and singing about love being a force that brings out the best in everyone, even if people have made bad choices in the past. Their excitement was infectious, and Anna and Kristoff were soon swept up in the celebration. Anna actually enjoyed the dancing, and she even let the troll women decorate her hair. Before long, she and Kristoff were moved to an area where they stood in front of the entire troll crowd.
paras.zh: 地精们开始又唱又跳，唱爱情是一种力量，能让每个人展现出最好的一面，哪怕过去做过糟糕的选择。他们的兴奋劲儿很有感染力，安娜和克里斯托夫很快也被卷入了这场欢庆之中。安娜其实很享受跳舞，她甚至让地精女眷们给她打扮头发。没过多久，她和克里斯托夫被拥到一个地方，站在整群地精面前。

paras.en: “Do you, Anna,” a serious troll began, “take Kristoff to be your troll-fully wedded—”
paras.zh: “你，安娜，”一个神情严肃的地精开了口，“愿意接受克里斯托夫，与你缔结地精之好——”

paras.en: “Wait! What?” Anna exclaimed.
paras.zh: “等等！什么？”安娜惊呼。

paras.en: “You’re getting married,” the troll said.
paras.zh: “你们要成亲了呀。”那地精说。

paras.en: Just then, a mighty shiver shot through Anna and she collapsed. Kristoff caught her.
paras.zh: 就在这时，一阵剧烈的颤抖窜过安娜全身，她倒了下去。克里斯托夫接住了她。

paras.en: “I think someone has cold feet,” Soren said.
paras.zh: “我看是有人冷到脚软了。”索伦说。

paras.en: Hulda sniffed. “Nervous jitters is all.”
paras.zh: 胡尔达嗅了嗅。“不过是紧张得发抖罢了。”

paras.en: Kristoff held Anna tight. “No,” he insisted. “Something’s wrong.”
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫紧紧抱住安娜。“不。”他坚持道。“是有哪里不对劲。”

paras.en: Pabbie pushed his way through the crowd. “He’s right. Something is wrong,” he said. Pabbie walked up to Anna, took her hands, and looked into her weakened eyes. A shiver went through her body as he lifted a lock of her hair, which was now all white.
paras.zh: 帕比长老从人群中挤了过来。“他说得对。确实出了事。”他说。帕比长老走到安娜面前，握住她的双手，凝视着她虚弱的眼睛。他撩起她的一缕头发——那头发如今全白了——安娜的身子又是一阵颤抖。

paras.en: “Anna,” Pabbie said in a low voice, “your life is in danger.”
paras.zh: “安娜，”帕比长老低声说，“你的生命正危在旦夕。”

paras.en: A hush fell over the trolls. Anna looked at Kristoff as Pabbie continued.
paras.zh: 地精们顿时一片寂静。帕比长老继续说着，安娜望向克里斯托夫。

paras.en: “There is ice in your heart, put there by your sister. If not removed…to solid ice you will freeze,” he told her. “Forever.”
paras.zh: “你心里有一块冰，是你姐姐放进来的。若不取出……你便会冻成一尊坚冰。”他告诉她。“永远如此。”

paras.en: “What? No!” Anna gasped.
paras.zh: “什么？不！”安娜倒抽一口冷气。

paras.en: Kristoff tried to stay calm. “So remove it, Pabbie,” he said.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫努力保持镇定。“那就把它取出来啊，帕比长老。”他说。

paras.en: “I can’t. If it were in her head, that would be easy,” Pabbie said. “But only an act of true love can thaw a frozen heart.”
paras.zh: “我办不到。要是冰长在头上，那倒容易。”帕比长老说。“可唯有真爱之举，才能融化一颗冻结的心。”

paras.en: “An act of true love?” Anna repeated.
paras.zh: “真爱之举？”安娜重复道。

paras.en: “A true love’s kiss, perhaps?” suggested a nearby troll.
paras.zh: “或许，是真爱之吻？”旁边一个地精提议道。

paras.en: Kristoff paused, thinking. “We’ve got to get you back to Hans,” he said.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫停顿片刻，思索着。“我们得把你送回汉斯身边。”他说。

paras.en: “Hans,” Anna answered weakly. “Right. Hans.”
paras.zh: “汉斯。”安娜虚弱地应道。“对。汉斯。”

paras.en: Quickly, Kristoff scooped Anna into his arms and placed her on Sven’s back. He climbed up behind her, nodding his thanks to the trolls.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫迅速把安娜抱起来，放到斯文背上。他爬到她身后，朝地精们点头致谢。

paras.en: Hulda sighed. “Ugh. We’ll never get him married, Soren,” she muttered.
paras.zh: 胡尔达叹了口气。“唉。咱们是永远别想让他成家了，索伦。”她嘀咕道。

paras.en: “Someday, Hulda,” Soren replied.
paras.zh: “总会有那么一天的，胡尔达。”索伦答道。

paras.en: Kristoff took hold of Sven’s reins. “Come on, Olaf!” he called.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫拉住斯文的缰绳。“快点，雪宝！”他喊道。

paras.en: “I’m coming!” Olaf shouted, grabbing Sven’s tail. “Let’s go kiss Hans!”
paras.zh: “我来啦！”雪宝喊着，一把抓住斯文的尾巴。“咱们去亲汉斯喽！”

paras.en: Sven turned and headed back toward Arendelle, breaking into a gallop as he left the trolls’ valley. The sun began to rise. And one by one, the trolls turned back into stone.
paras.zh: 斯文转过身，朝阿伦黛尔奔去，一离开地精的山谷便撒开四蹄飞奔起来。太阳开始升起。地精们一个接一个，重新变回了石头。

paras.en: Hans carried a torch as he walked down the steps into the dungeon of Arendelle castle. He appeared in the doorway of Elsa’s cell.
paras.zh: 汉斯提着火炬，走下台阶，进入阿伦黛尔城堡的地牢。他出现在艾莎牢房的门口。

paras.en: Elsa was gazing out the small window at Arendelle, now buried in snow and ice. She turned when she heard Hans enter. “Why did you bring me here?” Elsa asked.
paras.zh: 艾莎正从小窗望出去，看着如今被冰雪掩埋的阿伦黛尔。听见汉斯进来，她转过身。“你为什么把我带到这儿来？”艾莎问。

paras.en: “I couldn’t just let them kill you,” Hans told her.
paras.zh: “我不能眼睁睁让他们杀了你。”汉斯告诉她。

paras.en: Elsa glanced at her shackled hands. “But I’m a danger to Arendelle. Get Anna,” she suggested.
paras.zh: 艾莎瞥了一眼自己戴着镣铐的双手。“可我对阿伦黛尔是个威胁。去找安娜。”她提议。

paras.en: “Anna has not returned,” Hans said. “If you would just stop the winter and bring back summer…please.”
paras.zh: “安娜还没回来。”汉斯说。“只要你停住这场寒冬，让夏天回来……求你了。”

paras.en: Elsa stared at Hans with sad eyes. “Don’t you see?” she said. “I can’t. You have to tell them to let me go.”
paras.zh: 艾莎以悲伤的眼神望着汉斯。“你还不明白吗？”她说。“我做不到。你得叫他们放我走。”

paras.en: Hans walked back to the door. “I will do what I can,” he said. Exiting the cell, he locked the door behind him.
paras.zh: 汉斯走回门边。“我会尽我所能的。”他说。他退出牢房，在身后锁上了门。

paras.en: Elsa looked down at her shackles. Ice was beginning to spread over them. And ice was forming along the edges of the floor. Elsa’s emotions—and her powers—were again slipping out of her control.
paras.zh: 艾莎低头看着自己的镣铐。冰正开始爬上镣铐。冰也正沿着地面的边缘凝结。艾莎的情绪——连同她的魔力——再次渐渐失控。

chapters.title: 第十八章 · 急速下山

paras.en: Sven charged down the mountain at full speed with Kristoff and Anna on his back. Olaf slid down the trail next to them like a playful penguin.
paras.zh: 斯文载着克里斯托夫和安娜，全速冲下山去。雪宝像一只顽皮的企鹅，顺着他们身旁的小径滑下。

paras.en: Kristoff looked over at Anna. She was shivering and very pale. “Just hang in there,” he said. “Come on, buddy. Faster!” he urged Sven.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫扭头看向安娜。她浑身发抖，脸色惨白。“再撑一下。”他说。“拜托了，老伙计。再快点！”他催促斯文。

paras.en: When they arrived at Arendelle, Olaf shot ahead. “Wooo! I’ll meet you guys at the castle,” he said.
paras.zh: 他们抵达阿伦黛尔时，雪宝一下子蹿到了前头。“哇哦！咱们城堡见！”他说。

paras.en: “Stay out of sight!” Kristoff called after him.
paras.zh: “别让人看见你！”克里斯托夫在他身后喊。

paras.en: “I will!” Olaf yelled back as he disappeared down into the town. Kristoff watched him disappear from view. Then he heard a scream from someone who was obviously not expecting to see a talking snowman.
paras.zh: “我会的！”雪宝大声回喊，消失在镇子里。克里斯托夫望着他消失在视线之外。接着，他听见一声尖叫——显然是有人没料到会撞见一个会说话的雪人。

paras.en: “Ah! It’s alive!” the villager shrieked. So much for Olaf staying out of sight!
paras.zh: “啊！它是活的！”那个村民尖声叫道。雪宝“别让人看见”的计划，算是彻底泡汤了！

paras.en: At the castle gates, a soldier soon spotted the reindeer and the two riders.
paras.zh: 在城堡门口，一名士兵很快认出了那头驯鹿和背上的两个人。

paras.en: “It’s Princess Anna!” he shouted.
paras.zh: “是安娜公主！”他高喊。

paras.en: Anna struggled to get off Sven.
paras.zh: 安娜挣扎着要从斯文背上下来。

paras.en: “I’ve got you,” Kristoff said, helping her off the reindeer.
paras.zh: “我扶住你了。”克里斯托夫说着，把她从驯鹿身上扶了下来。

paras.en: Anna was very weak. Her eyes lifted to meet Kristoff’s. “Are you going to be okay?” she asked.
paras.zh: 安娜虚弱极了。她抬起眼，迎上克里斯托夫的目光。“你……会没事的吧？”她问。

paras.en: “Don’t worry about me,” Kristoff said. Quickly, two servants rushed over to help Anna. “You need to get her to Prince Hans,” Kristoff told them.
paras.zh: “别为我操心。”克里斯托夫说。两名仆人连忙跑过来搀扶安娜。“你们得把她送到汉斯王子那儿去。”克里斯托夫对他们说。

paras.en: “You poor girl, you’re freezing,” the older servant said. “Let’s get you inside. Let’s get you warm.”
paras.zh: “可怜的孩子，你都冻僵了。”年长些的仆人说。“我们带你进去。让你暖和起来。”

paras.en: As the servants whisked Anna away, Kristoff stood watching. Sven looked at his friend, unsure what he would do next. Then the castle door closed, shutting Kristoff out.
paras.zh: 仆人们把安娜匆匆带走时，克里斯托夫站在原地目送。斯文望着自己的朋友，不知他接下来会怎么做。接着，城堡大门轰然关上，把克里斯托夫关在了门外。

paras.en: In the castle library, Hans was meeting with dignitaries and soldiers, discussing the fate of Arendelle’s queen.
paras.zh: 在城堡的图书室里，汉斯正与各国使节和士兵们会面，商讨阿伦黛尔王后的命运。

paras.en: “I’m going back out to look for Anna,” Hans told them. “No one is to go near the queen until I get back.”
paras.zh: “我打算再出去找安娜。”汉斯对他们说。“在我回来之前，谁也不许靠近王后。”

paras.en: “Prince Hans,” a man said. “You cannot risk going out there again. Arendelle needs you.”
paras.zh: “汉斯王子，”一个人说。“您不能再冒险出去了。阿伦黛尔需要您。”

paras.en: Hans sank into a chair. “But if anything happens to Princess Anna…”
paras.zh: 汉斯颓然坐进椅子里。“可要是安娜公主有个三长两短……”

paras.en: “If anything happens to Princess Anna,” another dignitary said, “you are all Arendelle has left. Please.”
paras.zh: “要是安娜公主有个三长两短，”另一位使节说，“您就是阿伦黛尔唯一的指望了。求您了。”

paras.en: The door flew open, and the two servants brought Anna into the room.
paras.zh: 门猛地推开，两名仆人把安娜扶进了房间。

paras.en: “Anna!” Hans exclaimed as she fell into his arms. “You’re so cold.”
paras.zh: “安娜！”她倒进他怀里时，汉斯惊呼出声。“你身上好冷。”

paras.en: “Hans, you have to kiss me,” she managed to say.
paras.zh: “汉斯，你得吻我。”她费力地说。

paras.en: “What?” he asked.
paras.zh: “什么？”他问。

paras.en: “Now!” Anna said desperately.
paras.zh: “现在！”安娜绝望地说。

paras.en: Hans was a bit taken aback. “Slow down,” he said.
paras.zh: 汉斯有些措手不及。“慢点说。”他说。

paras.en: The servants smiled, realizing that Anna and Hans needed to be alone. “We’ll give you two some privacy,” said one, backing away. Everyone in the room followed him out.
paras.zh: 仆人们笑了，明白安娜和汉斯需要独处。“我们给你们俩留点私人空间。”其中一个边退边说。屋里的人全都跟着他退了出去。

paras.en: Once they were alone, Hans turned to Anna. “What happened out there?” he asked.
paras.zh: 等只剩他们两人，汉斯转向安娜。“外面发生了什么事？”他问。

paras.en: “Elsa struck me with her powers,” she said softly.
paras.zh: “艾莎用她的魔力击中了我。”她轻声说。

paras.en: “You said she’d never hurt you.”
paras.zh: “你说过她绝不会伤害我的。”

paras.en: Anna lowered her eyes. “I was wrong,” she said. “She froze my heart, and only an act of true love can save me.”
paras.zh: 安娜垂下眼睛。“是我错了。”她说。“她冻住了我的心，唯有真爱之举才能救我。”

chapters.title: 第十九章 · 错付的信任

paras.en: Anna’s body felt even colder than when she was out in the storm. But it was a relief to tell Hans everything, to know that he could help her.
paras.zh: 安娜的身体比在暴风雪里时还要冷。但能把一切都说给汉斯听，知道他能帮自己，总算让她松了口气。

paras.en: After hearing the whole tale, Hans looked at her with a tender smile. “A true love’s kiss,” he said pensively. He leaned in close, ready to kiss her. Anna lifted her chin and closed her eyes in anticipation. Then he stopped.
paras.zh: 听完整个经过，汉斯带着温柔的微笑望着她。“真爱之吻。”他若有所思地说。他凑上前，准备吻她。安娜仰起下巴，闭上眼睛，满心期待。可他停住了。

paras.en: “Oh, Anna,” he said. “If only somebody loved you.”
paras.zh: “噢，安娜。”他说。“要是有人爱你就好了。”

paras.en: “What?” Anna said in shock.
paras.zh: “什么？”安娜震惊地说。

paras.en: Hans rose to his feet and walked away. He stood in front of the window, looking out over the kingdom. “As thirteenth in line in my own kingdom, I didn’t stand a chance,” he told her. “I knew I’d have to marry into the throne somewhere.”
paras.zh: 汉斯站起身，走开了。他站在窗前，眺望着窗外的王国。“在自己的国家，我只是第十三顺位继承人，压根没有机会。”他告诉她。“我知道，自己必须靠联姻在哪个王国登上王位。”

paras.en: Anna could barely lift her head. “What? What are you talking about?” she asked.
paras.zh: 安娜几乎抬不起头来。“什么？你在说什么？”她问。

paras.en: “As heir, Elsa was preferable, of course,” Hans continued. “But no one was getting anywhere with her. But you…” He trailed off with a small smile.
paras.zh: “作为继承人，艾莎当然更理想。”汉斯继续道。“可谁也拿她没办法。可你……”他挂着一丝微笑，话没有说完。

paras.en: “Hans?” Anna said, growing concerned.
paras.zh: “汉斯？”安娜说，心里渐渐不安起来。

paras.en: “Like your sister said,” he told her. “You were so desperate for love, you were willing to marry me just like that.” He walked over to a table and grabbed a pitcher of water. Then he moved closer to the fire. “I figured after we married, I’d have to stage a little accident for Elsa.” He poured the water on the fire, putting it out.
paras.zh: “就像你姐姐说的。”他告诉她。“你太渴望被爱，居然就这么随随便便愿意嫁给我。”他走到桌边，抓起一把水壶。接着，他走近壁炉。“我盘算着，等我们成婚之后，还得给艾莎安排一场小小的‘意外’。”他把水浇在火上，把火浇灭了。

paras.en: Anna reached out to stop him, but she was too weak and once again fell to the floor. “Hans, no, stop!” she cried.
paras.zh: 安娜伸手想拦住他，却太虚弱，再次跌坐在地上。“汉斯，不，住手！”她哭喊。

paras.en: Ignoring her plea, Hans took the fire poker and smothered the remaining embers. A cold draft filled the room. “But then she doomed herself, and you were dumb enough to go after her,” he snickered.
paras.zh: 汉斯不理她的哀求，拿起拨火棍，把剩下的余烬全都摁灭。一阵冷风灌满了房间。“可后来她自己葬送了自己，而你还蠢到追着她跑。”他窃笑道。

paras.en: “Please,” Anna begged.
paras.zh: “求求你。”安娜哀求。

paras.en: Hans laughed. “All that’s left now is to kill Elsa and bring back summer.”
paras.zh: 汉斯笑了起来。“现在只剩下杀掉艾莎、让夏天回来了。”

paras.en: A sense of despair engulfed Anna as she realized the depth of Hans’s cruelty. “You’re no match for Elsa,” she said bravely.
paras.zh: 意识到汉斯竟狠毒到这般地步，一股绝望淹没了安娜。“你根本不是艾莎的对手。”她鼓起勇气说。

paras.en: Hans looked down at Anna. “No, you’re no match for Elsa,” he told her. “I, on the other hand, am the hero who is going to save Arendelle from destruction.” He strode to the door.
paras.zh: 汉斯低头看着安娜。“不，你才根本不是艾莎的对手。”他告诉她。“而我，才是那个要把阿伦黛尔从毁灭中拯救出来的英雄。”他大步走向门口。

paras.en: “You won’t get away with this,” Anna said fiercely.
paras.zh: “你不会得逞的。”安娜咬牙说。

paras.en: “Oh, I already have,” Hans said with a nasty grin. He walked out, locking the door tight.
paras.zh: “噢，我已经得逞了。”汉斯狞笑着说。他走了出去，把门牢牢锁上。

paras.en: Anna tried to get up from the floor, but she was too weak. She could feel the cold taking the last of her strength.
paras.zh: 安娜想从地上爬起来，却太过虚弱。她能感觉到寒意正抽走她最后一丝力气。

paras.en: “Please, somebody,” she called out hoarsely. “Help!” She looked around the dark room and knew she was totally alone. “Please, please,” she whispered.
paras.zh: “求求你，谁来救救我。”她沙哑地呼喊。“救命！”她环顾漆黑的房间，知道自己彻底孤身一人。“求求你，求求你。”她低声呢喃。

paras.en: And then she collapsed.
paras.zh: 接着，她昏了过去。

paras.en: Hans left Anna and went to the council chamber where the Duke and other dignitaries were gathered.
paras.zh: 汉斯离开安娜，来到议事厅，公爵和其他使节正聚在那儿。

paras.en: “It’s getting colder by the minute,” the Duke said. “Forget starving; we’ll soon freeze to death.”
paras.zh: “天一分钟比一分钟冷。”公爵说。“别说挨饿了，我们很快就要活活冻死了。”

paras.en: Hans fell into a chair, looking weak and grief-stricken.
paras.zh: 汉斯瘫坐进椅子，一副虚弱又悲痛的模样。

paras.en: “Prince Hans!” a dignitary said, reaching out to him gently.
paras.zh: “汉斯王子！”一位使节轻声唤道，伸手扶住他。

paras.en: Hans lowered his head and chuckled to himself. He had sat down on the throne. His plan was moving along perfectly. Pretending to be full of remorse, Hans said, “Princess Anna is…dead.”
paras.zh: 汉斯低下头，暗自窃笑。他坐下的，正是那张王座。他的计划正在完美推进。汉斯做出满怀悔恨的样子，说道：“安娜公主……死了。”

paras.en: “What?” the other men exclaimed.
paras.zh: “什么？”其他人惊呼。

paras.en: “How could this happen?” one of the dignitaries asked.
paras.zh: “这怎么可能？”一位使节问。

paras.en: Hans shook his head slowly. “She was killed by Queen Elsa.”
paras.zh: 汉斯缓缓摇头。“她是被艾莎王后杀死的。”

paras.en: “No!” the Duke shouted.
paras.zh: “不！”公爵喊道。

paras.en: With his head in his hands, Hans played the part of a grieving man. “We said our wedding vows…before she died in my arms.”
paras.zh: 汉斯双手抱头，演起一副悲痛欲绝的样子。“我们立过了婚誓……就在她死在我怀里之前。”

paras.en: “There can be no doubt now,” the Duke declared. “Queen Elsa is a monster!”
paras.zh: “现在毋庸置疑了。”公爵宣称。“艾莎王后是个怪物！”

paras.en: “Prince Hans,” stated one of the dignitaries. “Arendelle looks to you.”
paras.zh: “汉斯王子，”一位使节郑重说道。“阿伦黛尔仰仗您了。”

paras.en: Hans nodded grimly, but he was secretly elated. Never in his wildest dreams could he have plotted his ascent to the throne so gloriously. “With a heavy heart, I charge Queen Elsa with treason and sentence her to death,” he declared.
paras.zh: 汉斯面色沉痛地点了点头，心里却暗暗得意。他连做梦都想不到，自己登上王位的谋划竟能如此风光。“怀着沉痛的心情，我以叛国罪指控艾莎王后，并判处她死刑。”他宣布。

paras.en: In her dungeon cell, Elsa stood by the window. The snow was cascading down heavily. She wondered where Anna was at that moment. Anna would never be able to survive this storm.
paras.zh: 在地牢的牢房里，艾莎站在窗边。大雪纷纷扬扬，下得正紧。她想知道，此刻安娜身在何处。安娜绝不可能熬过这场暴风雪。

paras.en: Maybe I am a monster, she thought. Hans’s words haunted her. Her powers had done nothing but cause great trouble for the kingdom.
paras.zh: 或许，我真的是个怪物，她想。汉斯的话在她心头挥之不去。她的魔力除了给王国招来大麻烦，什么也没有带来。

paras.en: Elsa knew that she had to leave Arendelle so she wouldn’t do any more harm. As her eyes welled up with tears, she looked down at her shackles. They were completely frozen, and suddenly, they broke open. Then, with a thunderous crash, ice broke through the dungeon walls, splitting them apart as Elsa’s emotions overwhelmed her mind and heart. Realizing she could escape, Elsa hurried through the gaping hole in the wall.
paras.zh: 艾莎知道，她必须离开阿伦黛尔，才不会再造成任何伤害。她眼里噙满泪水，低头看向自己的镣铐。镣铐已完全冻住，忽然，它们崩开了。接着，随着一声震天巨响，冰冲破地牢的墙壁，将墙劈裂开来——艾莎的情绪已彻底淹没了她的心神。意识到自己可以逃走，艾莎匆匆钻过墙上的大洞。

paras.en: Hans heard the noise and ran down to the dungeon. The Duke and his guards were already there.
paras.zh: 汉斯听见响动，跑下地牢。公爵和他的卫兵已经在那儿了。

paras.en: “What happened?” Hans asked.
paras.zh: “怎么回事？”汉斯问。

paras.en: “The queen has escaped,” the Duke replied, gazing through the opening in the wall.
paras.zh: “王后逃走了。”公爵望着墙上的破洞答道。

chapters.title: 第二十章 · 逆风回山

paras.en: The howling winds pushed against Kristoff as he headed back up the mountain, away from Arendelle. He adjusted his goggles and wrapped his scarf tightly around his face.
paras.zh: 呼啸的狂风撞击着克里斯托夫，他正掉头往山上走，远离阿伦黛尔。他调整好护目镜，把围巾紧紧裹在脸上。

paras.en: Sven was lagging behind. The reindeer looked longingly back at Arendelle and the castle. He shook his head and whinnied. Kristoff kept walking, ignoring him. Sven charged ahead, passed Kristoff, and then stopped in front of him. He faced him and looked Kristoff directly in the eye.
paras.zh: 斯文落在了后面。那头驯鹿恋恋不舍地回头望向阿伦黛尔和城堡。它摇了摇头，发出一声嘶鸣。克里斯托夫头也不回地继续赶路，不理它。斯文猛冲上前，越过克里斯托夫，然后停在了他面前。它转过身面对他，直直地注视着克里斯托夫的眼睛。

paras.en: “What is it, buddy?” Kristoff asked.
paras.zh: “怎么了，老伙计？”克里斯托夫问。

paras.en: The reindeer nudged his antlers into Kristoff’s side.
paras.zh: 那头驯鹿用鹿角轻轻顶了顶克里斯托夫的身侧。

paras.en: “Hey, watch it,” Kristoff said, annoyed. “What’s wrong with you?”
paras.zh: “嘿，小心点。”克里斯托夫恼火地说。“你这是怎么了？”

paras.en: Sven shook his head and wiggled his mouth.
paras.zh: 斯文摇摇头，动了动嘴。

paras.en: “I don’t understand you when you talk that way,” Kristoff told him. In a flash, Sven bucked Kristoff and lifted him up with his antlers. “Hey! Stop it!” Kristoff shouted. “Put me down.”
paras.zh: “你那样比划，我可看不懂。”克里斯托夫对它说。电光石火间，斯文猛地一甩身，用鹿角把克里斯托夫顶了起来。“嘿！住手！”克里斯托夫喊道。“放我下来。”

paras.en: Sven dropped him straight into the snow, hard.
paras.zh: 斯文把他直直地摔进雪里，结结实实。

paras.en: “No, Sven,” Kristoff said. “We’re not going back.”
paras.zh: “不，斯文。”克里斯托夫说。“我们不回去了。”

paras.en: Sven snorted his disapproval.
paras.zh: 斯文喷着鼻息，表示不赞同。

paras.en: “She’s with her true love.” Kristoff saw Sven’s doubt. He glanced back at the kingdom to make his point. But to his surprise, he saw a strange new storm swirling above the castle. He could see dark clouds forming, and more ice on the castle walls, putting it into an even deeper freeze. “Anna!” he cried.
paras.zh: “她正和她的真爱在一起呢。”克里斯托夫看出了斯文的怀疑。为了证明自己的话，他回头瞥了一眼王国。可令他吃惊的是，他看见城堡上空盘旋着一场诡异的新风暴。他能看见乌云正在聚拢，城堡墙上又结起更多寒冰，把整座城冻得更深。“安娜！”他惊呼。

paras.en: Instantly, Kristoff changed his course and took off running toward Arendelle. Sven scrambled and raced up behind him. He ducked his head and lifted Kristoff with his antlers, then threw him onto his back. The duo raced down the hillside.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫立刻改变方向，撒腿朝阿伦黛尔奔去。斯文也慌忙跟上，从后面疾追而来。它低下头，用鹿角把克里斯托夫托起，随即甩到自己背上。这一人一鹿沿着山坡飞驰而下。

paras.en: Anna was curled up on the floor of the library. She had made it to the door but was now too weak to stand. No one could hear her whispered cries for help. She was so cold—and her heart ached.
paras.zh: 安娜蜷缩在图书室的地板上。她已经挪到了门口，可如今虚弱得站不起来。没有人能听见她微弱的呼救声。她冷极了——心口也阵阵作痛。

paras.en: At that moment, the door handle jiggled. Anna was barely able to raise her head to see who it was. The lock clicked. Anna could see a carrot wedged into the keyhole.…
paras.zh: 就在这时，门把手晃动了一下。安娜好不容易才抬起头，想看清来人是谁。锁“咔嗒”一声响了。安娜看见钥匙孔里塞着一根胡萝卜……

paras.en: Suddenly, the door flew open. It was Olaf! The snowman pulled his carrot nose out of the lock and put it back into the middle of his face. He was very proud of himself, but his happiness melted the moment he saw Anna.
paras.zh: 忽然，门猛地打开了。是雪宝！雪人从锁孔里拔出他的胡萝卜鼻子，重新安回脸中央。他对自己得意极了，可一看到安娜，那份高兴瞬间便融化了。

paras.en: “Anna, no!” he called. He ran to the fireplace and struck a match. In seconds there was a large, roaring fire.
paras.zh: “安娜，不要！”他喊道。他跑到壁炉前，划着了一根火柴。转眼间，一团熊熊大火燃了起来。

paras.en: “Olaf,” Anna said. “Get away from there!”
paras.zh: “雪宝。”安娜说。“快离那儿远点！”

paras.en: “Whoa!” Olaf exclaimed, taking in the sight and feel of the fire. He was a little scared, but he couldn’t resist the warmth coming from the fireplace. “So that’s heat,” he said. “I gotta say, I still like it!” He hurried over to Anna and brought her closer to the fire. “So, where’s Hans? What happened to your kiss?”
paras.zh: “哇！”雪宝惊叹着，打量那火光，感受着热气。他有点害怕，却又抵挡不住壁炉传来的暖意。“原来这就是热啊。”他说。“我得说，我还是挺喜欢的！”他匆匆跑到安娜身边，把她挪近火堆。“那么，汉斯呢？你的吻怎么了？”

paras.en: “I was wrong about him,” Anna said. “It wasn’t true love.”
paras.zh: “是我看错他了。”安娜说。“那不是真爱。”

paras.en: Olaf didn’t want to believe it. “But we rode all the way here,” he said.
paras.zh: 雪宝不愿相信。“可我们一路赶来就是为了这个啊。”他说。

paras.en: “Please, Olaf,” Anna managed to say. “You can’t stay here. You’ll melt.”
paras.zh: “求你了，雪宝。”安娜勉强说道。“你不能待在这儿。你会融化的。”

paras.en: “I’m not leaving until we find some other act of true love to save you,” Olaf said. He sat down next to Anna. “Got any ideas?”
paras.zh: “在找到别的真爱之举来救你之前，我是不会走的。”雪宝说。他在安娜身旁坐下。“想到什么办法了吗？”

paras.en: Anna sighed heavily. “I don’t even know what love is anymore.”
paras.zh: 安娜重重地叹了口气。“我连爱是什么都不知道了。”

paras.en: “That’s okay,” Olaf said. “I do.” He sat up a little taller. “Love is putting someone else’s needs before yours—like, you know how Kristoff brought you back here to Hans and left you forever?”
paras.zh: “没关系。”雪宝说。“我知道。”他坐直了些，挺起身子。“爱就是把别人的需要放在自己前面——就像，你知道克里斯托夫把你送回汉斯身边、然后永远离开了吗？”

paras.en: “Kristoff loves me?” Anna asked. Her eyes widened.
paras.zh: “克里斯托夫爱我？”安娜问。她的眼睛一下子睁大了。

paras.en: Olaf nodded. “You really don’t know anything about love, do you?”
paras.zh: 雪宝点了点头。“你真是一点都不懂爱，对吧？”

paras.en: Anna looked at Olaf. He was dripping from head to toe! “Olaf, you’re melting!” she cried.
paras.zh: 安娜望着雪宝。他正从头到脚往下淌水呢！“雪宝，你在融化！”她喊道。

paras.en: “Some people are worth melting for,” he said. His face was quickly losing its shape. Olaf tried to push up his sagging head. He ran and sat behind Anna, trying to escape the fire’s heat. “Just maybe not right this second.”
paras.zh: “有些人，值得为她融化。”他说。他的脸正迅速失去形状。雪宝努力想把耷拉下来的脑袋撑起来。他跑过去坐在安娜身后，想躲开火的热气。“也许，只是眼下这一秒还不行。”

paras.en: A window across the room blew open and a cold gust of wind swept through. Anna shuddered. Olaf ran to the window to shut it. “Don’t worry,” he said. “I’ve got it. We’re gonna get through…” He stopped talking and stared out the window. He leaned forward and squinted at the horizon. “Hang on, just one second. I’m getting something!”
paras.zh: 房间那头的一扇窗户猛地被吹开，一股寒风席卷而入。安娜打了个寒颤。雪宝跑到窗边去关窗。“别担心。”他说。“交给我。我们一定能挺过去的……”他忽然不说话了，呆呆地盯着窗外。他探身向前，眯眼看向天边。“等等，就一秒钟。我看到什么了！”

paras.en: He reached through the open window and grabbed an icicle off the window ledge. He flipped the icicle around and used it as a telescope. “Hey, Kristoff and Sven!” he shouted when he realized who was running toward the castle. He turned to Anna excitedly. “They’re coming back this way!”
paras.zh: 他伸出窗外，从窗台上抓下一根冰柱。他把冰柱调转方向，当成望远镜用。“嘿，是克里斯托夫和斯文！”认出朝城堡跑来的是谁时，他喊了起来。他兴奋地转向安娜。“他们正往这边回来呢！”

paras.en: “They are?” Anna asked. She tried to stand up to see for herself.
paras.zh: “真的吗？”安娜问。她想站起来亲眼看看。

paras.en: “Wow, he’s moving really fast!” Olaf said. “Huh, I guess I was wrong. I guess Kristoff doesn’t love you enough to leave you behind.”
paras.zh: “哇，他跑得可真快！”雪宝说。“嗯，看来是我错了。看来克里斯托夫对你的爱，还没到肯把你扔下的程度。”

paras.en: “Help me up,” Anna said, struggling. “Please.”
paras.zh: “扶我起来。”安娜挣扎着说。“求你了。”

paras.en: “No,” Olaf told her. “You need to stay by the fire and keep warm.”
paras.zh: “不行。”雪宝对她说。“你得待在火边保暖。”

paras.en: Anna was adamant. “I need to get to Kristoff.”
paras.zh: 安娜十分坚决。“我得去见克里斯托夫。”

paras.en: “Why?” Olaf asked. Then he paused. “Oh, I know why! There’s your act of true love right there, riding across the fjords like a valiant, pungent reindeer king!” He reached for Anna. “Come on!”
paras.zh: “为什么？”雪宝问。接着他顿住了。“噢，我知道为什么了！你的真爱之举就在那儿——像一位英勇又带着腥膻味儿的驯鹿国王，正驰过峡湾呢！”他伸手去拉安娜。“快起来！”

paras.en: Sheets of ice began to break through the library walls. The cracks grew across the walls, and the room began to collapse. Anna and Olaf hurried out of the library just in time. Together, they struggled to make it through the hallway, dodging ice as it appeared in their path.
paras.zh: 一片片冰层开始冲破图书室的墙壁。裂缝在墙上蔓延开来，房间开始崩塌。安娜和雪宝及时慌忙逃出了图书室。他们一起艰难地穿过走廊，躲闪着不断冒出的寒冰。

paras.en: “Back this way,” Olaf said, pulling Anna. But every path they tried was blocked by ice! “We’re trapped!” he shouted.
paras.zh: “往这边退。”雪宝拉着安娜说。可他们试过的每条路都被冰封死了！“我们被困住了！”他喊道。

paras.en: Anna spun around and spotted a way out. She took Olaf’s hand and they made their way over to a window, broke the glass, and slid down an icy ramp. Olaf picked up more snow as he went. They landed safely outside the castle and took off toward Kristoff.
paras.zh: 安娜转身四顾，发现了一条出路。她拉起雪宝的手，两人挪到一扇窗前，砸碎玻璃，顺着冰坡滑了下去。雪宝一路又沾起了更多雪。他们安全落在城堡外，随即朝克里斯托夫奔去。

chapters.title: 第二十一章 · 暴雪将至

paras.en: The winds were picking up as the storm raged throughout Arendelle. The snow continued to fall, and the air was frigid. The ice blocks in the fjord were beginning to shift, which made walking on the frozen surface dangerous.
paras.zh: 风暴席卷阿伦黛尔，风势越来越猛。雪不停地下，空气刺骨般寒冷。峡湾里的冰块开始挪动，令冰面上的行走变得危险起来。

paras.en: The snow hit Anna’s face hard, blinding her, but she and Olaf continued. She held her hand up to shield her eyes when she reached the shore. It broke her heart to see the fjord waters frozen into solid blocks and the ships turned on their sides.
paras.zh: 雪重重拍在安娜脸上，迷了她的眼，可她和雪宝仍继续前行。走到岸边时，她抬起手遮挡眼睛。看到峡湾的水冻成实心的冰块、船只侧翻倒扣，她心都碎了。

paras.en: “Kristoff!” she called out weakly. She couldn’t see him, but she knew he was coming over the fjord—and she knew he was her last chance for survival. The ice was still spreading through her heart, making her weaker and weaker. She was determined, but was losing strength with each step.
paras.zh: “克里斯托夫！”她虚弱地喊。她看不见他，却知道他正越过峡湾赶来——也知道，他是自己活下去的最后希望。寒冰仍在她心间蔓延，让她越来越虚弱。她心意已决，却每走一步都在流失力气。

paras.en: The snow was swirling wildly now, covering everything. “Whoa!” Olaf cried as the wind lifted him up and took him from Anna.
paras.zh: 此刻大雪狂乱地打着旋，吞没了一切。“哇！”雪宝惊叫，风把他卷起，从安娜身边带走了。

paras.en: Not far away, but completely engulfed in the snowstorm, Kristoff was riding on Sven’s back, racing desperately toward Anna. As he passed over the fjord, a ship that was wedged in the thick ice in front of him began to shift and wobble. “Come on! Come on!” Kristoff urged Sven.
paras.zh: 在不远处，尽管完全被暴雪吞没，克里斯托夫正骑在斯文背上，拼命朝安娜飞奔。当他越过峡湾时，前方冻在厚冰里的一艘船开始挪动、摇晃起来。“快啊！快啊！”克里斯托夫催促着斯文。

paras.en: At that moment, the ice in front of Kristoff shifted again and caused the ship to drop, splintering the surface. Sven bravely jumped over the frigid waters and bucked his rider off to safety. Then the reindeer fell into the water.
paras.zh: 就在这时，克里斯托夫前方的冰面再次裂动，令那艘船骤然下坠，冰面碎裂开来。斯文勇敢地跃过冰冷的水面，把背上的骑手甩到安全之处。接着，那头驯鹿掉进了水里。

paras.en: “Sven!” Kristoff screamed. “Sven!”
paras.zh: “斯文！”克里斯托夫尖叫。“斯文！”

paras.en: With a mighty effort, Sven leaped out of the water and landed safely on a floating piece of ice. He nodded, signaling that he was all right.
paras.zh: 斯文奋力一跃，冲出水面，稳稳落在一块浮冰上。它点了点头，表示自己没事。

paras.en: “Good boy,” Kristoff called. He turned back to find Anna.
paras.zh: “好样的。”克里斯托夫喊道。他转回身去寻找安娜。

paras.en: Hans was also out on the frozen fjord, struggling through the storm. He was pursuing Elsa, however—and he nearly had her. “Elsa!” he yelled loudly through the howling winds. “You can’t run from this!”
paras.zh: 汉斯也在冰冻的峡湾上，顶着风暴艰难前行。不过，他追的是艾莎——而且几乎要得手了。“艾莎！”他在呼啸的狂风中大声喊。“你逃不掉的！”

paras.en: “Don’t try to stop me,” Elsa called back to him. “Just take care of my sister.”
paras.zh: “别拦我。”艾莎回喊道。“只要照顾好我妹妹就好。”

paras.en: “Your sister?” Hans laughed. “She returned from the mountain weak and cold. She said you froze her heart.”
paras.zh: “你妹妹？”汉斯笑了。“她从山上回来时，又虚弱又冰冷。她说你冻住了她的心。”

paras.en: Elsa gasped. “No!” She was overwhelmed by what her powers had done. Her worst fears had come true.
paras.zh: 艾莎倒抽一口气。“不！”她被自己的魔力所造成的后果击垮了。她最深的恐惧成了现实。

paras.en: “I tried to save her,” Hans lied. “But it was too late. Her skin was ice. Her hair turned white. Your sister is dead because of you.”
paras.zh: “我本想救她。”汉斯撒谎道。“可是太迟了。她的皮肤冻成了冰。她的头发变成了白色。你妹妹死了，都是你害的。”

paras.en: Elsa dropped to her knees and put her head in her hands.
paras.zh: 艾莎跪倒在地，双手掩面。

paras.en: The storm stopped abruptly in response to Elsa’s overwhelming despair. The winds and the driving snow ceased, leaving snowflakes suspended in the air.
paras.zh: 回应着艾莎那无尽的绝望，风暴骤然停息。狂风与飞雪皆止，雪花悬停在半空。

paras.en: In the sudden stillness, Kristoff finally spotted Anna. She was clutching her chest and her skin was pale, almost white. Her strength was decreasing with each passing moment.
paras.zh: 在这突如其来的寂静中，克里斯托夫终于看见了安娜。她紧捂着胸口，脸色苍白，近乎透明。她的力气正一刻一刻地消逝。

paras.en: Barely able to speak, she uttered his name and fell to her knees. “Kristoff.”
paras.zh: 她几乎说不出话，念出他的名字，跪倒在地。“克里斯托夫。”

paras.en: “Anna! Anna!” Kristoff called desperately as he ran toward her.
paras.zh: “安娜！安娜！”克里斯托夫一面朝她奔去，一面绝望地喊。

paras.en: In the quiet air, the people of Arendelle gathered at the shore, staring out at the frozen fjord. The view was finally clear, and they could see their queen kneeling on the ice, her head bowed. Prince Hans stood just behind her.
paras.zh: 在静谧的空气中，阿伦黛尔的百姓聚在岸边，凝望着冰封的峡湾。视野终于清晰了，他们看见自己的女王跪在冰上，低垂着头。汉斯王子就站在她身后。

chapters.title: 第二十二章 · 最后的抉择

paras.en: Though Anna could barely move, she lifted her head to see Kristoff coming toward her. But nearby, in the other direction, she suddenly caught sight of something else—something she could hardly believe. Was that her sister? Could Elsa also be out on the ice? Anna tried to focus.
paras.zh: 安娜虽几乎动弹不得，仍抬起头，看见克里斯托夫正朝她走来。可就在近旁的另一个方向，她忽然瞥见了别的东西——一件她几乎不敢相信的事。那是她姐姐吗？艾莎也会在冰上吗？安娜努力集中目光。

paras.en: Then she realized that Hans was standing over Elsa, who knelt on the ice, her face buried in her hands. Horrified, Anna watched as Hans drew his sword and raised it over her sister’s head. He was taking his time, almost smiling with anticipation.
paras.zh: 接着她看清了：汉斯正居高临下地站在艾莎身旁，而艾莎跪在冰上，脸埋在双手里。安娜惊恐地看着汉斯拔出剑，高高举过姐姐的头顶。他不慌不忙，几乎带着期待的笑意。

paras.en: Anna knew that kissing Kristoff was her last hope for survival, but she couldn’t bear to see Elsa in danger. With great difficulty, she turned away from Kristoff and moved toward her sister.
paras.zh: 安娜知道，吻克里斯托夫是自己活命的最后希望，可她不忍心看着艾莎身处险境。她费尽力气，转过身背对克里斯托夫，朝姐姐挪去。

paras.en: “Elsa!” she cried. With a final surge of energy, Anna lunged, using every remaining ounce of her strength. She threw herself in front of Elsa to block Hans’s blow. “NO!” she shouted.
paras.zh: “艾莎！”她喊道。安娜使出最后一股劲，用尽残存的每一分力气猛扑过去。她扑到艾莎身前，挡住了汉斯的一击。“不——！”她大喊。

paras.en: In that instant, Anna’s entire body froze, turning into solid ice. Hans’s sword came down at full strength on her body. The sword shattered! Hans reacted in angry astonishment as jagged pieces of steel fell into the snow.
paras.zh: 就在那一瞬，安娜的整个身体冻住了，化作一尊坚冰。汉斯的剑用尽全力劈在她的身上。剑，碎了！碎裂的钢片落进雪里，汉斯又惊又怒。

paras.en: At the sound of the sword, Elsa turned…and saw Anna’s frozen body, one arm raised to shield her sister.
paras.zh: 听到剑碎的声音，艾莎转过身……看见安娜冻僵的身躯，一只手臂还高高举着，护着姐姐。

paras.en: “Anna!” Elsa cried. She jumped up and threw her arms around her unseeing sister. “Oh, Anna,” she said, weeping. “No, please, no!” Elsa sobbed, hugging the frozen figure.
paras.zh: “安娜！”艾莎哭喊。她跳起身，双臂抱住失去知觉的妹妹。“噢，安娜。”她含泪说道。“不，求你了，不要！”艾莎抽泣着，紧抱那冰冷的身躯。

paras.en: Behind her, Hans was fuming. He quickly picked up his broken sword and started to swing it at Elsa, but Kristoff ran at him just in time. He hit Hans right on the jaw and knocked him down. There would be no second blows for Hans.
paras.zh: 在她身后，汉斯气得发抖。他慌忙拾起断剑，正要朝艾莎挥去，克里斯托夫及时冲了上来。他一拳正中汉斯的下巴，把他打倒在地。汉斯再没有机会出第二击了。

paras.en: Olaf ventured forward, looking up at the sisters. He was shocked to see Anna so still, without movement or life. “Anna?” he asked sadly. He stepped back as Elsa hugged her sister and cried.
paras.zh: 雪宝壮着胆子走上前，仰头望着姐妹俩。看到安娜一动不动、了无生气，他震惊了。“安娜？”他难过地问。他退后几步，任由艾莎抱着妹妹哭泣。

paras.en: Kristoff, Sven, and Olaf all bowed their heads. So did the dignitaries and citizens of Arendelle, watching from the shore. A somber silence fell over the kingdom.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫、斯文和雪宝都低下了头。在岸边观望的阿伦黛尔使节与百姓，也纷纷垂首默哀。一片哀寂笼罩了王国。

paras.en: Suddenly, as Elsa hugged her sister, drops of water began to form at the tips of Anna’s fingers. Then her arm began to bend. Anna was beginning to thaw!
paras.zh: 忽然，就在艾莎抱着妹妹时，安娜的指尖开始凝出水珠。接着，她的手臂开始弯动。安娜开始解冻了！

paras.en: “Anna!” Elsa exclaimed.
paras.zh: “安娜！”艾莎惊呼。

paras.en: “Elsa…,” Anna murmured. She opened her eyes and smiled lovingly at her sister. Elsa laughed with joy.
paras.zh: “艾莎……”安娜喃喃道。她睁开眼，朝姐姐露出了充满爱意的微笑。艾莎欢喜地笑了。

paras.en: “You sacrificed yourself for me?” Elsa asked in wonder.
paras.zh: “你为了我牺牲了自己？”艾莎又惊又喜地问。

paras.en: Still weak, Anna replied simply, “I love you.”
paras.zh: 安娜仍很虚弱，只轻轻答了一句：“我爱你。”

paras.en: Olaf gasped. “An act of true love will thaw a frozen heart,” he said. Anna’s sacrifice had saved her own life!
paras.zh: 雪宝倒抽一口气。“真爱之举，能融化冰冻的心。”他说。安娜的牺牲，救了她自己的命！

paras.en: Elsa found herself turning Olaf’s words over in her mind as she slowly realized their full meaning. “Love will thaw.… Love. Of course!” she said. She hugged Anna again and laughed.
paras.zh: 艾莎不由得在心里反复琢磨着雪宝的话，渐渐明白了其中的全部含义。“爱能融化……爱。当然！”她说。她再次抱住安娜，笑了起来。

paras.en: “Of course what?” Olaf asked. Elsa took a step back and raised her hands above her head, and the snow drifted back up to the sky! Next, the ground began to shake and move. The ice and snow began to melt. The fjord waters thawed and a boat rose, lifting Elsa and the others onto its deck. Soon all the boats in the fjord were returned to their upright positions. Elsa waved her arms one more time and revealed a sunny sky! The warmth of a summer’s day spread across the kingdom in one joyous moment.
paras.zh: “当然什么？”雪宝问。艾莎后退一步，双手举过头顶，雪花竟纷纷飘回天上！接着，大地开始震动、起伏。冰雪开始消融。峡湾的水融化了，一艘船浮起，把艾莎和众人托上了甲板。很快，峡湾里所有的船都恢复了正立的姿态。艾莎再一挥手，露出了晴朗的天空！夏日的暖意在这一刻欢欣地漫过整个王国。

paras.en: All of Arendelle cheered!
paras.zh: 阿伦黛尔上下一片欢呼！

paras.en: “Hands down, this is the best day of my life!” Olaf exclaimed. But the snowman was again starting to melt. “And,” he added, “quite possibly the last.”
paras.zh: “绝对是，今天是我这辈子最棒的一天！”雪宝喊道。可雪人又开始融化了。“而且，”他补充道，“很可能也是最后一天。”

paras.en: Elsa looked over at the dripping, sagging snowman. “Oh, Olaf,” she said kindly. “Hang on, little guy.” She waved a hand over Olaf and surrounded him with a swirl of cold air. Olaf quickly refroze and looked like himself again. Best of all, he now had a permanent little snow cloud above his head, to keep him from melting ever again.
paras.zh: 艾莎看向那个正淌着水、慢慢垮塌的雪人。“噢，雪宝。”她温柔地说。“撑住，小家伙。”她朝雪宝挥了挥手，用一团盘旋的冷气将他包裹起来。雪宝很快重新冻好，又恢复了原样。最妙的是，他头顶从此多了一朵常驻的小雪云，让他再也不会融化。

paras.en: “Ha!” he exclaimed. “How are we doing this?”
paras.zh: “哈！”他惊叫。“这是怎么办到的？”

paras.en: Hans climbed to his feet, still dazed from Kristoff’s punch, and turned to Anna. “B-but she froze your heart,” he stammered. He thought Anna had frozen to death back in the library.
paras.zh: 汉斯挨了克里斯托夫一拳，还晕乎乎地爬起来，转向安娜。“可、可她冻住了你的心啊。”他结巴道。他以为安娜早在图书室里就冻死了。

paras.en: “The only frozen heart around here is yours,” Anna replied fiercely. Then, with all her might, she punched him in the face. Hans fell backward into the water.
paras.zh: “这周围唯一冰冷的心，是你的。”安娜厉声答道。接着，她用尽全身力气，一拳打在他的脸上。汉斯仰面跌进水里。

paras.en: Anna grinned. She was feeling warmer already. She caught sight of Kristoff and grinned. Then she hugged Elsa again. The sisters held each other tight. Neither one wanted to let go.
