paras.zh: 安娜咧嘴一笑。她已经觉得暖和多了。她看见克里斯托夫，又笑了。接着，她再次抱住了艾莎。姐妹俩紧紧相拥。谁也不愿松手。

chapters.title: 第二十三章 · 暖春归来

paras.en: Summer returned to Arendelle, and the waters in the fjord were full of boats moving cargo and people. Hans sat locked in a cage on the deck of a ship preparing to return to the Southern Isles.
paras.zh: 夏天回到了阿伦黛尔，峡湾的水面上满是运送货物与行人的船只。汉斯被锁在一只笼子里，坐在一艘准备返回南方群岛的船的甲板上。

paras.en: “I’ll return this scoundrel to his country,” a dignitary told the royal handler. “We shall see what his twelve brothers think of his behavior!”
paras.zh: “我会把这个无赖押送回他的国家。”一位使节对王室侍官说。“倒要看看，他那十二个哥哥会怎么看待他的行径！”

paras.en: Nearby, Arendelle soldiers were leading the Duke and his two guards to their ship.
paras.zh: 不远处，阿伦黛尔的士兵正押着公爵和他的两名护卫走向他们的船。

paras.en: “This is unacceptable,” the Duke protested. “I am innocent! I’m a victim of fear. I demand to see the queen!”
paras.zh: “这不可接受。”公爵抗议道。“我是清白的！我只是恐惧的受害者。我要求面见女王！”

paras.en: “Oh, right,” the royal handler told him. “I have a message from the queen: ‘Arendelle will henceforth and forever no longer do business of any sort with Weaseltown.’”
paras.zh: “噢，对了。”王室侍官对他说。“女王有话带给你：‘阿伦黛尔从今往后，永远不再与鼬鼠镇有任何往来。’”

paras.en: “Weselton!” shouted the Duke. “It’s Weselton!”
paras.zh: “韦斯文顿！”公爵喊道。“是韦斯文顿！”

paras.en: In the village, Anna hurried through the streets, pulling a blindfolded Kristoff behind her. “Come on, come on,” she called to him.
paras.zh: 村子里，安娜匆匆穿过街道，牵着蒙住眼睛的克里斯托夫往前走。“快点儿，快点儿。”她朝他喊。

paras.en: Anna led Kristoff straight into people and almost slammed him into a pole. “You’re not a very good blindfold guide,” he told her. Finally, they stopped.
paras.zh: 安娜领着克里斯托夫直往人堆里撞，还差点把他撞到柱子上。“你这个蒙眼向导，当得可不怎么样。”他对她说。终于，他们停下了。

paras.en: “Here we are!” Anna said. She pulled off Kristoff’s blindfold. Before them sat a beautiful new sled. “I owe you a sled!”
paras.zh: “我们到了！”安娜说。她摘下克里斯托夫的眼罩。他们面前停着一架漂亮的新雪橇。“我还欠你一架雪橇呢！”

paras.en: Kristoff was taken aback. “Are you serious?” he said. “No. I can’t accept this.”
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫吃了一惊。“你是说真的？”他说。“不，这个我不能收。”

paras.en: Anna laughed. “You have to. No returns. Queen’s orders. She’s named you the official Arendelle ice master and deliverer.”
paras.zh: 安娜笑了。“你必须收下。概不退换。女王下的令。她封你为阿伦黛尔官方御用采冰大师兼送货员。”

paras.en: “That’s not a thing,” said Kristoff with a smile.
paras.zh: “哪有这种职位。”克里斯托夫笑着说。

paras.en: “Sure it is!” Anna said. “And it even has a cup holder. Do you like it?”
paras.zh: “当然有！”安娜说。“而且还带杯架呢。你喜欢吗？”

paras.en: Kristoff hugged Anna. “Like it?” he asked. “I love it. I could kiss you!” Kristoff looked into Anna’s eyes and suddenly felt bashful. “I mean, I’d like to. May I? I mean, may we? Wait—what?”
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫抱住了安娜。“喜欢？”他问。“我简直爱死了。我真想亲你一口！”克里斯托夫望进安娜的眼睛，忽然害羞起来。“我是说，我很想亲。可以吗？我是说，我们可以吗？等等——什么？”

paras.en: Anna leaned over and gave Kristoff a quick kiss. “We may,” she said.
paras.zh: 安娜凑过去，在克里斯托夫脸上飞快地亲了一下。“我们可以。”她说。

paras.en: Kristoff smiled. Then he leaned in and kissed Anna right back. But this time it was a real kiss, sweet and romantic, and perfect for Anna.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫笑了。接着他俯下身，回吻了安娜。但这一回，是一个真正的吻，甜蜜而浪漫，对安娜来说再完美不过。

paras.en: Not far away, Olaf was happily enjoying the summer weather with the help of his little snow cloud. He held a big bouquet of flowers up to his nose and took a deep sniff. Suddenly, he sneezed—and his carrot nose shot off his face!
paras.zh: 不远处，雪宝正借着头顶的小雪云，快活地享受着夏日天气。他举起一大束花凑到鼻尖，深深嗅了一下。忽然，他打了个喷嚏——胡萝卜鼻子竟从脸上飞了出去！

paras.en: Sven was standing nearby, and with a quick movement of his head, the reindeer reached out and caught the carrot in his mouth. For a moment, it looked like Sven might chomp down on his favorite food. But instead, he gave the carrot back to Olaf, who happily popped the carrot back onto his face.
paras.zh: 斯文就站在近旁，只见它脑袋一甩，伸出嘴稳稳叼住了那根胡萝卜。有一瞬间，斯文像是要一口咬下这最爱的美食。可它并没有，而是把胡萝卜还给了雪宝，雪宝开心地把胡萝卜重新安回脸上。

paras.en: Just past Olaf, Anna saw something else that brought a smile to her face. The gates to the castle were wide open. Elsa stood in the courtyard. All around her, people were putting on ice skates. And the parts of the castle that had been destroyed earlier were now fully repaired—with ice!
paras.zh: 越过雪宝，安娜望见了另一样东西，令她脸上泛起笑意。城堡的大门敞开着。艾莎站在庭院里。她身旁，人们正纷纷穿上溜冰鞋。而城堡早先被毁的部分，如今已全部用冰修缮一新！

paras.en: “Are you ready?” Elsa was asking the crowd. She raised her arms, swirled them in the air, and created a beautiful ice rink!
paras.zh: “准备好了吗？”艾莎正问着人群。她举起双臂，在空中旋了一圈，造出一座漂亮的溜冰场！

paras.en: Anna ran to her sister. “The gates are open,” she said. “I like it.”
paras.zh: 安娜跑到姐姐身边。“大门敞开着呢。”她说。“我喜欢。”

paras.en: Elsa put an arm around Anna. “Let’s never close them again.” Then, with a smile, she pulled Anna onto the ice so the two could skate around the rink, together at last.
paras.zh: 艾莎搂住安娜。“我们再也不关上它了。”接着，她笑着把安娜拉上冰面，姐妹俩终于能一起绕着冰场滑行了。

paras.en: Behind them, Sven ventured out onto the ice, too. But his skating didn’t come so easily. His legs slipped and twisted as he struggled to keep his balance. Anxious for his friend, Kristoff chased after Sven, awkwardly trying to keep him upright.
paras.zh: 她们身后，斯文也壮着胆子踏上了冰面。可它滑起来可没那么轻松。它双腿打滑、扭作一团，努力想保持平衡。克里斯托夫放心不下朋友，追在斯文身后，笨手笨脚地想扶它站稳。

paras.en: Last came Olaf, who slid over to Anna and Elsa. Together, they all skated happily across the ice. Summer—as well as love and happiness—had finally returned to Arendelle.
paras.zh: 最后过来的是雪宝，他滑到安娜和艾莎身边。他们一起，欢快地滑过冰面。夏天——连同爱与欢乐——终于回到了阿伦黛尔。
